This offers improved efficiency and resource utilization. To the best of our knowledge, this survey is the first comprehensive review focusing on deep MTL in CAVs. We begin with an overview of CAVs and MTL to provide foundational background. Then, we review MTL approaches across key functional domains in CAVs, including perception, prediction, planning, control, as well as V2X communications and radio resource management (RRM). For the first four domains, we categorize existing works under ego vehicle-only (onboard-only) and V2X-enhanced cooperative (multi-agent) paradigms. We further discuss V2X communications and RRM as communication-centric MTL problems. Finally, we discuss the strengths and limitations of existing methods, identify key research gaps, and provide future research directions aimed at advancing MTL methodologies for CAV systems.

</details>


### [430] [Reward Evolution with Graph-of-Thoughts: A Bi-Level Language Model Framework for Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.16136)
*Changwei Yao,Xinzi Liu,Chen Li,Marios Savvides*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出RE-GoT框架，利用图式思维（Graph-of-Thoughts）将LLM与VLM结合，实现无需人工干预的自动化奖励函数设计与迭代优化，在机器人操作任务中显著优于现有方法，甚至超越专家设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL中奖励函数设计依赖大量人工专家经验，现有LLM-based方法存在幻觉、依赖人类反馈、难以处理复杂多步任务等局限。

Method: 提出RE-GoT双层框架：上层将任务分解为文本属性图（text-attributed graphs）进行结构化推理以生成奖励函数；下层利用VLM进行自动rollout评估，迭代优化奖励函数，全程无需人工介入。

Result: 在10个RoboGen任务上平均成功率提升32.25%，在4个ManiSkill2任务上平均成功率93.73%，超越专家设计的奖励函数。

Conclusion: LLM与VLM结合图式推理为RL中自主奖励进化提供了可扩展且有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Designing effective reward functions remains a major challenge in reinforcement learning (RL), often requiring considerable human expertise and iterative refinement. Recent advances leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) for automated reward design, but these approaches are limited by hallucinations, reliance on human feedback, and challenges with handling complex, multi-step tasks. In this work, we introduce Reward Evolution with Graph-of-Thoughts (RE-GoT), a novel bi-level framework that enhances LLMs with structured graph-based reasoning and integrates Visual Language Models (VLMs) for automated rollout evaluation. RE-GoT first decomposes tasks into text-attributed graphs, enabling comprehensive analysis and reward function generation, and then iteratively refines rewards using visual feedback from VLMs without human intervention. Extensive experiments on 10 RoboGen and 4 ManiSkill2 tasks demonstrate that RE-GoT consistently outperforms existing LLM-based baselines. On RoboGen, our method improves average task success rates by 32.25%, with notable gains on complex multi-step tasks. On ManiSkill2, RE-GoT achieves an average success rate of 93.73% across four diverse manipulation tasks, significantly surpassing prior LLM-based approaches and even exceeding expert-designed rewards. Our results indicate that combining LLMs and VLMs with graph-of-thoughts reasoning provides a scalable and effective solution for autonomous reward evolution in RL.

</details>


### [431] [Symskill: Symbol and Skill Co-Invention for Data-Efficient and Reactive Long-Horizon Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.01661)
*Yifei Simon Shao,Yuchen Zheng,Sunan Sun,Pratik Chaudhari,Vijay Kumar,Nadia Figueroa*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SymSkill是一个统一框架，能从无标注、无分段的演示中联合学习谓词、操作符和技能，结合了符号规划的组合泛化能力与实时故障恢复能力，在仿真和真实机器人上均实现了高效的多步操作任务执行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的模仿学习（IL）虽具有反应性但缺乏组合泛化能力，而经典的任务与运动规划（TAMP）虽具备组合性但规划延迟高，无法实现实时故障恢复。因此需要一种既能组合泛化又能实时恢复的统一框架。

Method: 离线阶段从无标注演示中学习符号抽象（谓词、操作符）和目标导向技能；在线阶段使用符号规划器组合和重排技能以实现符号目标，并在运动和符号层面实时恢复故障，结合柔顺控制器支持安全执行。

Result: 在RoboCasa仿真中，SymSkill以85%的成功率执行12个单步任务并组合成多步规划；在真实Franka机器人上，仅需5分钟演示数据即可执行12步任务。

Conclusion: SymSkill有效结合了符号规划的泛化优势与IL的实时响应能力，实现了动态环境中多步操作的高成功率和实时故障恢复。

Abstract: Multi-step manipulation in dynamic environments remains challenging. Imitation learning (IL) is reactive but lacks compositional generalization, since monolithic policies do not decide which skill to reuse when scenes change. Classical task-and-motion planning (TAMP) offers compositionality, but its high planning latency prevents real-time failure recovery. We introduce SymSkill, a unified framework that jointly learns predicates, operators, and skills from unlabeled, unsegmented demonstrations, combining compositional generalization with real-time recovery. Offline, SymSkill learns symbolic abstractions and goal-oriented skills directly from demonstrations. Online, given a conjunction of learned predicates, it uses a symbolic planner to compose and reorder skills to achieve symbolic goals while recovering from failures at both the motion and symbolic levels in real time. Coupled with a compliant controller, SymSkill supports safe execution under human and environmental disturbances. In RoboCasa simulation, SymSkill executes 12 single-step tasks with 85% success and composes them into multi-step plans without additional data. On a real Franka robot, it learns from 5 minutes of play data and performs 12-step tasks from goal specifications. Code and additional analysis are available at https://symskill.github.io/ .

</details>


### [432] [How Well Do Latent World Models Understand Partially Observable Safety Constraints?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.06492)
*Matthew Kim,Kensuke Nakamura,Andrea Bajcsy*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究了潜在世界模型在部分可观测条件下的安全控制问题，识别了两种失败模式（估计缺口和预测缺口），提出了相应的诊断指标和缓解策略，并通过硬件实验验证了方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜在世界模型虽然能从高维观测中学习状态表征和动力学，但控制性能依赖于潜在表征是否编码了任务所需信息。在部分可观测条件下，安全相关信息可能无法在潜在状态中保留，导致控制失败，这一问题尚未被充分研究。

Method: 1) 识别了两种世界模型失败模式：估计缺口（当前观测无法揭示安全关键量）和预测缺口（失败可观测但无法可靠预测）。2) 提出了两种诊断指标：基于互信息的安全可观测性度量和基于rollout的未来安全可预测性度量。3) 提出了两种缓解策略：针对估计缺口采用特权多模态监督，针对预测缺口采用保形风险校准。

Result: 在Franka Research 3机械臂的烹饪任务上，使用单模态RGB世界模型以及多模态RGB+Tactile和RGB+Thermal变体进行实验，结果表明提出的缓解策略在部分可观测条件下提高了安全性，但代价是增加了保守性。

Conclusion: 本文揭示了世界模型状态表征是否足以支持可靠机器人控制这一核心问题，为部分可观测条件下的安全控制提供了诊断工具和缓解方法。

Abstract: Latent world models are a promising approach for learning state representations and dynamics directly from high-dimensional observations, enabling robot control in hard-to-model settings. However, control performance ultimately depends on the latent representation encoding the required information for the task. In this work, we study latent-space safe control problems and show how partial observability can induce control failures when safety-relevant information is not preserved in the latent state. Specifically, we identify two world model failure modes: estimation gaps, where current observations do not reveal safety-critical quantities (e.g., temperature in a cooking task), and prediction gaps, where failures are observable once they occur but cannot be reliably anticipated from available observations. We introduce two diagnostics for these gaps: a mutual-information-based measure of safety observability and a rollout-based measure of future safety predictability. Finally, we present mitigation strategies for each failure mode: privileged multimodal supervision for estimation gaps and conformal risk calibration for prediction gaps. Across two hardware case studies -- using unimodal RGB world models and multimodal RGB+Tactile and RGB+Thermal variants -- we show that these mitigation strategies improve the safety of a Franka Research 3 manipulator on challenging cooking tasks under partial observability, albeit with increased conservativeness. More broadly, our work raises the question of when world model state representations are sufficient for reliable robot control

</details>


### [433] [DIJIT: A Robotic Head for an Active Observer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.07998)
*Mostafa Kamali Tabrizi,Mingshi Chi,Bir Bikram Dey,Kelly Yuan,Markus D. Solbach,Yiqian Liu,Michael Jenkin,John K. Tsotsos*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文介绍DIJIT，一种专为移动机器人设计的双目仿人机器人头，具备9个机械自由度和4个光学自由度，在速度上达到人类峰值扫视速度的85%，并实现了接近人类的扫视精度（左右相机平均误差分别为1.17°和1.14°），用于研究主动视觉、眼-头协调及其与计算机视觉方法的差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了在移动机器人上实现主动视觉研究，探索人类视觉中眼/头运动解决视觉任务的方式与当前计算机视觉方法的差异，以及研究类人眼-头颈部运动及其相互关系。

Method: 设计了一款具有9个机械自由度和4个光学自由度的双目机器人头DIJIT，其机械运动范围和速度与人类相当；并提出了一种基于相机方向与电机值直接关系的扫视运动方法。

Result: DIJIT达到人类峰值扫视速度的85%，覆盖会聚、版本和旋转等收敛立体视觉所需的运动范围；扫视运动精度接近人类，左右相机平均误差分别为1.17°和1.14°。

Conclusion: DIJIT在双目仿人机器人头设计中实现了高性能的主动视觉能力，其扫视精度接近人类水平，为主动视觉研究和眼-头协调机制探索提供了有效平台。

Abstract: We present DIJIT, a novel binocular robotic head expressly designed for mobile agents that behave as active observers. DIJIT's unique breadth of functionality enables active vision research and the study of human-like eye and head-neck motions, their interrelationships, and how each contributes to visual ability. DIJIT is also being used to explore the differences between how human vision employs eye/head movements to solve visual tasks and current computer vision methods. DIJIT's design features nine mechanical degrees of freedom, while the cameras and lenses provide an additional four optical degrees of freedom. The ranges and speeds of the mechanical design are comparable to human performance. DIJIT attains 85\% of the peak human saccade speed. Our design includes the ranges of motion required for convergent stereo, namely, vergence, version, and cyclotorsion. Here, we present DIJIT and some aspects of its performance. We also present a novel method for saccadic camera movements, using a direct relationship between camera orientation and motor values. The resulting saccadic camera movements are close to human movements in terms of their accuracy, with 1.17$^\circ$ and 1.14$^\circ$ mean error for the left and right cameras, respectively.

</details>


### [434] [Programmable Deformation Design of Porous Soft Actuator through Volumetric-Pattern-Induced Anisotropy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.12320)
*Canqi Meng,Weibang Bai*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种通过在泡沫多孔弹性体上切割特定图案实现可编程变形的软体致动器设计方法，利用局部结构各向异性引导真空驱动下的变形，实现了弯曲、倾斜和扭转三种基本运动模式，并通过有限元分析和实验验证了其有效性，最终应用于仿人软体机械手。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于空心弹性腔的软体气动致动器存在结构支撑小、多模态功能需昂贵几何重新设计等问题。虽然泡沫等填充材料可提供结构稳定性，但通过裁剪多孔体本身实现可编程变形的方法尚待探索。

Method: 在圆柱形泡沫基材上切割特定图案（横向切口实现弯曲、纵向切口实现倾斜、对角切口实现扭转），利用切口引入局部结构各向异性，在全局真空输入下引导材料变形；结合有限元分析构建计算模型，并通过实验优化图案阵列数量N。

Result: 最优设计下：弯曲可达80°（N=2），倾斜18°（N=1），扭转115°（N=8）。方法具备图案可转移性、可扩展性和无模快速成型能力。以人手折痕图转化为功能图案，实现了仿人自适应抓取软体机械手。

Conclusion: 该工作为多功能软体多孔机器人设计提供了一种高效、可扩展的新范式。

Abstract: Conventional soft pneumatic actuators, typically based on hollow elastomeric chambers, often suffer from small structural support and require costly geometry-specific redesigns for multimodal functionality. Porous materials such as foam, filled into chambers, can provide structural stability for the actuators. However, methods to achieve programmable deformation by tailoring the porous body itself remain underexplored. In this paper, a novel design method is presented to realize soft porous actuators with programmable deformation by incising specific patterns into the porous foam body. This approach introduces localized structural anisotropy of the foam guiding the material's deformation under a global vacuum input. Furthermore, three fundamental patterns on a cylindrical foam substrate are discussed: transverse for bending, longitudinal for tilting, and diagonal for twisting. A computational model is built with Finite Element Analysis (FEA), to investigate the mechanism of the incision-patterning method. Experiments demonstrate that with a potential optimal design of the pattern array number N, actuators can achieve bending up to $80^{\circ}$ (N=2), tilting of $18^{\circ}$ (N=1), and twisting of $115^{\circ}$ (N=8). The versatility of our approach is demonstrated via pattern transferability, scalability, and mold-less rapid prototyping of complex designs. As a comprehensive application, we translate the human hand crease map into a functional incision pattern, creating a bio-inspired soft robot hand capable of human-like adaptive grasping. Our work provides a new, efficient, and scalable paradigm for the design of multi-functional soft porous robots.

</details>


### [435] [LightTact: A Visual-Tactile Fingertip Sensor for Deformation-Independent Contact Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.20591)
*Changyi Lin,Boda Huo,Mingyang Yu,Emily Ruppel,Bingqing Chen,Jonathan Francis,Ding Zhao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: LightTact是一种基于变形无关原理的视觉-触觉指尖传感器，通过环境阻挡光学配置实现高对比度接触成像，可感知极轻微接触（如液体、半液体、超软材料），并实现像素级鲁棒分割，支持新型机器人操作行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有触觉传感器大多依赖表面形变来推断接触，但在与液体、半液体或超软材料交互时，宏观形变往往不存在，导致此类轻接触难以被可靠感知。

Method: 设计了一种环境阻挡光学配置：抑制外部光和内部照明在非接触区域的传播，仅传输真实接触点产生的散射光。由此产生高对比度原始图像（非接触像素近黑，接触像素保留表面自然外观）。

Result: 实现了对材料属性、接触力、表面外观和环境光照鲁棒的像素级接触分割；在水平扩展、面霜蘸取、软薄膜交互等极轻接触场景中展示了新型机器人操作能力；空间对齐的视觉-触觉图像可直接被视觉语言模型解释。

Conclusion: LightTact通过光学原理而非形变机制感知接触，突破了传统触觉传感器的局限，为机器人在精细、轻接触场景中的操作提供了新途径。

Abstract: Contact often occurs without macroscopic surface deformation, such as during interaction with liquids, semi-liquids, or ultra-soft materials. However, most existing tactile sensors rely on deformation to infer contact, making such light-contact interactions difficult to perceive robustly. To address this, we present LightTact, a visual-tactile fingertip sensor that makes contact directly visible via a deformation-independent principle. LightTact features an ambient-blocking optical configuration that suppresses both external light and internal illumination at non-contact regions, while transmitting only the scattered light generated at true contacts. As a result, LightTact produces high-contrast raw images in which non-contact pixels remain near-black (mean gray value < 3) and contact pixels preserve the natural appearance of the contacting surface. Built on this, LightTact achieves accurate pixel-level contact segmentation that is robust to material properties, contact force, surface appearance, and environmental lighting. We further demonstrate that LightTact unlocks new robotic manipulation behaviors that require detection of extremely light contact, including water spreading, facial-cream dipping, and soft thin-film interaction. In addition, we show that LightTact's spatially aligned visual-tactile images can be directly interpreted by vision-language models.

</details>


### [436] [Vision-Based Early Fault Diagnosis and Self-Recovery for Strawberry Harvesting Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.02085)
*Meili Sun,Chunjiang Zhao,Lichao Yang,Hao Liu,Shimin Hu,Ya Xiong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出视觉故障诊断与自恢复框架解决草莓采摘机器人存在的视觉感知差、夹爪不对中、空抓/误抓及滑落等问题。通过SRR-Net实现目标与夹爪的统一感知，基于相对误差补偿校正位置偏差，利用微型光学相机和MobileNet V3-Small进行空抓/误抓调节，采用LSTM预测草莓滑落并执行二次抓取。实验表明定位误差显著降低，滑落恢复率达81.25%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有草莓采摘机器人存在视觉感知能力不足、夹爪与目标对准偏差、空抓/误抓及采摘过程中草莓滑落等问题，导致采摘稳定性和效率低下。

Method: 1) SRR-Net端到端网络实现目标与夹爪的联合检测、分割和成熟度回归；2) 基于同时检测目标与夹爪的相对误差补偿方法校正位置偏差；3) 利用末端微型光学相机和MobileNet V3-Small在放气阶段进行空抓/误抓分类，提前终止采摘循环；4) 采用时间序列LSTM分类器在拉断阶段预测草莓滑落，对滑落中草莓执行再充气与二次拉断，对已滑落草莓终止循环。

Result: 末端执行器与采摘点沿x轴和y轴的平均绝对误差分别从11.50 mm和5.25 mm降至3.12 mm和4.06 mm，时间增加0.64±0.24 s。抓取调节模块减少约0.5 s抓取阶段，避免空放置。滑落预测模块对已滑落情况成功率达88.89%，每个失败循环节省约4.00 s；对滑落中草莓恢复率达81.25%，重抓取需额外0.63 s。

Conclusion: 所提出的视觉故障诊断与自恢复框架有效提升了草莓采摘机器人的定位精度、抓取可靠性和整体效率，尤其通过滑落预测与重抓取机制显著减少了失败采摘循环的时间损失。

Abstract: Strawberry-harvesting robots faced challenges such as poor visual perception, gripper misalignment, empty grasp/misgrasp, and slippage, which reduced harvesting stability and efficiency.To overcome these issues, this paper proposes a visual fault diagnosis and self-recovery framework. An end-to-end SRR-Net achieved unified perception and fault diagnosis through joint detection, segmentation, and ripeness regression of the fruit and gripper. Leveraging this integrated perception, a relative error compensation method driven by simultaneous target-gripper detection was designed to correct positional misalignments exceeding the tolerance threshold. A micro-optical camera integrated within the end-effector delivered real-time visual feedback. Based on the micro-optical camera, a MobileNet V3-Small classifier was utilized for grasp adjustment during the deflating stage, enabling the early abort of the harvesting cycle in cases of empty grasp/misgrasps. Furthermore, a time-series LSTM classifier was applied during the snap-off stage to predict strawberry slippage. Based on these predictions, the system executed re-inflation and a secondary snap-off attempt for slipping strawberries, or aborted the cycle for slipped strawberries. Experiments demonstrated that the mean absolute errors between the end-effector and the picking point were reduced to 3.12 mm and 4.06 mm from 11.50 mm and 5.25 mm along the x- and y-axes, respectively, at the cost of a time increment of 0.64 $pm$ 0.24 s. The grasp adjustment module reduced the grasping phase by approximately 0.5 s and avoided empty-placement for failure cases. The strawberry slip prediction module handled slipped cases with an 88.89% success rate, saving approximately 4.00 s per harvesting cycle for failure cases. Also, it achieved an 81.25% recovery rate for slipping strawberries, requiring additional 0.63 s for re-grasping.

</details>


### [437] [On-the-fly hand-eye calibration for the da Vinci surgical robot](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.14871)
*Zejian Cui,Ferdinando Rodriguez y Baena*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于机器人辅助微创手术中实时计算手眼变换矩阵的标定框架，通过特征关联和手眼标定两个模块实现无预训练的关键点匹配与多场景适配，在公开数据集上显著降低了工具定位误差，且相比现有方法更高效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在机器人辅助微创手术中，线缆驱动机器人（如达芬奇系统）因编码器读数误差导致工具定位不准确，影响手术安全与操作精度，因此需要一种能实时校正手眼变换矩阵的标定方法。

Method: 提出包含两个核心算法的标定框架：(1) 特征关联块，无需预训练即可在单目图像上建立关键点的鲁棒对应关系；(2) 手眼标定块，通过多种滤波方法适配不同手术场景，实现手眼变换矩阵的在线计算。

Result: 在涵盖多种手术器械、体外与离体场景、不同光照条件和关键点测量精度的公开视频数据集上，该框架显著降低了工具定位误差，精度与最先进方法相当，同时计算时间更短。

Conclusion: 提出的在线标定框架能有效解决线缆驱动机器人工具定位误差问题，在保持高精度的同时具备更好的时间效率，适用于多样化的手术场景。

Abstract: In Robot-Assisted Minimally Invasive Surgery (RMIS), accurate tool localization is crucial to ensure patient safety and successful task execution. However, this remains challenging for cable-driven robots, such as the da Vinci robot, because erroneous encoder readings lead to pose estimation errors. In this study, we propose a calibration framework to produce accurate tool localization results through computing the hand-eye transformation matrix on-the-fly. The framework consists of two interrelated algorithms: the feature association block and the hand-eye calibration block, which provide robust correspondences for key points detected on monocular images without pre-training, and offer the versatility to accommodate various surgical scenarios by adopting an array of filter approaches, respectively. To validate its efficacy, we test the framework extensively on publicly available video datasets that feature multiple surgical instruments conducting tasks in both in vitro and ex vivo scenarios, under varying illumination conditions and with different levels of key point measurement accuracy. The results show a significant reduction in tool localization errors under the proposed calibration framework, with accuracies comparable to other state-of-the-art methods while being more time-efficient.

</details>


### [438] [Robot-DIFT: Correspondence-Sensitive Diffusion Features for Contact-Rich Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.11934)
*Yu Deng,Yufeng Jin,Xiaogang Jia,Jiahong Xue,Gerhard Neumann,Georgia Chalvatzaki*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Robot-DIFT，通过流形蒸馏将扩散特征转化为确定性单次前馈骨干网络，并结合空间-语义特征金字塔网络（S2-FPN）提供闭环控制所需的对应敏感性，在接触敏感型操作任务中显著优于各类基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人操作常在最后毫米级失败，这是因为语义不变性抑制了闭环控制所需的对应线索，或这些线索未以可用形式暴露给策略。现有视觉编码器提供强语义抽象，但接触丰富的操作需要对应敏感性——对位姿、边界和接触几何中行动相关变化的判别性特征响应。

Method: 提出Robot-DIFT，包含两个核心组件：1) 流形蒸馏（Manifold Distillation），将噪声条件的扩散Teacher转换为干净输入、单次前馈的Student，同时保留Teacher的特征流形；2) 空间-语义特征金字塔网络（S2-FPN），融合从粗到细的Student解码器特征，生成暴露语义上下文和精细接触细节的视觉token。

Result: 在RoboCasa、LIBERO-10和真实机器人实验中，Robot-DIFT在接触敏感型任务上优于视觉-语言、自监督、几何导向和扩散基线方法。通过控制骨干网络/读出头的消融实验表明，S2-FPN是解锁而非替代扩散对应先验。

Conclusion: 扩散特征蕴含的密集对应先验经过合适的蒸馏和特征融合后，可以有效服务于实时闭环机器人控制，解决接触敏感操作中的精确对齐问题。

Abstract: Robot manipulation often fails in the final millimeters: a policy may recognize the right object yet miss the pose offsets, boundaries, or pre-contact alignments needed for action. We argue that such failures arise when semantic invariance suppresses correspondence cues for closed-loop control, or when these cues are not exposed to the policy in a usable form. Modern visual encoders provide strong semantic abstractions, but contact-rich manipulation requires correspondence sensitivity: discriminative feature responses to action-relevant changes in pose, boundary, and contact geometry. Diffusion features provide a strong prior for dense correspondence, but direct use is impractical due to stochasticity, latency, and representation drift. We introduce Robot-DIFT, a deterministic diffusion-derived backbone for real-time control. Through Manifold Distillation, Robot-DIFT converts a noise-conditioned diffusion Teacher into a clean-input, single-pass Student while preserving the teacher's feature manifold. A Spatial--Semantic Feature Pyramid Network (S2-FPN) fuses coarse-to-fine Student decoder features into visual tokens that expose semantic context and fine contact detail to the policy. Across RoboCasa, LIBERO-10, and real robots, Robot-DIFT outperforms vision--language, self-supervised, geometry-oriented, and diffusion baselines on contact-sensitive tasks. Controlled backbone/readout swaps show that S2-FPN unlocks, rather than replaces, the diffusion correspondence prior.

</details>


### [439] [SODA-CitrON: Static Object Data Association by Clustering Multi-Modal Sensor Detections Online](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.22243)
*Jan Nausner,Kilian Wohlleben,Michael Hubner*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出SODA-CitrON方法，通过在线聚类多模态传感器检测数据解决静态目标数据关联问题，同时估计位置并维持未知数量目标的持久轨迹。该方法为无监督在线学习，支持时间不相关和多传感器测量，具有最坏情况对数线性复杂度并提供完全可解释输出。在蒙特卡洛仿真中，SODA-CitrON在F1分数、位置RMSE、MOTP和MOTA指标上持续优于POM滤波、DBSTREAM聚类和JPDA等现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 静态目标在机器人、自主系统和环境建图中具有重要应用，但经典数据关联方法（如JPDA）针对动态目标设计，对间歇观测、异质不确定性的静态目标效果不佳，因为运动模型在区分真实目标与杂波时缺乏判别力。

Method: 提出SODA-CitrON方法，采用在线无监督机器学习聚类多模态传感器检测，同步进行位置估计与轨迹维护。方法完全在线运行，处理时间不相关和多传感器测量，具有最坏情况对数线性复杂度，并提供完全可解释的输出。

Result: 在多种蒙特卡洛仿真场景中，SODA-CitrON在F1分数、位置RMSE、MOTP和MOTA指标上持续优于基于POM的滤波、DBSTREAM聚类和JPDA等现有方法。

Conclusion: SODA-CitrON有效解决了静态目标数据关联难题，为异质传感器检测下的静态目标在线融合与跟踪提供了高效、可解释的解决方案。

Abstract: The online fusion and tracking of static objects from heterogeneous sensor detections is a fundamental problem in robotics, autonomous systems, and environmental mapping. Although classical data association approaches such as JPDA are well suited for dynamic targets, they are less effective for static objects observed intermittently and with heterogeneous uncertainties, where motion models provide minimal discriminative power with respect to clutter. In this paper, we propose a novel method for static object data association by clustering multi-modal sensor detections online (SODA-CitrON), while simultaneously estimating positions and maintaining persistent tracks for an unknown number of objects. The proposed unsupervised machine learning approach operates in a fully online manner and handles temporally uncorrelated and multi-sensor measurements. Additionally, it has a worst-case loglinear complexity in the number of sensor detections while providing full output explainability. We evaluate the proposed approach in different Monte Carlo simulation scenarios and compare it against state-of-the-art methods, including POM-based filtering, DBSTREAM clustering, and JPDA. The results demonstrate that SODA-CitrON consistently outperforms the compared methods in terms of F1 score, position RMSE, MOTP, and MOTA in the static object mapping scenarios studied.

</details>


### [440] [Sparse Autoencoders Reveal Interpretable and Steerable Features in VLA Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.19183)
*Aiden Swann,Lachlain McGranahan,Hugo Buurmeijer,Monroe Kennedy,Mac Schwager*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文通过稀疏自编码器（SAEs）分析VLA模型的内部表征，发现模型学习到了可迁移的运动基元和语义概念特征，并通过因果干预实验验证了这些特征对泛化能力的贡献，揭示了VLA模型跨任务、场景泛化的内在机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型在机器人操作任务中展现出良好泛化能力，但缺乏对其内部表征的机制性理解，不清楚模型何时以及为何能跨对象、场景和指令进行泛化。

Method: 在VLA模型隐层激活上训练稀疏自编码器（SAEs），学习稀疏字典以提取可解释的特征方向；提出度量方法区分通用可迁移基元与特定情节的记忆；通过因果干预实验（放大/消融特征）在LIBERO仿真基准和DROID真实硬件上验证发现。

Result: 识别出对应运动基元和语义概念的SAE特征，部分特征具有跨情节通用性和因果可操控性；放大通用和语义特征可诱导符合其语义的行为，消融则破坏模型性能；展示了利用特征操控实现未提示方向的行为控制。

Conclusion: VLA模型能够在内部学习到连接视觉、语言和动作的可复用特征，这些特征是跨任务和场景泛化的基础，为理解VLA泛化机制提供了有力证据。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising approach for general-purpose robot manipulation. However, little research has mechanistically explored when and why they generalize across objects, scenes, and instructions. To probe internal representations, we train Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) on the VLA's hidden-layer activations. SAEs learn sparse dictionaries over model activations, often revealing features that correspond to interpretable directions in the model's representation space. We identify SAE features corresponding to motion primitives and semantic concepts, including features that are general across episodes and causally steerable. We propose a metric to categorize features as general transferable primitives or episode-specific memorizations, offering a promising glimpse towards VLA generalization. We validate these findings through steering experiments on both the LIBERO simulation benchmark and on real-world DROID hardware. We find that amplifying general and semantic features induces behaviors consistent with their meanings, whereas ablating them destroys model performance. Furthermore, we demonstrate steering as a way to control behavior in unpromptable directions. Together, these results provide mechanistic evidence that VLAs can learn reusable internal features linking perception, language, and action across tasks and scenes. Our project page is located at https://drvla.github.io

</details>


### [441] [Decentralized End-to-End Multi-AAV Pursuit Using Predictive Spatio-Temporal Observation via Deep Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.24238)
*Yude Li,Zhexuan Zhou,Huizhe Li,Yanke Sun,Yenan Wu,Yichen Lai,Yiming Wang,Youmin Gong,Jie Mei*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种去中心化端到端多智能体强化学习框架，利用预测性时空观测（PSTO）将原始激光雷达观测直接映射为连续控制指令，使无人机群在杂乱环境中无需特权信息即可实现协同追捕，并在仿真和室外实验中验证了其性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法依赖抽象的几何特征或特权真值状态，回避了现实世界中部分、噪声感知带来的不确定性，难以支持无人机群在杂乱环境下的去中心化协同追捕。

Method: 提出去中心化端到端MARL框架，核心为预测性时空观测（PSTO）——一种以自我为中心的网格表示，将障碍物几何、预测的对抗意图和队友运动统一对齐到固定分辨率投影中。基于PSTO训练单一去中心化策略，直接映射原始LiDAR观测到连续控制指令。

Result: 仿真中相较依赖特权障碍物信息的SOTA学习方法，捕获效率更优、成功率具有竞争力；单一策略无需重训即可无缝扩展到不同规模的机群；室外四旋翼无人机群实验完全依赖机载感知与计算完成自主追捕。

Conclusion: 所提框架有效解决了真实场景下杂乱环境中去中心化协同追捕的感知不确定性挑战，且策略具有良好的可扩展性与实用性。

Abstract: Decentralized cooperative pursuit in cluttered environments is challenging for autonomous aerial swarms, especially under partial and noisy perception. Existing methods often rely on abstracted geometric features or privileged ground-truth states, and therefore sidestep perceptual uncertainty in real-world settings. We propose a decentralized end-to-end multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) framework that maps raw LiDAR observations directly to continuous control commands. Central to the framework is the Predictive Spatio-Temporal Observation (PSTO), an egocentric grid representation that aligns obstacle geometry with predictive adversarial intent and teammate motion in a unified, fixed-resolution projection. Built on PSTO, a single decentralized policy enables agents to navigate static obstacles, intercept dynamic targets, and maintain cooperative encirclement. Simulations demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior capture efficiency and competitive success rates compared to state-of-the-art learning-based approaches relying on privileged obstacle information. Furthermore, the unified policy scales seamlessly across different team sizes without retraining. Finally, fully autonomous outdoor experiments validate the framework on a quadrotor swarm relying on only onboard sensing and computing.

</details>


### [442] [FingerEye: Learning Dexterous Manipulation with Continuous Vision-Tactile Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.20689)
*Zhixuan Xu,Yichen Li,Xuanye Wu,Tianyu Qiu,Lin Shao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: FingerEye是一个感知与学习框架，通过在指尖集成双目摄像头和柔性接触界面，实现从接触前到接触后连续视觉-触觉反馈，从而提升机械手灵巧操作能力。实验证明该方法在7个接触敏感任务中相比仅使用腕部相机策略提升超30个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灵巧机械手操作需要从接触前到接触后保持感知信息的有效性，但现有方法在接触前后的感知连续性不足，缺乏统一的视觉-触觉反馈框架。

Method: 1) 感知端：在指尖集成双目RGB摄像头和带标记的柔性接触界面，接触前提供近距离视觉线索和立体信息，接触后通过标记跟踪柔性环形变实现接触力感知。2) 学习端：构建虚实数据收集与评估基础设施，设计FingerEye Policy，采用分组结构化模态融合减少模态捷径学习，更好利用分布式指尖反馈。

Result: 在7个接触敏感任务中，FingerEye在仿真和真实世界中相比仅使用腕部相机的策略在平均成功率上提升超过30个百分点。

Conclusion: FingerEye通过连续视觉-触觉反馈显著提升了灵巧机械手在接触敏感操作任务中的性能，验证了指尖集成多模态感知与分组模态融合策略的有效性。

Abstract: Dexterous robotic manipulation requires perception that remains informative from pre-contact approach to contact initiation and post-contact control. We introduce FingerEye, a sensing and learning framework that strengthens robotic dexterity through continuous vision-tactile feedback throughout interaction. On the sensing side, FingerEye integrates binocular RGB cameras with a compliant contact interface to support perception both before and after contact. Before contact, the fingertip cameras provide close-range visual cues and implicit stereo for precise approach and object localization. After contact, marker-tracked deformation of the compliant ring provides a proxy for contact wrench sensing. On the learning side, we build real-and-sim infrastructure for data collection and evaluation, systematically study policy-interface designs for learning with multiple FingerEye sensors, and develop FingerEye Policy, which applies group-structured modality fusion to reduce modality shortcuts and better exploit distributed fingertip feedback. Across seven contact-sensitive task settings, FingerEye improves wrist-only policy by over 30 percentage points in mean success rate in both simulation and the real world.

</details>


### [443] [CodeGraphVLP: Code-as-Planner Meets Semantic-Graph State for Non-Markovian Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.22238)
*Khoa Vo,Sieu Tran,Taisei Hanyu,Yuki Ikebe,Duy Nguyen,Nghi D. Q. Bui,Minh Vu,Anthony Gunderman,Chase Rainwater,Anh Nguyen,Ngan Le*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: CodeGraphVLP提出层级框架，结合持久化语义图、可执行代码规划器和进度引导的视觉语言提示，解决了VLA模型在非马尔可夫长时域操作任务中因部分可观测性和杂乱环境导致的失败问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型假设最新观测足以进行动作推理，这违背了非马尔可夫长时域任务的特性——任务相关信息可能被遮挡或仅出现在历史轨迹中，且杂乱环境使细粒度视觉定位变得脆弱。

Method: 提出CodeGraphVLP层级框架：(1) 语义图维护部分可观测下的任务相关实体和关系；(2) 基于可执行代码的规划器在语义图上执行进度检查，输出子任务指令和子任务相关物体；(3) 利用上述输出构建去除杂乱的关键观测，聚焦VLA执行器。

Result: 在真实世界非马尔可夫任务中，CodeGraphVLP相比强VLA基线及其历史增强变体显著提升任务完成率，同时相比VLM-in-the-loop规划大幅降低规划延迟。

Conclusion: 持久化语义图和结构化规划是克服VLA模型在长时域操作中部分可观测性和杂乱干扰的关键，消融实验证实了各组件的贡献。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models promise generalist robot manipulation, but are typically trained and deployed as short-horizon policies that assume the latest observation is sufficient for action reasoning. This assumption breaks in non-Markovian long-horizon tasks, where task-relevant evidence can be occluded or appear only earlier in the trajectory, and where clutter and distractors make fine-grained visual grounding brittle. We present CodeGraphVLP, a hierarchical framework that enables reliable long-horizon manipulation by combining a persistent semantic-graph state with an executable code-based planner and progress-guided visual-language prompting. The semantic-graph maintains task-relevant entities and relations under partial observability. The synthesized planner executes over this semantic-graph to perform efficient progress checks and outputs a subtask instruction together with subtask-relevant objects. We use these outputs to construct clutter-suppressed observations that focus the VLA executor on critical evidence. On real-world non-Markovian tasks, CodeGraphVLP improves task completion over strong VLA baselines and history-enabled variants while substantially lowering planning latency compared to VLM-in-the-loop planning. We also conduct extensive ablation studies to confirm the contributions of each component.

</details>


### [444] [Robust Koopman Control Barrier Filters for Safe Actor-Critic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26452)
*Dhruv S. Kushwaha,Zoleikha A. Biron*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Robust Koopman-CBF SAC框架，通过数据驱动的Koopman预测器与CBF安全滤波器结合，在模型无关的强化学习中实现零约束违反，同时揭示了线性EDMD模型与一阶速度势垒在高维任务中的局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在模型无关的强化学习中，控制屏障函数（CBF）需要精确动力学和手工设计的屏障证书，限制了其应用；现有方法难以在无模型条件下同时保证任务性能与约束满足。

Method: 1）从数据中学习有限维Koopman预测器；2）在升维空间中构造仿射CBF约束，并通过二次规划安全层施加；3）利用投影残差边界收紧CBF条件以补偿Koopman近似误差；4）评论家在执行的安全动作上训练，演员则向Koopman-CBF可行集正则化。

Result: 在CartPole稳定与跟踪任务中实现零约束违反，回报匹配或超越无约束SAC；在Safety Gymnasium高维任务中减少部分违反，但暴露出线性EDMD模型和一阶速度势垒的局限性。

Conclusion: 鲁棒Koopman-CBF滤波器是连接模型无关RL与可证明安全的有前景桥梁，但有效性依赖于结构条件，高阶与多步Koopman-CBF扩展是未来方向。

Abstract: Safe reinforcement learning (RL) for robotic systems requires policies that improve task performance while satisfying state and input constraints during both training and deployment. Control barrier functions (CBFs) provide a principled mechanism for enforcing forward invariance through minimally invasive safety filters, but their use in model-free RL is limited by the need for accurate dynamics and hand-designed barrier certificates. We propose Robust Koopman-CBF SAC, a safety-filtered actor--critic framework that learns a finite-dimensional Koopman predictor from data, constructs affine CBF constraints in the lifted space, and enforces them through a quadratic-program safety layer. To account for finite-dimensional Koopman approximation error, the CBF condition is tightened using a projected residual margin estimated from held-out rollout data. The critic is trained on the executed safe action, while the actor is regularized toward the Koopman-CBF feasible set, reducing dependence on the filter over training. Across safe-control benchmarks, the method achieves zero constraint violations on CartPole stabilization and tracking while matching or exceeding unconstrained SAC returns. On high-dimensional Safety Gymnasium locomotion tasks, the method reduces violations in some settings but also exposes important limitations of first-order velocity barriers and linear EDMD models, motivating high-order and multi-step Koopman-CBF extensions. These results suggest that robust Koopman-CBF filters are a promising bridge between model-free RL and certifiable safety, while clarifying the structural conditions under which such filters remain effective.

</details>


### [445] [BORA: Bridging Offline Reinforcement Learning and Online Residual Adaptation for Real-World Dexterous VLA Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30226)
*Zhongxi Chen,Yifan Han,Yanming Shao,Huanming Liu,Congsheng Xu,Xiaoyu Chen,Yao Mu,Wenzhao Lian*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: BORA是一个面向真实世界灵巧操作VLA模型的离线到在线RL后训练框架，通过离线阶段构建动作条件价值引导的评论家、在线阶段引入轻量级人机协同残差适应机制，在5项灵巧任务上平均成功率提升33%，未见物体泛化提升43%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型在灵巧操作中面临高维手部控制和执行误差累积的挑战，而真实世界RL后训练虽能弥合视觉引导动作生成与物理可靠执行之间的差距，但高维灵巧探索会引发时间不一致性、样本低效和硬件风险。

Method: 离线阶段构建同时利用VLM认知token和动作块的评论家，实现动作条件价值引导；在线阶段冻结VLA基座，引入轻量级人机协同残差适应机制，结合干预驱动的奖励来纠正执行偏差。

Result: 在5项复杂真实世界灵巧任务中，标准设置下平均成功率绝对提升33%，未见物体泛化场景下提升43%。

Conclusion: BORA通过离线到在线的RL后训练框架有效解决了灵巧操作中的执行误差和物理适应问题，显著优于纯模仿学习和传统解耦RL基线。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for grounding visual-language understanding into real-world robotic manipulation. However, dexterous manipulation remains challenging for VLA policies due to high-dimensional hand control and compounding execution errors, which makes real-world RL post-training essential for bridging the gap between visually grounded action generation and physically reliable dexterous execution. However, high-dimensional dexterous exploration often triggers temporal inconsistency, sample inefficiency and hardware risks in the real world. To address these challenges, we propose BORA, an offline-to-online RL post-training framework designed for real-world dexterous VLA models. In the offline phase, BORA constructs a critic that takes both the VLM's cognition tokens and action chunks as inputs. This design enables action-conditioned value guidance, allowing the critic to evaluate dexterous hand motions beyond visual context alone. During the subsequent online phase, BORA freezes the VLA base and introduces a lightweight, Human-in-the-Loop (HiL) chunk-wise residual adaptation mechanism to mitigate real-world execution errors and further correct the offline-learned intents within the actual physical environment. By inheriting the offline critic and employing intervention-driven rewards, BORA effectively corrects execution discrepancies and adapts to real-world physical variances while preserving the pretrained policy as a stable prior. Extensive evaluations across five complex real-world dexterous tasks demonstrate that BORA significantly outperforms pure imitation learning and traditional decoupled RL baselines, achieving a 33% absolute increase in average success rate under standard settings and up to a 43% improvement in unseen object generalization.

</details>


### [446] [Continuous Reasoning for Vision-Language-Action](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00229)
*Yueh-Hua Wu,Tatsuya Matsushima,Kei Ota*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出连续推理（Continuous Reasoning）方法，用共享且可验证的连续潜变量替代自然语言作为VLA模型的推理媒介，在LIBERO-PRO和真实机器人任务上显著提升成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言与连续控制存在粒度不匹配：语言和子目标作用于任务级粒度，而VLA策略需要在更细的时间尺度上选择动作。一个推理步骤可能跨越多个动作块，与当前所需动作耦合弱。因此需要重新思考什么应充当VLA的"语言"角色。

Method: 1) 预测结构化的连续思维集作为连续推理；2) 将其作为共享上下文用于块结构动作生成；3) 将连续推理实例化为共享高斯潜变量接口；4) 使用自验证目标训练：指数移动平均教师模型必须成功消费学生的推理来预测目标动作。

Result: 在LIBERO-PRO上提升鲁棒性；在真实机器人上，TX-G2变体相比π0.5平均子任务成功率提升40.4%，HSR上提升26.3%。

Conclusion: VLA中的推理关键不在于增加额外token，而在于构建可共享、可验证的内部动作语言。

Abstract: Natural language is a powerful reasoning medium for language and vision-language models, but it is mismatched to the granularity of continuous control. Text and explicit subgoals operate at task-level granularity, whereas vision-language-action (VLA) policies must choose actions at a much finer temporal scale; a single reasoning step can therefore span many action chunks while remaining only weakly coupled to the action needed now. This suggests a different question for VLA: what should play the role of language? We argue that a useful VLA reasoning medium must be shareable across model instances, verifiable through downstream action improvement, and aligned with temporally extended control structure.
  Based on this view, we propose Continuous Reasoning for Vision-Language-Action. Our model first predicts continuous reasoning in the form of a structured set of continuous thoughts, then reuses them as shared context for chunk-structured action generation. Better action prediction alone does not certify good reasoning: if the same internal medium cannot be shared across model instances and independently verified through improved downstream control, the added latent may simply become a model-private shortcut that helps on seen behaviors without supporting generalizable control. We therefore instantiate continuous reasoning as a shared Gaussian latent interface and train it with a self-verification objective in which an exponential-moving-average teacher must successfully consume the student's reasoning when predicting target actions.
  Empirically, Continuous Reasoning improves LIBERO-PRO robustness and performs strongly on real robots, raising mean subtask success over π0.5 by 40.4% on TX-G2, an AgiBot G2-compatible variant, and 26.3% on HSR. This suggests that reasoning in VLA is less about extra tokens than about a shareable, verifiable internal language for action.

</details>


### [447] [ImagineUAV: Aerial Vision-Language Navigation via World-Action Modeling and Kinodynamic Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01205)
*Xuchen Liu,Jiawei Huang,Shihao Xia,Bingxi Liu,Jinqiang Cui,Jiankun Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了ImagineUAV框架，通过级联世界-动作建模（潜在视频扩散模型生成未来观测 + 动作提取器推断6-DoF运动 + 运动动力学规划器优化轨迹），解决无人机视觉-语言导航中VLA模型的几何不一致和动态不匹配问题，仅1.3B参数即在基准和真实飞行中超越先前方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型在无人机VLN任务中虽擅长语义推理，但因几何不一致性和动态不匹配导致脆弱性，现有方法缺乏对环境演化的显式建模。

Method: 1) 潜在视频扩散模型生成指令条件化的未来观测（想象环境演变）；2) 动作提取器从生成视频中推断6-DoF运动；3) 运动动力学规划器将估计优化为无碰撞轨迹；4) 步蒸馏推理管线实现实时执行。

Result: 仅1.3B参数，在VLN benchmarks和真实世界飞行中均优于先前的VLN和VLA基线方法。

Conclusion: 验证了想象驱动的空中导航范式的实用性，证明通过显式建模环境演变更能提升无人机在部分可观测条件下的导航鲁棒性。

Abstract: Vision-language navigation (VLN) for UAVs demands grounding free-form instructions into 6-DoF flight under partial observability. While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models excel at semantic reasoning, they suffer from brittleness due to geometric inconsistency and dynamics mismatch. To address this, we propose ImagineUAV, an imagination-driven framework leveraging cascaded world-action modeling. Instead of direct regression, ImagineUAV employs a latent video diffusion model to generate instruction-conditioned future observations, explicitly imagining environmental evolution, from which 6-DoF motions are inferred via an action extractor. A kinodynamic planner then refines these estimates into collision-free trajectories. Additionally, a step-distilled inference pipeline ensures real-time execution. With only 1.3B parameters, ImagineUAV outperforms prior VLN and VLA baselines on benchmarks and real-world flights, validating the practicality of imagination-driven aerial navigation.

</details>


### [448] [Crazyflow: An Accurate, GPU-Accelerated, Differentiable Drone Simulator in JAX](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01478)
*Martin Schuck,Marcel P. Rath,Yufei Hua,Abhishek Goudar,SiQi Zhou,Angela P. Schoellig*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Crazyflow是一个面向空中机器人算法开发的高性能仿真器，支持单机到大规模集群仿真（4000架×数千集群），速度比现有SOTA快一个数量级以上，支持解析梯度策略学习（亚厘米级轨迹跟踪）、采样避障（每秒超5亿步），甚至实现0.38秒内完成飞行中强化学习训练恢复策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有空中机器人仿真器虽然各自在保真度、可微分性、集群仿真等特定领域有所支持，但缺乏一个统一平台能够同时整合上述所有能力，从而限制了从基于模型到数据驱动、从梯度方法到采样方法、从单智能体到多智能体系统的全面算法开发。

Method: Crazyflow通过多层级仿真抽象设计实现精度、速度与可微分性的协同提升；提供轻量级系统辨识流程，兼容所有开源Crazyflie模型，支持快速重配置自定义无人机平台；打破传统"训练-部署"范式，利用极端仿真速度实现在线飞行中强化学习。

Result: 单无人机仿真速度比现有SOTA快一个数量级以上；可模拟4000架无人机组成的数千个集群；实现亚厘米级轨迹跟踪精度（无需域随机化）；采样避障速度超5亿步/秒；0.38秒内完成无人机空中抛掷后的恢复策略训练并成功稳定无人机。

Conclusion: Crazyflow通过同时提升精度、速度和可微分性，为合成数据生成提供开源资源，其大规模并行化能力支持在线执行中的学习与优化，为新型算法开发开辟了新路径。

Abstract: High-quality, large-scale synthetic data from simulations is becoming a cornerstone for pushing the capabilities of robot algorithms. While aerial robotics simulators have evolved to support specialized needs such as fidelity, differentiability, and swarms independently, a unified platform that can synthesize data across all these domains is missing. In this work, we propose Crazyflow, a simulator designed to push the limits of aerial-robotics algorithm development, from model-based to data-driven methods, gradient-based to sampling-based approaches, and single-agent to multi-agent systems. Compared to existing state-of-the-art drone simulators, it achieves speeds more than an order of magnitude faster for a single drone and can simulate thousands of swarms of 4000 drones each. Real-world experiments show Crazyflow supports both analytical-gradient-based policy learning, achieving sub-centimeter trajectory tracking accuracy without domain randomization, and sampling-based obstacle avoidance at speeds exceeding half a billion steps per second. Breaking the traditional train-then-deploy paradigm, we show that its unprecedented speed even enables in-flight reinforcement learning; we demonstrate this by throwing a physical drone into the air and training a recovery policy from scratch in 0.38 seconds, successfully stabilizing the drone. Crazyflow supports multiple levels of simulation abstraction, is directly compatible with all open-source Crazyflie models, and enables rapid reconfiguration across custom drone platforms and applications by providing a light-weight system identification pipeline. By pushing accuracy, speed, and differentiability simultaneously, Crazyflow serves as an open-source resource for synthetic data generation, with emerging capabilities for large-scale parallelization for online, in-execution learning and optimization, opening the door to novel algorithm development.

</details>


### [449] [Dexterity-BEV: Aligning 3D World and Actions for Generalizable Robot Policies Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02274)
*Huayi Zhou,Wei Gao,Dekun Lu,Ruiji Liu,Zhanqi Zhang,Ziyang Zhang,Jian Chen,Wenlve Zhou,Sheng Xu,Shumin Li,Kangyi Guo,Shichen Xu,Zixin Huang,Yongyi Su,Kui Jia*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Dex-BEV，通过引入对齐顶点图和顶点频谱作为3D表示，结合BEV对齐框架，解决端到端操作策略中2D基础模型缺乏3D感知和空间对齐的问题，提升机器人灵巧操作的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有端到端操作策略结合大规模预训练VLM虽然展现出通用灵巧操作的潜力，但继承了2D基础模型的两个关键局限性：1）依赖2D RGB输入，忽视了操作的固有3D特性；2）输入输出空间以及跨不同机器人形态、相机设置和轨迹数据集缺乏空间3D对齐。

Method: 1）引入对齐顶点图和顶点频谱——一种像素级3D表示，通过相机标定和可选深度将2D视觉输入提升到3D；2）通过将每个相机视图和机器人动作的逐像素3D信息表达到一个共享坐标系，对齐操作策略的输入和输出；3）设计规范BEV对齐帧，构建BEV图像，产生对相机位姿变化鲁棒的视角不变表示；4）开发数据处理流水线和对齐方案，包括跨不同机器人、人类操作员和数据集的时空对齐。

Result: 这些贡献共同缓解了输入和输出的时空对齐问题，提高了真实世界操作的一致性和泛化能力。

Conclusion: 通过统一的3D表示和BEV对齐框架，有效弥合了2D VLM与3D操作之间的鸿沟，为跨不同机器人形态和相机设置的通用灵巧操作提供了可行的解决方案。

Abstract: End-to-end manipulation policies, combined with web-scale pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs), show the promise for generalizable and dexterous robotic manipulation. However, they inherit two key limitations from 2D foundation models: 1) the reliance on 2D RGB inputs that ignores the intrinsically 3D nature of manipulation; and 2) the lack of spatial 3D alignment between input-output spaces as well as across diverse robot embodiments, camera setups, and trajectory datasets. In this paper, we present a series of contributions to address these issues. First, we introduce aligned vertex map and vertex spectrum -- a pixel-wise 3D representation that elevates 2D visual inputs to 3D, using camera calibration and optional depth. This novel input representation marries 3D awareness with the generalization of 2D large VLMs. Then, we propose to align the inputs and outputs of manipulation policies by expressing per-pixel 3D information of each camera view and robot actions to a shared coordinate. Based on this, we designate a canonical Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) alignment frame and innovatively propose to construct BEV images, producing a view-invariant representation robust to camera pose variations. To enable training and evaluation at scale, we develop a comprehensive data processing pipeline to perform such alignments; we also introduce a novel temporal alignment scheme for trajectories across diverse robots, human operators, and datasets. These contributions collectively mitigate input and output spatial-temporal misalignments, improving the consistency and generalization for real-world manipulation. Pretrained checkpoint, source code and data processing pipeline are available in https://hnuzhy.github.io/projects/Dex-BEV.

</details>


### [450] [IMAC-AgriVLN: Can Agricultural Vision-and-Language Navigation Agents be Aware of Instruction Mistakes?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02519)
*Xiaobei Zhao,Xingqi Lyu,Xin Chen,Xiang Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出A2A-MI基准测试，针对农业VLN任务中指令可能包含错误的问题，构建了半自动数据标注器在原始指令中插入三类错误。实验发现现有模型在错误指令下性能大幅下降（SR下降57%，NE下降9%），为此提出IMAC模块，通过分析指令与当前前方图像来检测并尝试修正指令错误，显著提升了模型在错误指令下的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有农业VLN方法都假设给定的自然语言指令本身是正确的，但这不符合实际场景，因为任何人都有可能说出带有错误的指令。为了弥合这一差距，需要研究如何在指令存在错误的情况下仍能完成农业导航任务。

Method: 1) 构建A2A-MI基准：设计半自动数据标注器，以多样化且高效的方式在每条原始指令中插入三类错误（错误分类）。2) 提出IMAC模块：分析当前指令与机器人前方图像的匹配程度，判断指令是否存在错误，并在必要时尝试纠正错误，然后将纠正后的指令用于导航。

Result: 在A2A-MI基准上测试多个SOTA农业VLN智能体，性能显著下降（SR下降57%，NE下降9%）。将IMAC模块集成到基线模型后，观察到明显改进，有效缩小了与无错误指令场景下的性能差距。

Conclusion: 农业VLN智能体倾向于假设指令正确，缺乏在场景与指令不一致时产生怀疑的意识。IMAC模块通过引入指令错误检测与纠正机制，能够有效提升模型在现实场景中面对错误指令的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Agricultural robots are serving as powerful assistants across a wide range of agricultural tasks, nevertheless, still heavily relying on manual operations or railway systems for movement. The AgriVLN method and the A2A benchmark pioneeringly extended Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) to the agricultural domain, enabling a robot to navigate to a target position following a natural language instruction. However, almost all the prior methods adopt an ideal assumption that the given instructions themselves are correct, which does not align with the realistic scenarios, because anybody may say an instruction with mistakes. To bridge this gap, we propose the A2A-MI benchmark, in which we build a semi-automatic data annotator to insert three mistake classifications into each original instruction in a more diversified and efficient way. We test several state-of-the-art agricultural VLN agents on it and observe a sufficient drop with -57% on SR and -9% on NE, from which we suggest that an agricultural VLN agent tends to assume that the given instruction is correct, so does not have the awareness to doubt it when the scenes it sees do not align with the instruction it receives. To build the awareness on instruction mistake, we propose the IMAC module analyzing the instruction and the current front-facing image, to judge whether the instruction has mistakes and attempt to correct it when needed. We integrate IMAC into the baseline model, and observe a noteworthy improvement, sufficiently narrowing the gap to the performance on instructions without mistakes. Project: https://github.com/AlexTraveling/IMAC-AgriVLN.

</details>


### [451] [See Less, Specify More: Visual Evidence Budgets for Generalizable VLAs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02735)
*Yueh-Hua Wu,Tatsuya Matsushima,Kei Ota*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: S2（See Less, Specify More）是一个提升VLA模型泛化能力的框架，通过为执行器提供更精细的轨迹级语言指令和显式的视觉证据预算机制，在8个真实机器人任务上将平均子任务成功率从54.2%提升到79.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型在泛化方面存在瓶颈，特别是在干扰物、外观变化和语义相似任务下，策略需要从粗粒度指令中推断局部执行细节，同时决定图像中哪些部分对控制重要。现有方法缺乏对执行器的有效引导。

Method: S2框架包含两个核心设计：1) Specify More - 保留原始指令作为稳定高层目标，同时将每条轨迹重新标注为细粒度的轨迹级和子任务级语言，消除当前执行模式的歧义；2) See Less - 引入显式视觉证据预算机制，训练执行器仅依靠任务充分的证据行动，无需任何区域或掩码标注。

Result: 在AgiBot G2兼容变体TX-G2和HSR上的8个真实机器人任务中，S2将平均子任务成功率从pi0.5基线的54.2%提升至79.0%。消融实验表明：粗粒度指令会导致可避免的监督混叠，保持目标一致的局部引导优于指令替换，显式证据预算可减少对广泛视觉上下文的依赖。

Conclusion: VLA泛化能力的提升关键在于让执行器在信息丰富的局部引导和任务充分的视觉证据下进行训练，而非从弱监督中同时恢复两者。

Abstract: Generalization remains a central bottleneck for vision-language-action (VLA) models: under distractors, appearance shifts, and semantically similar tasks, the policy must often infer local execution details from coarse instructions while also deciding which parts of the image matter for control. We present S2 (See Less, Specify More), a framework for improving VLA generalization by training the executor under a cleaner interface.
  Specify More preserves the original instruction as a stable high-level goal while relabeling each trajectory into refined trajectory- and subtask-level language that disambiguates the current execution mode. Unlike native attention, See Less imposes an explicit visual evidence budget, training the executor to act from task-sufficient evidence rather than unconstrained visual context, without any region or mask annotation.
  This interface lets the executor follow detailed guidance without relying on distracting visual patches or resolving avoidable ambiguity on its own, and it remains compatible with off-the-shelf VLM planners through in-context learning. Across our main evaluation settings, S2 improves overall generalization metrics by changing the executor's learning problem: coarse instructions induce avoidable supervision aliasing, goal-preserving local guidance outperforms instruction replacement in our main ablations, and explicit evidence budgeting reduces dependence on broad visual context beyond efficiency considerations.
  Across eight real-robot tasks on TX-G2 (an AgiBot G2-compatible variant) and HSR, S2 raises mean subtask success from 54.2% to 79.0% over pi0.5. Together, these results suggest that VLA generalization improves when the executor is trained to act from informative local guidance and task-sufficient visual evidence, rather than recovering both from weak supervision.

</details>


### [452] [Worth Remembering: Surprise-Gated Robot Episodic Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03787)
*Nicolas Gorlo,Derek K. Wise,Alberto Speranzon,Luca Carlone*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出利用贝叶斯惊讶（Bayesian surprise）作为门控机制，在V-JEPA-2潜在空间中选择性存储高实用性过去事件，以增强机器人长期记忆，在问答和事件分割任务上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用型机器人需要将指令与过去的经验关联，但存储所有历史事件不现实，因此需要选择性记忆机制来保留对未来任务有用的信息，而未来任务通常无法预先知晓。

Method: 使用贝叶斯惊讶作为记忆形成的门控机制，在V-JEPA-2提供的语义丰富且部署无关的潜在空间中计算惊讶值，将门控情景记忆与4D场景图空间记忆相结合。

Result: 在机器人问答任务中，对时间、空间和二元问题的准确率比现有方法提高≥12%；在事件分割任务中，无监督因果关系方法超越了监督和非因果方法。

Conclusion: 贝叶斯惊讶作为门控机制能有效选择高实用性记忆，提升机器人在通用任务中的表现，为长期机器人记忆管理提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Robots solving generalist tasks need to be able to ground instructions in their past experience, since humans may refer to notable past events when giving a task (e.g., ``Take me to where the chemical spill happened yesterday''). Since memory limits make storing all past events infeasible, long-term robot memory must be selective, ideally retaining only those episodes with high utility for future tasks. However, future tasks are not typically given a priori for generalist robots. To select generically useful memories, we propose Bayesian surprise as a gating mechanism for memory formation. We present an approach to compute surprise in a semantically rich deployment-agnostic latent space provided by V-JEPA-2. Using our gated episodic memory to augment 4D scene graph-based spatial memory, we show a consistent improvement over state-of-the-art benchmarks in robot question answering, outperforming prior robot memory methods by $\geq12\%$ for temporal, spatial, and binary questions, and surpassing the performance of supervised and non-causal methods with an unsupervised causal method in event segmentation tasks.

</details>


### [453] [RealDexUMI: A Wearable Universal Manipulation Interface for Dexterous Robot Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06033)
*Chaoyi Xu,Yixuan Jiang,Jiahui Huan,Yuhui Fu,Haoyu Zhou,Weitian Yuan,Jiayi Yu,Wanpeng Zhang,Haoqi Yuan,Zongqing Lu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: RealDexUMI 提出了一种基于可穿戴通用操作接口的灵巧操作数据收集与部署框架，通过共享末端执行器模块（轻量级灵巧手、手部视觉、指尖触觉）和同态遥操作手套，实现无重定向、零间隙的数据收集，在8个真实机器人任务上达到88.75%的平均成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有灵巧操作数据收集方法要么通过重定向或具身转换损失了可部署的灵巧性，要么依赖成本高昂、缺乏直观接触感知的机器人专用遥操作，难以规模化扩展。

Method: 提出RealDexUMI框架：1）共享灵巧末端执行器模块，包含轻量级灵巧手、手部视觉和指尖触觉传感；2）手掌侧同态遥操作手套，将人类手指输入直接映射为机器人手关节命令，无需重定向；3）共享手和传感模块实现收集与部署间零间隙的末端执行器数据（手部观测、触觉信号、接触、手部动作完全匹配）。

Result: 在8个真实机器人任务（涵盖精细操作、接触丰富、长时域、双臂操作）上，基于RealDexUMI数据训练的策略平均成功率达88.75%，能泛化到未见过的初始位姿，并可在三种不同本体间迁移。

Conclusion: RealDexUMI通过可穿戴同态遥操作和共享感知-执行模块，实现了直观、精准、低成本、可扩展的灵巧操作数据收集与策略部署，有效弥合了数据收集与部署之间的鸿沟。

Abstract: Learning dexterous manipulation requires demonstrations that preserve fine hand-object interactions while remaining executable at deployment. Existing pipelines either lose deployable dexterity through retargeting or embodiment conversion, or rely on robot-specific teleoperation that is costly to scale and often lacks intuitive, contact-aware control for dexterous data collection. We present RealDexUMI, a wearable universal manipulation interface built around a shared dexterous end-effector module that integrates a lightweight dexterous hand, in-hand vision, and fingertip tactile sensing. A palm-side isomorphic teleoperation glove maps human finger inputs to robot-hand joint commands, enabling real-time, retargeting-free, intuitive, and precise hand control. The shared hand and sensing modules yield zero-gap end-effector data, with matched in-hand observations, tactile signals, contacts, and hand actions between collection and deployment. Across eight real-robot tasks spanning fine-grained, contact-rich, long-horizon, and bimanual manipulation, policies trained on RealDexUMI data achieve an average success rate of 88.75%, generalize to unseen initial poses, and transfer across three embodiments. Website: https://research.beingbeyond.com/realdexumi

</details>


### [454] [HANDOFF: Humanoid Agentic Task-Space Whole-Body Control via Distilled Complementary Teachers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06493)
*Lizhi Yang,Junheng Li,Nehar Poddar,Yiling Hou,Gio Huh,Robert Griffin,Georgia Gkioxari,Aaron Ames*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出HANDOFF，一种基于紧凑显式接口的人形机器人全身控制器，通过多教师KL蒸馏和混合专家架构，在Unitree G1上实现了与SOTA匹配的速度跟踪和最大的鲁棒操作工作空间，并支持基于自然语言的任务执行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有全身控制器通常需要任务规划器难以从任务语义中合成的稠密运动学或空间参考，因此需要一种更紧凑、直观、通用且表达力强的命令空间接口，以弥合任务规划与全身控制之间的鸿沟。

Method: 提出紧凑显式接口作为命令空间；采用多教师KL蒸馏，在上下文条件门控机制下将三个互补专家（全身运动跟踪+安全滤波数据、 locomotion、跌倒恢复）蒸馏为混合专家学生模型。

Result: 在Unitree G1上，HANDOFF匹配了SOTA的速度跟踪性能，并提供了当前最大的鲁棒操作工作空间之一；通过VLM驱动的智能体规划器，无需任务特定数据或控制器微调即可完成多自然语言驱动任务。

Conclusion: 所提出的紧凑接口和蒸馏框架能够有效弥合任务规划与全身控制之间的鸿沟，实现通用、模块化的全身控制，并支持零样本的自然语言任务泛化。

Abstract: For a humanoid robot to be deployed in the real world, the choice of command space (i.e., the interface between task planning and whole-body control) is crucial. Existing whole-body controllers typically demand dense kinematic or spatial references that planners struggle to synthesize from task semantics. We instead propose a compact, explicit interface that is intuitive, general, modular, and expressive enough for diverse loco-manipulation skills. To this end, we introduce HANDOFF, a single humanoid whole-body controller that follows this interface and is distilled via multi-teacher KL distillation under a context-conditioned gating scheme into a mixture-of-experts student from three complementary specialists: whole-body motion tracking with safety-filtered data, locomotion, and fall-recovery. On the Unitree G1, HANDOFF matches state-of-the-art velocity tracking and offers one of the largest robust manipulation workspaces. We further demonstrate hardware feasibility through multiple natural-language-driven task roll-outs, powered by a VLM-driven agentic planner with no task-specific data or controller fine-tuning.

</details>


### [455] [QuadVerse: An Integrated Framework Aligning Visual-Physical Reality for Quadruped Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07118)
*Yuxiang Chen,Yuanhao Wang,Ziheng Zhang,Meng Zhang,Yu Liu,Yufei Jia,Tiancai Wang,Erjin Zhou,Jin Xie*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: QuadVerse是一个集成框架，通过重建场景作为校准基底，统一对齐视觉感知、物理交互和驱动动力学，从而缩小sim-to-real差距。它利用3D高斯泼溅重建场景进行视觉校准，通过网格提取初始化摩擦先验进行接触校准，并训练残差动力学补偿器减少执行器差异，实现了零样本视觉导航策略部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的sim-to-real方法通常单独处理视觉或动力学差异，忽视了这些个体不匹配在机器人状态演化过程中积累和传播的问题。

Method: 1) 从RGB视频重建几何约束的3D高斯泼溅场景，支持批处理逼真渲染和碰撞感知语义网格提取；2) 通过网格初始化空间变化的摩擦先验，并基于轨迹后验搜索进行接触校准；3) 在接触校准地形上回放真实轨迹，训练残差动力学补偿器以解耦接触误差与执行器非理想性。

Result: QuadVerse在重建质量和运动跟踪上优于相关基线，并实现了无需任务特定真实世界数据收集的零样本视觉导航策略部署。

Conclusion: 通过统一的场景校准框架，可以有效弥合sim-to-real差距，显著提升机器人策略的迁移效果和零样本部署能力。

Abstract: Simulation is central to robot learning, yet the sim-to-real gap remains a major bottleneck. Existing approaches often tackle visual or dynamic gaps separately, overlooking how these individual mismatches accumulate and propagate throughout the robot's state evolution. In this paper, we introduce QuadVerse, an integrated framework that uses reconstructed scenes as a calibration substrate for aligning visual perception, physical interaction, and actuator dynamics. From captured RGB videos, we reconstruct geometry-constrained 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes that support batched photorealistic ego-view rendering and collision-ready semantic mesh extraction. The meshes further enable contact calibration by initializing spatially varying friction priors and refining them through trajectory-based posterior search. To address remaining actuator discrepancies, QuadVerse trains a residual dynamics compensator by replaying real-world trajectories on the contact-calibrated terrain, reducing the entanglement between terrain-induced contact errors and actuator non-idealities. Experiments show that QuadVerse improves reconstruction quality and locomotion tracking over relevant baselines. Leveraging this foundation, we demonstrate robust zero-shot visual-navigation policy deployment without task-specific real-world rollouts.

</details>

# cs.CY [[Back]](#toc)

### [456] [Beware of GeeksBearing Gifts: Building True EU Frontier AI Sovereignty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07536)
*Nick Moës,Toni Lorente,Amin Oueslati,Jonathan Smith,Robin Staes-Polet,Radina Kraeva*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个连接五大主权支柱与前沿AI堆栈五层分解的统一框架，用于识别欧盟在AI领域的战略自主性缺口、冗余和权衡，并对92项政策倡议进行了分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 欧盟在前沿AI领域存在结构性依赖（模型、算力、数据中心均高度依赖美中），现有政策碎片化且缺乏凝聚性愿景，亟需一个系统化框架来评估和指导实现战略自主的政策干预。

Method: 提出了一个统一框架，将五大主权支柱（经济竞争力、韧性、安全与国防、欧洲价值观、外交关系）与前沿AI堆栈的五层分解（包括26个组件和29个子组件）相结合，以此识别关键缺口、冗余和跨支柱权衡，并分析92项欧盟委员会通信中的倡议。

Result: 运用该框架分析了AI Gigafactory Initiative，揭示了狭义经济框架所遮蔽的主权冲突；识别了欧盟现有政策中的关键缺口、冗余和跨支柱权衡。

Conclusion: 该框架为政策制定者提供了一个结构化基础，用于在设计、评估和优先排序前沿AI干预措施时，综合考虑欧洲战略自主的多个维度。

Abstract: Frontier artificial intelligence is reshaping all aspects of society, from economic output or military capability to democratic institutions. The EU is entering this transformation from a position of structural dependence: frontier models originate almost exclusively from the United States or China, the US holds approximately sixteen times the EU's AI supercomputing capacity, and only 15% of global hyperscale data centre capacity resides within EU borders. Although the European Commission has accelerated its policy response, existing initiatives remain fragmented and lack a cohesive vision for securing strategic autonomy across the full frontier AI value chain. Here we propose a unified framework connecting five sovereignty pillars (economic competitiveness, resilience, security and defence, European values, and foreign relations) to a decomposition of the frontier AI stack comprising five layers, 26 components, and 29 sub-components. This framework allows the identification of critical gaps, redundancies, and inter-pillar trade-offs that current EU policy leaves implicit. Our analysis of the AI Gigafactory Initiative illustrates how a sovereignty-centred lens reveals conflicts that narrowly economic framings obscure. Moreover, this framework offers policymakers a structured basis for designing, evaluating, and prioritising frontier AI interventions across multiple dimensions of European strategic autonomy across the 92 initiatives from four major Commission communications we. identify, and beyond.

</details>


### [457] [Prompt Governance? On Governing Technologies Governed by Natural Language](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07539)
*Anna Neumann,Holli Sargeant,Jatinder Singh*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了系统级指令（如系统提示）作为生成式AI治理工具的有效性，发现文献中存在矛盾主张，政策制定者将其视为稳定控制机制，但实际效果在不同语境下不可靠，提示了通过自然语言治理AI的局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 政策制定者和监管者开始将系统级指令视为可干预的GenAI控制点，但这些指令能否在不同语境下可靠且可预测地运行以支持治理框架，尚未得到充分探索。

Method: 系统评估了三方面：(i)文献中研究者如何讨论和处理系统级指令；(ii)政策制定者如何将系统级指令定位为治理对象，包括分析美国反觉醒AI行政令和欧盟通用AI实践准则；(iii)上述视角之间的错位是否需要更仔细审视通过自然语言治理AI的可行性。

Result: 识别出文献中存在碎片化且相互矛盾的主张，并将其提炼为类型学；揭示了不同主张如何使将系统级指令视为稳定、可解释控制机制的政策方法复杂化。

Conclusion: 鉴于这些错位，必须谨慎考虑提示治理方法。研究结果具有广泛影响，从LLM政策语境扩展到自然语言作为技术系统控制机制的更一般性应用。

Abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is increasingly operated by natural language instructions (prompts). Across the pipeline, stakeholders designate various forms, e.g. end-user guidelines, developer specifications, or system prompts, as prompt governance instruments. These textual artifacts are intended to shape model behaviour by specifying constraints, priorities, and compliance rules. Policymakers and regulators have begun to treat system-level instructions as accessible prompt-based GenAI intervention points, assuming they function (directly or indirectly) as behavioural control. Yet whether these instructions operate reliably and predictably enough across contexts to support such governance frameworks remains underexplored. Towards this, we systematically evaluate (i) how researchers discuss and treat system-level instructions in the literature, focusing on large language models (LLMs) as they isolate language effects; (ii) how policymakers position system-level instructions as governance objects, incorporating analysis of two policy frameworks (US Exec. Order on Preventing Woke AI, and EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice); and (iii) whether misalignments between these perspectives warrant closer inspection of the viability of governing AI through natural language. We identify a fragmented literature advancing varying and contradictory claims about what goals system-level instructions can achieve, which we distil into a typology of claims. Further, we show how divergent claims complicate policy approaches that treat system-level instructions as stable, interpretable control mechanisms. We argue that given such misalignments, careful consideration must be given to prompt governance approaches. Our findings have broad implications, extending from a LLM policy context to the use of natural language as control mechanism in technical systems more generally.

</details>


### [458] [DIYHealth Suite: Dataset, Model, and Benchmark for Health Management at Home](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07542)
*Changshuo Liu,Junran Wu,Zhongle Xie,Wenqiao Zhang,Kaiping Zheng,Jiaqi Zhu,Qingpeng Cai,Ooi Gene Anne,Marcus Chun Jin Tan,Jianwei Yin,James Wei Luen Yip,Beng Chin Ooi*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出DIYHealth Suite框架，包含DIYHealth-900K多模态数据集、DIYHealthGPT自适应基础模型（采用Hybrid Hyper Low-Rank Adaptation技术）和DIYHealthBench基准，用于解决家庭DIY健康管理中的异质数据、任务适应性及统一评估三大挑战，在11项家庭护理任务上取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI在医疗领域的应用多依赖医院级设备，限制了其在家庭场景的可及性。随着便携设备和远程医疗普及，医疗正向家庭DIY诊断模式转变，但面临家庭数据异质且缺乏标准数据集、模型需适应可变任务和个人健康状况、以及缺乏统一评估基准三大挑战。

Method: 构建了DIYHealth-900K大规模多模态数据集以覆盖真实家庭护理场景；提出了DIYHealthGPT自适应基础模型，核心创新为Hybrid Hyper Low-Rank Adaptation（混合超低秩自适应）技术；建立了DIYHealthBench基准用于系统评估基础模型在家庭护理任务上的表现。

Result: 在11项家庭护理任务的开放问答和封闭问答两种设定下，DIYHealthGPT相较于通用基线模型和医学专用基线模型均取得了最先进的性能。

Conclusion: DIYHealth Suite为下一代个性化家庭健康管理奠定了基础，有效解决了家庭DIY医疗场景中的数据、模型和评估三大核心挑战。

Abstract: Generative AI is reshaping healthcare, yet most existing advances rely on hospital-grade devices, which limits their accessibility and potential for health management outside clinical settings. With the proliferation of portable devices and telemedicine, healthcare is shifting toward home-based Diagnosis-It-Yourself (DIY) care. Despite this promise, several distinctive challenges remain: (i) home-collected data are heterogeneous, exacerbated by the absence of standardized large-scale datasets; (ii) models require adaptation to variable task demands and evolving individual conditions; (iii) the broad spectrum of home care tasks lacks a unified benchmark for systematic evaluation. In this paper, we present DIYHealth Suite, a comprehensive framework designed to address these challenges through a tailored dataset, model, and benchmark. We first curate DIYHealth-900K, a large-scale multimodal dataset capturing diverse real-world home care scenarios. Building on this, we propose DIYHealthGPT, an adaptive foundation model for home-based health management, powered by the novel Hybrid Hyper Low-Rank Adaptation technique. Finally, we establish DIYHealthBench, the first benchmark to evaluate foundation models on home care tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DIYHealthGPT delivers state-of-the-art performance over both general-purpose and medical-specific baselines on 11 home care tasks in both open-QA and closed-QA settings, laying the groundwork for the next generation of personalized health management at home.

</details>


### [459] [Concerns and Strategic Responses of Older Workers Navigating Generative AI in Bridge Employment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07543)
*Aditya Nayak,Aakash Gautam,Rama Adithya Varanasi*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究通过对21名专业人士的深度半结构化访谈，探讨了老年工作者（OWs）在过渡性就业阶段如何应对生成式AI（GenAI）带来的颠覆性影响。研究发现，GenAI在过渡性就业决策的各个阶段造成了时间性和结构性颠覆，老年工作者通过不同形式的边界工作重新配置任务，以恢复稳定性和连续性。本文将这种应对机制概念化为"AI韧性"，它使过渡性就业决策演变为一个持续的协商与适应过程。最后，研究提出通过平衡个体层面的AI韧性策略、中观层面的AI韧性集体以及宏观层面的对抗性和可争议的AI中介组织结构，来减少老年工作者的职业倦怠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GenAI正快速改变职场环境，对弱势群体（包括通过过渡性就业重返职场的老年工作者）造成不成比例的影响。然而，目前缺乏对老年工作者如何在GenAI颠覆下应对变化并做出过渡性就业决策的深入理解。

Method: 采用定性研究方法，对21名专业人士进行深度半结构化访谈，分析老年工作者如何应对GenAI驱动的颠覆并追求过渡性就业角色。

Result: 老年工作者在过渡性就业决策的所有阶段都经历了GenAI带来的时间性和结构性颠覆；他们通过不同形式的边界工作重新配置任务以恢复稳定性和连续性；这种应对机制被概念化为"AI韧性"；过渡性就业决策演变为持续的协商与适应过程。

Conclusion: 为减少老年工作者的职业倦怠，需要在个体层面的AI韧性策略、中观层面的AI韧性集体以及宏观层面的对抗性和可争议的AI中介组织结构之间取得平衡。

Abstract: Generative AI (GenAI) is transforming workplaces at a rapid pace. This disproportionately affects vulnerable communities, including older workers (OWs) who re-enter the workforce through bridge employment prior to final retirement. Through in-depth semi-structured interviews with 21 professionals, we examine how OWs navigate GenAI-driven disruptions while pursuing bridge roles, focusing on their concerns about GenAI integration and their responses to these changes. Our findings show that OWs experienced both temporal and structural disruptions across all stages of the bridge employment decision-making process due to GenAI. In response, they reconfigured their tasks through different forms of boundary work aimed at restoring stability and continuity. We conceptualize these responses as AI resilience, which reshaped OWs' bridge employment decision-making into an ongoing process of negotiation and adaptation. We conclude by offering recommendations to reduce burnout among OWs by balancing individual-level AI resilience strategies with meso-level AI resilience collectives and macro-level adversarial and contestable AI-mediated organizational structures.

</details>


### [460] [AI-Integrated Learning Management System for Middle School: A Longitudinal Study of Learning Outcomes Through High School and Beyond](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07544)
*Misan Paul Etchie,Taiwo Olutosin*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向初中生的AI集成学习管理系统，通过策略控制的AI辅助（ formative反馈、间隔复习、自适应练习）和教师仪表盘，在保护隐私的前提下提供及时教学支持，并设计纵向研究评估其对高中及后续教育路径的长期影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 初中是核心学业技能和学习习惯形成的关键期，但现有学习管理系统（LMS）仅是工作流工具而非教学支持工具，导致学生带着困惑持续练习、教师被动答疑，反馈延迟使得误解固化，需要一种能提供及时、持续AI支持的解决方案。

Method: 设计AI集成LMS平台，包含：策略控制的AI辅助（ formative反馈与提示）、基于掌握度的间隔复习与自适应练习推荐、面向教师的误解模式总结与持续困难标记仪表盘；采用隐私优先设计（数据最小化、角色访问控制、年龄适宜响应约束、可审计日志）；配套纵向研究设计，链接细粒度学习轨迹与制度性结果。

Result: 预期成果包括：短期上提升学习效果，长期上通过纵向追踪区分工具采纳效应与学习轨迹的长期变化，揭示AI辅助对高中及后高中阶段教育路径的影响。

Conclusion: 通过政策约束的AI辅助与隐私保护设计相结合，AI集成LMS有望改变初中教学中反馈延迟的瓶颈问题，为评估AI在教育中的长期影响提供方法论框架。

Abstract: Middle school is a key window for building core academic skills and the learning routines students carry into later grades, yet many students still fall behind because help is often limited and comes too late, after they have already been stuck for a while. Learning Management Systems (LMSs) are now standard infrastructure for distributing materials, collecting work, assessing students' tasks, and recording grades, but in most deployments they still behave more like workflow tools than instructional supports. The result is the usual bottleneck: students keep practicing through confusion, teachers triage questions, and feedback that could have corrected the misunderstanding arrives after the misconception has already hardened. To address this gap, we propose an AI-integrated LMS for middle school instruction, paired with a longitudinal study design to test whether sustained, bounded AI support changes outcomes through high school and into post-high school pathways. The proposed platform adds policy-gated AI assistance to everyday coursework, delivering formative feedback and hinting, recommending spaced review and adaptive practice based on mastery, and providing teacher-facing dashboards that summarize misconception patterns and flag sustained struggle. Because the platform is intended for minors, the design is privacy-first, using data minimization, role-based access control, age-appropriate response constraints, and auditable logs of AI interactions. Beyond short-term performance, the evaluation plan links fine-grained learning traces (attempts, revisions, help-seeking, and pacing) to institutional outcomes where feasible, so we can separate tool adoption effects from longer-run changes in learning trajectories.

</details>


### [461] [Reshaping Undergraduate Computer Science Education in the Generative AI Era](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07545)
*Yi-Chieh Lee,Nattapat Boonprakong,Yugin Tan,Harold Soh,Alex Potanin,Viraj Kumar,Anoop K. Sinha,Chen Qian,Paul Denny,Mennatallah El-Assady,Ian Oakley,Jake Renzella,Amy Zhang,Jat Singh,Wee Sun Lee,Hsuan-Tien Lin,Jane L. E,Anthony Tang,Margaret M. Burnett,Sowmya Somanath,Renwen Zhang,Vicky Charisi,Alexandra I. Cristea*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 随着生成式AI自动化了许多传统软件工程任务，计算机科学本科教育应转向强调理解与验证AI生成产物，重点培养系统设计、抽象和批判性评估能力。本文基于两届NUS-Google国际研讨会，提出了课程改革的战略建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI正在自动化实现级编程、调试、测试等传统CS教育的核心技能，使现有的课程框架难以为继，亟需重新思考CS本科教育的定位和内容。

Method: 通过在新加坡举办两届NUS-Google国际研讨会，召集教职人员、行业从业者和学生共同研讨，基于研讨发现提出战略性课程改革方案。

Result: 识别出必须保留的关键技能和重要性下降的技能；提出了通过"面包屑"策略在当前课程中嵌入引导性练习；明确了课程重心应向系统设计、抽象和批判性评估转移。

Conclusion: CS教育改革应通过培养AI原生能力、重构基础教育的核心、增强高级学习路径、采纳新教学法以及转变制度支持来推进，以确保毕业生能够有效创建、解决问题、管理并与AI协同创作。

Abstract: Generative AI represents a turning point for Computer Science (CS) education. In recent decades, post-secondary CS education has largely focused on what has been seen as practical software engineering skills: implementation-level programming, debugging, testing, and software design, analysis, and documentation. However, this framing is becoming less tenable as generative AI automates many of these tasks, challenging their centrality in CS education.
  To keep pace with advances in AI technology, CS curricula should consider a shift toward understanding and verifying AI-generated artifacts. This white paper outlines the findings of two international NUS-Google Workshops in Singapore, where we convened faculty members, industry practitioners, and students, and proposes a strategic response to reshape how CS should be taught at the undergraduate level. Based on the findings, we identify critical skills that must be preserved and those that are becoming less important. By incorporating these skills as "breadcrumbs," we can provide helpful nudges and engaging exercises within the current curriculum, enhancing learning experiences for everyone.
  We believe that to effectively prepare future computer science graduates, capable of creating, solving problems, and managing, as well as co-creating, artifacts with AI. It is important to consider a shift in curricula. Emphasizing system design, abstraction, and critical evaluation could greatly enhance their education and readiness for the challenges ahead. We propose prerequisites for solutions to reform CS education by fostering AI-native competencies, re-centering fundamental education, enhancing advanced pathways, embracing new pedagogies, and shifting institutional support.

</details>


### [462] [Astro, I'm Home! Investigating Factors that Influence the Acceptance of Home Robots Using Supervised Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07551)
*Katrin Fischer,Essence Wilson,Steffie Kim,Dmitri Williams*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究应用正则化技术（如Lasso和Ridge回归）探索社交机器人情境下的技术接受模型，发现UTAUT2框架中的绩效预期、社会影响和享乐动机是最强且最一致的预测变量，同时识别出可用性、信任和能力作为预测使用意向的新兴变量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着社交机器人在家庭环境中的日益普及，需要更准确地理解影响用户接受该技术的因素，但传统技术接受模型在社交机器人领域的适用性尚不明确，因此本研究旨在通过正则化方法探索和识别新的预测变量及模型。

Method: 采用探索性研究方法，应用正则化技术（Lasso回归和Ridge回归）对变量进行筛选和分析，在原始UTAUT2框架基础上识别和验证技术接受的预测模型。

Result: 绩效预期、社会影响和享乐动机是UTAUT2框架中最强且最一致的使用意向预测因子；可用性、信任和能力被识别为有前景的预测变量。

Conclusion: 正则化技术有效地识别了社交机器人技术接受的关键预测因素，拓展了UTAUT2模型在该领域的适用性，为后续研究提供了新的变量和模型方向。

Abstract: The use of social robots in home environments is on the rise. This exploratory study applies regularization techniques (e.g., Lasso and Ridge regression) to investigate variables and identify new models of technology acceptance in the context of social robots. Within the original UTAUT2 framework, performance expectancy, social influence, and hedonic motivation emerged as the strongest and most consistent predictors of intention to use the technology. In addition, usability, trust, and competence were identified as promising variables in a model predicting intention to use.

</details>


### [463] [Position: Anthropomorphic Misalignment Research Needs Stronger Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07612)
*Vansh Gupta,Peter Nutter,Samuel Stante,Andreas Krause,Florian Tramèr,Lukas Fluri,Xin Chen,Anna Hedström*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文指出当前拟人化错位研究（AMR）在方法上缺乏严谨性，存在概念模糊、数据不稳健、实验设计不足和因果干预不充分等问题，可能导致对模型行为的过度解读。作者提出证据层级框架和诊断清单，以提高AMR研究的实证基础，确保AI风险主张建立在可靠证据之上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多拟人化错位研究（AMR）缺乏足够稳健的证据，无法为模型部署和监管等关键安全决策提供可靠基础。

Method: 通过评估欺骗、突现错位和谄媚等不同错位概念下的失败模式，分析概念模糊性、数据集非稳健性、实验设计问题和因果干预不足等问题，并提出证据层级框架和诊断清单。

Result: 识别出AMR研究中存在概念模糊、非稳健数据集、实验设计缺陷和因果干预不足等问题，这些会导致对模型行为的过度解读。

Conclusion: 通过提出证据层级和诊断清单作为共享标准，提升AMR的方法论严谨性，确保AI风险主张建立在坚实的实证基础上，促进更富有成效的科学讨论。

Abstract: We argue that many Anthropomorphic Misalignment Research (AMR) studies need stronger evidence to ensure that they can provide a robust foundation for critical safety decisions, such as model deployment and regulation. By evaluating failure modes across different misalignment concepts, such as deception, emergent misalignment, and sycophancy, we show how conceptual ambiguity, non-robust datasets, experimental design, and insufficient causal interventions can lead to overinterpretation of model behaviors. This position paper aims to offer guidance on evidentiary considerations that can help improve methodological rigor in AMR. To achieve this, we provide a clear call to action through a proposed framework of evidence levels and a diagnostic checklist. These shared standards will enable more productive scientific discourse and ensure that claims about AI risks rest on solid empirical foundations.

</details>


### [464] [Frankenstein in the Pipeline: Computational Epistemicide in Facial Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07628)
*Nina da Hora*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文运用玛丽·雪莱的《弗兰肯斯坦》作为诊断框架，揭示基于嵌入的人脸识别技术如何通过检测/裁剪、特征点定位、对齐/正面化、嵌入等流程，逐步将人脸从鲜活的 relational 表面简化为数值代理，实施作者所称的"计算性认知灭绝"（computational epistemicide）。论文论证向量化完成了弗兰肯斯坦式的"缝合"，距离度量和阈值则将"足够接近"标准化，最终主张废除将向量化身份作为权利与访问的合法基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有批判技术研究虽已充分记录计算机视觉的优生学根源，却较少关注这种暴力在流水线层面上的具体运作机制。本文旨在弥补这一空白，通过《弗兰肯斯坦》作为方法论诊断工具，揭示嵌入人脸识别技术如何系统性地实施认知灭绝。

Method: 本文采用玛丽·雪莱的《弗兰肯斯坦》作为方法诊断框架（而非简单的"意外后果"隐喻），将弗兰肯斯坦的拆解、重构与创造过程映射到人脸识别流程的各阶段（检测/裁剪、特征点定位、对齐/正面化、嵌入）。同时，作者将Sueli Carneiro的"认知灭绝"概念扩展至计算领域，提出"计算性认知灭绝"概念，分析距离度量和阈值如何将标准化"足够接近"运作化为规范。

Result: 论文揭示：(1) 人脸在各阶段被逐步窄化为可被数据稳定的形式，产生"规范面孔"作为可读性条件及相应的"形式-主体"作为识别条件；(2) 向量化完成弗兰肯斯坦式的缝合，将拆解的人脸重组为固定维度的可流通人造物；(3) 距离相似度与阈值使识别与标准化不可分割，导致改革主义"伦理AI"优化在结构上不充分。

Conclusion: 本文主张废除作为规范性立场：拒绝将向量化身份作为权利和访问的合法基础，并拆除通过可拆解数据点治理人类生活的制度冲动。改革主义"伦理AI"优化在结构性上不足以应对根本问题。

Abstract: While the eugenic roots of computer vision are well-documented in critical technology studies, less attention has been paid to the operational mechanisms through which this violence is enacted at the level of the pipeline. This paper employs Mary Shelley's Frankenstein not as a metaphor for unintended consequences, but as a diagnostic framework for method: disassembly, reconstruction, and the production of a creature whose legitimacy is asserted by the procedure that made it.
