*Gianluca Barmina,Annemette Broch Pirchert,Andrea Blasi Núñez,Lukas Galke Poech,Peter Schneider-Kamp*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BrainSurgery 是一个用于神经网络检查点（checkpoint）的"张量手术"工具，通过声明式 YAML 计划实现对模型权重的结构修改、数学变换和张量重塑，支持正则表达式和结构化定位，并内置断言验证以防止静默错误，提供了比传统 ad-hoc Python 脚本更鲁棒和可复现的检查点操作方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着深度学习模型规模扩大，管理、检查和修改大型检查点文件变得越来越困难。研究人员经常需要更改模型权重以进行层重构、精度转换、低秩分解和架构调试，但这些工作流通常依赖脆弱的 ad-hoc Python 脚本，缺乏鲁棒性和可复现性。

Method: BrainSurgery 通过抽象存储格式和内存管理，让用户使用声明式 YAML 计划执行复杂变换。它支持结构修改、数学变换和张量重塑，通过 expressive 正则表达式和结构化目标定位来指定操作对象，并内置断言来验证张量的形状、数据类型和值，防止静默错误。

Result: 论文通过四个示例和三个案例研究（从模型升级到 LoRA 提取）进行了系统演示，展示了 BrainSurgery 在处理检查点操作任务中的有效性和鲁棒性。

Conclusion: BrainSurgery 通过其可复现和可验证的操作，为未来研究提供了坚实的基础，有望成为深度学习检查点管理领域的标准化工具。

Abstract: As deep learning models scale, managing, inspecting, and modifying large checkpoints has become increasingly challenging. Researchers often need to alter model weights for layer restructuring, precision casting, low-rank factorization, and architectural debugging, yet these workflows often rely on fragile ad-hoc Python scripts. Here, we introduce BrainSurgery, a tool for robust and reproducible "tensor surgery" on neural network checkpoints, and provide a system demonstration covering four examples and three case studies from model upcycling to LoRA extraction. By abstracting storage formats and memory management, BrainSurgery executes complex transformations through declarative YAML plans. It supports structural modifications, mathematical transformations, and tensor reshaping through expressive regex and structural targeting, while built-in assertions validate tensor shapes, data types, and values to prevent silent errors. We envision that BrainSurgery will provide a strong foundation for future research through its reproducible and validated operations.

</details>


### [750] [Disentanglement with Holographic Reduced Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09725)
*Jhonny J. Velasquez Olivera,Christo K. Thomas,Walid Saad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于全息简化表示（HRR）的无监督解耦学习算法，利用HRR的解绑定操作作为归纳偏置，通过符号化结构实现因子分离，并证明了该操作能产生近似独立的符号-值对，推导了每槽位容量界限，实验表明该方法在解耦指标和噪声鲁棒性上具有竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于连续表示的解耦方法面临挑战，而离散符号结构虽更符合概念间的组合关系，但保持可微性学习困难且架构复杂。本文旨在利用HRR的解绑定操作提供一种更简洁的归纳偏置来实现神经解耦。

Method: 提出无监督学习算法，采用全息简化表示（HRR）作为潜表示形式，利用HRR的解绑定（unbinding）操作分离因子；结合信息论分析解绑定通道，证明其产生近似独立的符号-值对，并推导每槽位容量界限以量化可靠编码的概念数量。

Result: 在潜变量遍历和解耦指标上，HRR方法取得了与基线相当甚至更优的结果；HRR表示对噪声具有更强的鲁棒性，能在不同信噪比下保持重建质量。

Conclusion: HRR的解绑定操作提供了一种有效的归纳偏置来促进解耦，其符号化的向量求和表示不同于传统自编码器的标量潜变量，在噪声鲁棒性方面具有优势，信息论分析从理论上解释了其解耦能力。

Abstract: Disentanglement, the separation of factors of variation in data using neural networks, remains a long-standing challenge in machine learning. Prior work has addressed this problem with variational autoencoders and generative adversarial networks that incorporate ideas from variational inference and information-theoretic constraints. In contrast to methods that rely on continuous representations, we propose a design that treats disentangled representations as symbolic structures, motivated by the compositional relationships among the concepts that make up samples from a distribution. However, learning discrete symbolic structures with neural networks while maintaining differentiability is difficult and often requires complex architectures. To address this, we introduce an unsupervised learning algorithm that uses holographic reduced representations (HRR) for neural disentanglement. We show that the HRR unbinding operation provides an inductive bias for separating factors and yields competitive results against baselines, as measured by latent traversals and disentanglement metrics. We complement these empirical findings with an information-theoretic analysis of the HRR unbinding channel. We prove that unbinding induces approximately independent symbol-value pairs and derive a per-slot capacity bound that quantifies how many distinct symbolic concepts can be reliably encoded, giving a quantitative account of the inductive bias toward disentanglement. The resulting representations differ from standard autoencoder-based models, in that their latent units are vectors that are summed together, rather than scalar dimensions of a low-dimensional latent vector. We show that this HRR representation is more robust to noise than other disentangled representations and maintains reconstruction quality across a range of SNRs.

</details>


### [751] [Tight Sample Complexity of Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09731)
*Chenxiao Yang,Nathan Srebro,Zhiyuan Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文严格刻画了深度为L、总参数量为W、处理输入序列长度T并输出单个结果的Transformer的VC维，给出了上界O(L W log(T W))和几乎匹配的下界Ω(L W log(T W / L))；同时严格刻画了思维链学习（chain-of-thought learning）的样本复杂度，证明了教师强制（teacher forcing）方法需要O(L W log((T+T')W))个样本即可学习，而任何利用思维链数据的学习规则至少需要Ω(L W log((T+T')W / L))个样本，其中T为输入长度，T'为自回归步数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作缺乏对Transformer架构在统计学习理论层面的严格刻画，尤其是其VC维和思维链学习的样本复杂度尚未得到紧界分析。

Method: 通过理论推导建立深度L、参数W的Transformer的VC维上下界，并分别分析教师强制方法与任意学习规则在思维链学习中的样本复杂度下界。

Result: VC维上界O(L W log(T W))，下界Ω(L W log(T W / L))；教师强制样本复杂度O(L W log((T+T')W))，任意学习规则所需样本下界Ω(L W log((T+T')W / L))。

Conclusion: Transformer的VC维与样本复杂度均与参数规模和序列长度呈对数关系，所得到的上下界几乎匹配，为理解Transformer的泛化能力和思维链学习的样本需求提供了理论支撑。

Abstract: We tightly characterize the VC dimension of depth-$L$ Transformers with a total of $W$ parameters, mapping an input sequence of length $T$ to a single output, establishing an upper bound of $O(L W \log (T W))$ and a nearly matching lower bound of $Ω(L W \log (T W / L))$. We further tightly characterize the sample complexity of chain-of-thought learning using such a Transformer, showing teacher forcing (i.e. selecting a predictor consistent with the entire chain-of-thought on training data) learns with sample complexity $O\left(L W \log \left(\left(T+T^{\prime}\right) W\right)\right)$ and that any learning rule that uses chain-of-thought data requires at least $Ω\left(L W \log \left(\left(T+T^{\prime}\right) W / L\right)\right)$ examples, where $T$ is the input length and $T^{\prime}$ is the number of autoregressive steps.

</details>


### [752] [Learning Dynamics Reveal a Hierarchy of Weight-Induced Layerwise Gram Metrics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09744)
*Claudio Nordio*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了使用固定读出层和二次损失的前馈ReLU网络，将梯度下降重新表述为训练集空间上场的集体动力学，而非权重空间动力学。单隐藏层可消除权重变量得到残差的封闭方程，深层网络则需引入权重诱导的Gram算子层次结构实现层间信息传输，共轭场动力学由满足反向拉回递归的算子控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统上梯度下降被视为权重空间中的动力学过程，但这种视角难以直接揭示网络内部表示演化的集体行为。本文旨在将梯度下降重新表述为训练集空间上场的集体动力学，从而更直接地理解神经网络的学习动态。

Method: 针对固定读出层和二次损失的ReLU前馈网络，从梯度下降动力学出发，在训练集空间上重新参数化。单隐藏层情况下消去权重变量得到残差的封闭方程，其核函数分解为输入几何矩阵和动态共激活矩阵的乘积。对于更深网络（深度≥3），引入权重诱导的Gram算子层次结构实现层间信息传输，共轭场动力学则通过反向拉回递归算子描述。

Result: 单隐藏层网络可获得残差动力学的完全封闭形式；两层及以上网络残差动力学保持清晰的逐层核结构；深度≥3时需引入权重诱导Gram算子的层次结构以实现封闭；共轭场动力学由反向拉回递归算子支配，权重诱导Gram算子是其首个非平凡实例。

Conclusion: 本文提供了一种新的理论框架，将梯度下降重新解释为训练集空间上场的集体动力学，揭示了深度学习中信息在层间传输的算子结构，为理解深层网络的训练动态提供了新的分析工具。

Abstract: We study feed-forward ReLU networks with fixed readout and quadratic loss. The aim is to rewrite gradient descent not primarily as a dynamics in weight space, but as a collective dynamics closed in terms of fields defined on the training-set space. For a single hidden layer, the weight variables can be eliminated from the activation dynamics, yielding a closed equation for the residuals governed by a collective kernel that factorizes into an input-geometric matrix and a dynamical co-activation matrix. For deeper networks, the residual dynamics retains a clean layer-wise kernel structure. However, from depth three onward, closure requires a hierarchy of weight-induced Gram operators that mediate information transport across layers. Moreover, the conjugate-field dynamics is governed by operators satisfying a backward pullback recursion, of which the weight-induced Gram operators are the first nontrivial instances.

</details>


### [753] [Perturbative Contrastive Physical Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09756)
*Kyungeun Kim,Amanuel Anteneh,Israel Klich,Olivier Pfister,J. M. Schwarz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出扰动对比物理学习（PCPL）框架，通过测量物理系统在受控扰动下的响应对比来实现学习，无需外部处理器或显式反向传播，并在弹簧网络和连续变量光子电路两种平台上验证了分类和模拟乘法任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解物理系统对扰动的响应是认识物理系统的关键，而对比不同条件下的响应差异提供了一种学习机制。现有方法如平衡传播和频率传播各有局限，需要统一框架来理解并扩展物理学习系统，使其摆脱对外部处理器和显式梯度计算的依赖。

Method: PCPL框架通过对比物理系统在可控变化（输入、边界条件、参数或解释函数）下产生的物理状态差异来实现学习。更新规则可以反映局部敏感性或全局逆问题结构，但无需集中梯度计算。在弹簧网络中通过测量位移和力来更新键刚度；在连续变量光子电路中通过x正交测量和雅可比矩阵的有限差分估计进行训练。

Result: 在弹簧网络和连续变量光子电路两种平台上成功实现了分类任务学习。连续变量光子电路还被训练实现模拟乘法，展示了向更自主物理学习系统迈进的步骤。

Conclusion: PCPL统一并扩展了平衡传播和频率传播等方法，证明有效的学习几何可以从系统自身的物理响应中隐式涌现，使学习行为无需外部处理器或显式反向传播即可发生，为构建更自主的物理学习系统提供了通用框架。

Abstract: Responses to perturbations are key to understanding physical systems. The ability to contrast such responses by comparing how a system reacts under slightly different conditions provides a mechanism for learning. Here, we introduce Perturbative Contrastive Physical Learning (PCPL), a general framework in which learning emerges from measurable contrasts between physical states produced by controlled changes to inputs, boundary conditions, parameters, or interpreter functions. PCPL unifies and extends prior approaches: Equilibrium Propagation is rooted in contrasts between free and nudged equilibria in energy-based systems, while Frequency Propagation corresponds to contrasts extracted from sinusoidally driven, frequency-demodulated responses. We show that contrast-driven updates can reflect either local sensitivities or global inverse-problem structure, yet do not require centralized gradient computation. Instead, effective learning geometry emerges implicitly from the system's own physical response, allowing learning behavior to arise without an external processor or explicit backpropagation. We demonstrate PCPL in two platforms: (i) spring networks that update bond stiffness using measured displacements and forces, and (ii) continuous-variable photonic circuits trained via x quadrature measurements and finite-difference estimates of the Jacobian. Both platforms successfully learn classification tasks. We further show that a continuous-variable photonic circuit can be trained to implement analog multiplication, illustrating a step toward more autonomous physical learning systems.

</details>


### [754] [Preserving Plasticity in Continual Learning via Dynamical Isometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09762)
*Andries Rosseau,Robert Müller,Ann Nowé*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究发现动态等距性（各层Jacobian奇异值接近1）是保持持续学习中网络可塑性的关键机制，并提出了一系列等距性保留方法（正则化、AdamO优化器），在监督学习和强化学习的持续学习基准上匹配或超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络在非平稳环境下持续训练会导致可塑性逐渐丧失，限制后续学习能力，需要找到保持可塑性的关键机制和实用方法。

Method: 将可塑性与经验神经正切核（NTK）联系起来，识别动态等距性为关键机制；提出等距性促进正则化方案，发现其能重新激活休眠ReLU单元；提出AdamO优化器将等距性正则化与梯度更新解耦；从动态等距性视角重新解释先前的可塑性保留方法。

Result: 在监督学习和强化学习的持续学习基准上，所提方法始终匹配或超越现有方法。

Conclusion: 动态等距性是保持持续学习可塑性的关键，所提出的正则化和优化方法能有效保留可塑性。

Abstract: Continual training of deep neural networks under non-stationarity often leads to a progressive loss of plasticity, eventually limiting further learning. We relate plasticity to the empirical Neural Tangent Kernel, and identify dynamical isometry (the condition that layer-wise Jacobian singular values remain close to one) as a key mechanism for preserving plasticity in continual learning. We revisit a class of networks that are almost-everywhere isometric while remaining universal Lipschitz function approximators, demonstrating that near-dynamical isometry is compatible with expressive nonlinear representations. For general architectures, we propose an efficient isometry-promoting regularization scheme and identify a novel mechanism by which it can reactivate dormant ReLU units. Building on this, we introduce AdamO, an Adam-style adaptive optimizer that decouples isometry regularization from gradient updates, analogous to AdamW. We further reinterpret prior plasticity-preserving approaches through the lens of dynamical isometry, showing that they target only a partial measure of isometry. Across supervised and reinforcement-learning continual-learning benchmarks designed to induce plasticity loss, our methods consistently match or outperform existing approaches.

</details>


### [755] [iOSWorld: A Benchmark for Personally Intelligent Phone Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09764)
*Lawrence Keunho Jang,Mareks Woodside,Geronimo Carom,Andrew Keunwoo Jang,Jing Yu Koh,Ruslan Salakhutdinov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: iOSWorld是首个基于原生iOS模拟器的交互式基准测试，包含26个内置应用程序和133个任务，用于评估手机代理在个性化、多应用交互和记忆推理方面的能力。最佳配置整体准确率52%，多应用任务仅37%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有移动代理基准测试缺乏个性化能力，无法评估代理基于用户身份、历史记录和设备上偏好进行推理的能力，而非仅仅在非个人化的沙盒中执行孤立指令。

Method: 构建了包含26个iOS应用的模拟器环境，各应用间通过交易记录、消息、旅行记录、社交关系和金融活动等数据相互关联。设计了133个任务，分为单应用任务（27个）、多应用任务（60个，跨2-8个应用）以及记忆与个性化任务（46个，需从个人数据中推断模式）。

Result: 最佳配置整体准确率52%，多应用任务仅37%。特权视觉+XML访问可将前沿模型性能提升最多26个百分点，但小型模型并未从辅助功能树输入中获益。

Conclusion: 开放了iOSWorld作为开源基准测试，包含所有应用、预设数据、任务、评分标准和评估代码，为评估移动代理的个性化智能提供了标准化平台。

Abstract: A useful phone agent needs to be personally intelligent. It should reason over a user's identity, history, and preferences as they exist on the device, not just follow isolated instructions in an impersonal sandbox. Existing mobile agent benchmarks lack this kind of personalization. We introduce iOSWorld, the first interactive native iOS simulator benchmark built around a persistent user identity spanning 26 newly built iOS apps. These apps contain connected data such as transactions, messages, travel records, social relationships, and financial activity. iOSWorld includes 133 tasks across three increasingly difficult categories. Single-app tasks (27) test one app, multi-app tasks (60) span 2 to 8 apps, and memory and personalization tasks (46) require agents to infer patterns from personal data. We evaluate frontier and open-source computer-use models in both vision-only and privileged vision+XML settings. The best configuration reaches 52\% overall but only 37\% on multi-app tasks. Privileged vision+XML access improves frontier models by up to 26 percentage points, while smaller models do not benefit from added accessibility-tree input. We release iOSWorld as an open-source benchmark with all apps, seeded data, tasks, rubrics, and evaluation code.

</details>


### [756] [Zero Touch Predictive Orchestration: Automating Time-Series Models for the Cloud-Edge Continuum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09787)
*Abd Elghani Meliani,Arora Sagar,Adlen Ksentini,Raymond Knopp*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对云边连续体中边缘节点因缺乏历史数据导致的"冷启动"问题，本文提出一种全自动时间序列预测架构，通过轻量级资源暴露器动态发现节点并采集遥测数据，结合公开高分辨率数据集TimeTrack进行数据混合，并使用神经架构搜索自动生成高精度基线模型，实验证明该方法能有效缓解冷启动问题，提升预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 云边连续体（CEC）的极端波动性需要通过时间序列预测实现主动式零触摸管理，但编排器面临严重的"冷启动"问题：新发现的节点缺乏训练本地预测模型所需的历史数据，而通用模型无法捕捉节点特有的硬件和微服务行为模式。

Method: 提出全自动时间序列预测架构：1）轻量级、技术无关的资源暴露器（RE）动态发现节点并持续采集可自定义的遥测数据；2）将稀疏的本地样本与公开高分辨率数据集TimeTrack（45秒间隔采集）自动合并，实现TimeTrack的高频时间模式与本地节点精确校准的协同；3）通过神经架构搜索（NAS）引擎自动生成高精度基线模型。

Result: 实验结果表明，将目标数据与TimeTrack混合能有效缓解冷启动挑战，在MSE、MAE和MAPE指标上显著提升预测准确性，并加速模型收敛，优于仅使用稀疏本地样本训练、仅使用通用数据集训练或将目标数据与标准替代数据集混合的方案。

Conclusion: 该方法为持续的MLOps部署建立了稳健基础，证明了数据混合策略在解决边缘节点冷启动问题上的有效性，为云边连续体的自动化管理提供了可行方案。

Abstract: The Cloud-Edge Continuum (CEC) enables latency-critical applications by distributing resources to the far edge, but its extreme volatility makes proactive Zero Touch Management via time-series forecasting essential. However, orchestrators face a severe "cold start" problem: newly discovered nodes lack the historical data required to train localized predictive models, while generalized models fail to capture unique hardware and microservice behaviors. To solve this, we propose a fully automated time-series prediction architecture driven by a novel data-mixing methodology. At the infrastructure level, we introduce a lightweight, technology-agnostic Resource Exposer (RE) that dynamically discovers nodes and continuously collects customizable telemetry (e.g., compute, network, energy). To overcome the sparsity of these initial local samples, our framework automatically merges them with TimeTrack, our publicly available, high-resolution dataset collected at 45-second intervals. This synergizes TimeTrack's foundational, high-frequency temporal patterns with the precise calibration of the local node data. Processed through a Neural Architecture Search (NAS) engine, the system automatically generates highly accurate baseline models. Experimental results demonstrate that merging the target data with TimeTrack effectively mitigates the cold start challenge. This integration significantly improves forecasting accuracy measured in Mean Squared Error (MSE), Mean Absolute Error (MAE), and Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) and accelerates convergence compared to training on the sparse local samples alone, training solely on generic datasets, or mixing the target data with standard alternative datasets, establishing a robust foundation for continuous MLOps deployment.

</details>


### [757] [Bandits for Efficient Experimentation: Adapting to Control Group, Preferences, and Context Drifts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09802)
*Udvas Das,Waris Radji,Debabrota Basu,Odalric-Ambrym Maillard*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了一种线性上下文随机多臂赌博机变体，其中学习器需为具有个性化偏好向量的用户群体提供推荐，且上下文分布随时间漂移。在实用假设下，该问题可简化为均值平稳但噪声异方差且非平稳的线性赌博机。进一步研究了要求每个决策的期望奖励必须超过基线策略π₀的保守约束场景。提出了Dri-MED算法，其遗憾界为$\tilde{\mathcal O}\left(\frac{\kappa}{\tilde{\Delta}}d^2\log(T)\right)$，约束违反为$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(d)$，实验表明显著优于忽略漂移和偏好结构的保守基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实场景中用户偏好随时间变化，且推荐系统需满足保守性约束（保证不低于基线策略），现有研究缺乏同时处理非平稳上下文分布、个性化偏好和保守约束的理论框架。

Method: 将问题转化为均值平稳但噪声异方差且非平稳的线性赌博机；基于线性MED策略设计Dri-MED算法，通过异方差回归处理噪声方差；理论推导了实例依赖的遗憾界和约束违反界。

Result: 实例依赖遗憾界为$\tilde{\mathcal O}\left(\frac{\kappa}{\tilde{\Delta}}d^2\log(T)\right)$，期望约束违反为$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(d)$；数值实验表明Dri-MED显著优于忽略漂移和偏好结构的保守基线方法。

Conclusion: Dri-MED算法能有效处理上下文分布漂移和保守约束，在理论上提供了紧的遗憾与约束违反保证，实践中优于现有基线方法。

Abstract: We consider a variant of the linear contextual stochastic multi-armed bandits, where the learner must provide recommendations to a group of users, each having its personalized preference vector, and in the presence of context distributions that are drifting over time. Under practitioner-friendly assumptions, we reduce this setting to linear bandit with stationary mean but heteroskedastic and non-stationary noise. We further study the case when the learner must ensure the mean reward of each decision must exceed that of a baseline strategy $\boldsymbolπ_0$ at each decision step. We introduce Dri-MED, an algorithm inspired from the linear version of the MED strategy, and carefully adapted to handle the non-stationary heteroskedastic noise. We show that the instance-dependent regret scales as $\tilde{\mathcal O}\left(\fracκ{\tildeΔ}d^2(\log(T)\right)$, where $\tildeΔ$ is the constraint-aware sub-optimality gap subject to policy $π_0$, with variance-aware multiplicative term $κ$ that we carefully handle using heteroskedastic regression. We further show Dri-MED enjoys $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(d)$ expected constraint violations. Our numerical results suggest that Dri-MED significantly outperforms conservative baselines that ignores the drift and preference structure.

</details>


### [758] [Topological Neural Operators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09806)
*Lennart Bastian,Samuel Leventhal,Mustafa Hajij,Tolga Birdal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出拓扑神经算子（TNOs），一种基于细胞复形的算子学习框架，通过离散外微分实现跨维度耦合，并引入层次化变体（HTNOs）处理长程依赖，在多种PDE基准上取得改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经算子局限于点和边上的函数映射，缺乏对拓扑结构和高维多尺度物理量的显式建模能力，无法自然表达梯度、旋度、散度等跨维度耦合关系。

Method: TNOs将数据定义为细胞复形上各维度的特征，利用离散外微分显式建模跨维度交互；核心设计是将信息流向（固定拓扑算子）与信息变换（可学习）解耦。HTNOs引入学习的粗化复形以传播长程和拓扑依赖信息。

Result: 在包含不规则几何流动问题在内的多种PDE基准上，TNOs和HTNOs相比现有方法提升了精度；控制实验进一步验证了原生高阶和拓扑结构的优势。

Conclusion: TNOs统一了跨离散化的算子学习视角，为物理量几何支撑和守恒相容性的显式建模提供了原则性框架。

Abstract: We introduce Topological Neural Operators (TNOs), a principled framework for operator learning on cell complexes that lifts neural operators (NOs) from functions on points and/or edges to topological domains. TNOs represent data as features defined on cells of varying dimension and model their interactions through Discrete Exterior Calculus, enabling explicit cross-dimensional coupling via gradient-, curl-, and divergence-type operators. The key design principle is to decouple where information flows, as governed by fixed topological operators, from how it is transformed (which is learned), yielding models that respect the geometric support of physical quantities and expose conservation and compatibility structure. We further propose Hierarchical TNOs (HTNOs), which incorporate learned coarse complexes to propagate long-range and topology-dependent information. Our framework subsumes existing NOs as a special case, providing a unified perspective on operator learning across discretizations. Across a range of PDE benchmarks, including irregular-geometry flow problems, TNOs and HTNOs improve accuracy; controlled studies further isolate the benefits of native higher-rank and topological structure. Project page: https://circle-group.github.io/research/TNO

</details>


### [759] [Rethinking the Divergence Regularization in LLM RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09821)
*Jiarui Yao,Xiangxin Zhou,Penghui Qi,Wee Sun Lee,Liefeng Bo,Tianyu Pang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DRPO提出用平滑的advantage加权二次正则化项替代DPPO中的硬掩码，在LLM强化学习后训练中实现更稳定的信任区域控制，实验表明其在不同模型规模、架构和精度设置下均能提升训练稳定性与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM RL方法（如PPO/GRPO）使用比率裁剪近似信任区域，但重要性比率在长尾词汇分布中无法有效表征分布偏移；DPPO虽改用基于散度的硬掩码，但一旦token越过信任区域边界，其梯度被直接丢弃而非修正，导致信息损失。

Method: DRPO将DPPO中的硬二值掩码替换为平滑的advantage加权二次正则化项，在保持相同信任区域几何结构的同时，对超出边界的更新产生连续且有界的衰减梯度权重，提供纠正信号而非完全丢弃梯度。

Result: 在多种模型规模、架构和精度设置下的实验表明，DRPO相比基线方法提升了LLM RL训练的稳定性和效率。

Conclusion: DRPO通过平滑正则化替代硬掩码，有效解决了信任区域边界处的梯度截断问题，为LLM后训练中的策略优化提供了一种更稳定高效的方案。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a key component of post-training large language models (LLMs). In practice, LLM RL is often off-policy because of training-inference mismatch and policy staleness, making trust-region control essential for stable optimization. Mainstream methods such as PPO and GRPO approximate this control with a ratio-clipping mechanism, but the importance ratio can be a poor proxy for distributional shift in long-tailed vocabularies. Recent work such as DPPO addresses this mismatch by replacing ratio-based clipping with a divergence-based mask, yielding a trust region defined by the sampled token's absolute probability shift. However, DPPO still relies on a hard mask: once a token crosses the trust-region boundary in a harmful direction, its gradient is discarded rather than corrected. To address this, we propose Divergence Regularized Policy Optimization (DRPO), which replaces the hard mask with a smooth advantage-weighted quadratic regularizer on policy shift. DRPO preserves the same trust-region geometry as DPPO while inducing bounded, continuous gradient weights that attenuate diverging updates and provide corrective signals beyond the boundary. Experiments across model scales, architectures, and precision settings show that DRPO improves the stability and efficiency of LLM RL training.

</details>


### [760] [An Agency-Transferring Model-Free Policy Enhancement Technique](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09825)
*Anton Bolychev,Georgiy Malaniya,Sinan Ibrahim,Pavel Osinenko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种将已有基线策略嵌入强化学习训练过程的方法，通过仲裁机制在训练初期依赖基线策略、逐步过渡到学习策略，最终得到无需基线支持且性能更优的独立策略，在连续控制任务中实现了高目标到达率和高效训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从零训练强化学习策略成本高昂，需要精细的奖励设计、环境设计和大量调参计算；而许多控制问题已存在功能可用但次优的基线策略，现有方法未能有效利用这一先验知识来提升训练效率。

Method: 提出一种仲裁机制，在每个时间步在基线策略和可训练的学习策略之间进行选择：训练初期主要依赖基线策略，随着训练推进逐步将控制权转移给学习策略；最终学习策略成为无需基线支持的独立神经网络。该方法形式化了基线策略的"功能性"（高概率到达并保持在目标集），并设计仲裁机制利用该属性。

Result: 在连续控制基准任务上的实验表明，该方法取得了与 competitive 方法相当或更优的回报，且在训练全程（包括最终无基线支持阶段）保持最高的目标到达率。

Conclusion: 嵌入基线策略的仲裁式强化学习范式可以兼顾训练效率与最终性能，理论分析为训练行为和最终策略的目标到达概率提供了下界保证，验证了方法的有效性。

Abstract: Training reinforcement learning (RL) policies from scratch is
  costly: it requires careful reward and environment design,
  extensive tuning, and substantial computation.
  Yet many control problems already have a functional but
  suboptimal policy available as a baseline.
  This paper proposes a method for embedding such a baseline into
  the RL training process, simultaneously improving training
  efficiency relative to from-scratch methods and producing a
  learning policy that outperforms the baseline.
  At each step, the method arbitrates between the baseline policy
  and a trainable learning policy, initially relying strongly on
  the baseline policy and then progressively transferring agency to
  the learning policy.
  By the end of training, the learning policy is a standalone
  neural network that operates without baseline policy support.
  The paper formalizes what it means for the baseline policy to be
  functional: under this policy, the agent reaches a goal set and
  remains there with high probability.
  The proposed arbitration mechanism is designed to exploit this
  property during training, yielding high goal-reaching rates right
  from the beginning of training.
  A theoretical analysis provides a formal interpretation of this
  behavior under stated assumptions and extends it to the final
  baseline-free regime, where explicit lower bounds are derived for
  the goal-reaching probability of the standalone learning policy.
  Empirical results on continuous-control benchmarks show that the
  proposed method achieves returns that match or exceed those of
  competitive approaches, while maintaining the highest
  goal-reaching rates throughout training among the compared
  methods -- including in the final stage, where the learning policy
  operates without any baseline support.

</details>


### [761] [Learning from flowsheets: A generative transformer model for autocompletion of flowsheets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2208.00859)
*Gabriel Vogel,Lukas Schulze Balhorn,Artur M. Schweidtmann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 受文本自动补全启发，提出利用SFILES 2.0符号将化工流程图表示为字符串，并通过基于Transformer的语言模型（预训练+微调）学习其语法与常见模式，从而实现流程图的自动补全，为交互式化工流程合成提供AI辅助建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 化工流程设计（流程合成）是一项复杂且耗时的任务，工程师需要反复构建和修改流程图。现有方法缺乏对交互式、智能辅助流程补全的支持。受文本自动补全技术的启发，作者希望将语言模型应用于化工流程图领域，使模型能够学习流程图的"语法"和常见设计模式，从而在工程师设计过程中提供即时、智能的流程推荐，提升设计效率。

Method: 1) 将化工流程图通过SFILES 2.0符号系统转换为字符串表示；2) 使用基于Transformer的语言模型；3) 先在合成生成的流程图拓扑数据上进行预训练，学习SFILES 2.0语言的语法结构；4) 再通过迁移学习在真实流程图拓扑数据上进行微调；5) 最终利用训练好的模型执行因果语言建模（自回归生成），实现流程图的自动补全。

Result: 该方法在流程图自动补全任务上展现出了较高的潜力，证明将语言模型应用于化工流程合成是可行的。但同时也揭示了当前阶段存在的局限性，指出了在实际流程合成场景中部署该技术仍需解决的关键问题。

Conclusion: 提出的将流程图表示为字符串并利用语言模型进行自动补全的方法为未来AI辅助流程合成提供了新思路，具有很高的应用潜力。但目前该方法仍处于早期阶段，存在局限性，需要进一步研究以实现在真实化工流程设计中的实际部署。

Abstract: We propose a novel method enabling autocompletion of chemical flowsheets. This idea is inspired by the autocompletion of text. We represent flowsheets as strings using the text-based SFILES 2.0 notation and learn the grammatical structure of the SFILES 2.0 language and common patterns in flowsheets using a transformer-based language model. We pre-train our model on synthetically generated flowsheet topologies to learn the flowsheet language grammar. Then, we fine-tune our model in a transfer learning step on real flowsheet topologies. Finally, we use the trained model for causal language modeling to autocomplete flowsheets. Eventually, the proposed method can provide chemical engineers with recommendations during interactive flowsheet synthesis. The results demonstrate a high potential of this approach for future AI-assisted process synthesis but also reveal the limitations at the present state and the next steps that need to be taken to deploy this technique in realistic flowsheet synthesis scenarios.

</details>


### [762] [TAMUNA: Doubly Accelerated Distributed Optimization under Partial Participation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2302.09832)
*Laurent Condat,Ivan Agarský,Grigory Malinovsky,Peter Richtárik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TAMUNA算法，首次将本地训练、压缩通信和部分客户端参与三者结合，在强凸设置下实现双加速线性收敛，显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分布式优化方法虽已成功结合本地训练和压缩通信实现双加速，但要求所有客户端全量参与，一旦存在空闲客户端错过通信触发点，算法就会失效。为解决这一实际部署中的关键限制，需要一种能同时支持本地训练、压缩通信和部分客户端参与的算法。

Method: 通过解耦原始模型更新与对偶控制变量，突破了先前方法的架构瓶颈。TAMUNA在保持本地训练（LT）和压缩通信（CC）优势的同时，支持任意水平的客户端部分参与（partial participation）。

Result: 在强凸设定下，TAMUNA线性收敛到精确解，实现了双加速收敛（同时关于条件数和模型维度），且支持任意水平的客户端参与率。

Conclusion: TAMUNA建立了新的最先进水平，首次在部分参与场景下同时实现本地训练和压缩通信的双加速效果，为分布式优化和联邦学习的实际部署提供了更可行的方案。

Abstract: In distributed optimization and federated learning, slow and costly communication between parallel devices and the central server constitutes the primary bottleneck. To alleviate this burden, two strategies have emerged: 1) local training (LT), which reduces communication frequency by performing multiple local computations between rounds, and 2) compression (CC), which consists of transmitting lower-dimensional, compact representations. Recent theoretical advances have successfully combined LT and CC to achieve doubly-accelerated communication rates, with respect to both condition number and model dimension. However, these methods have a major drawback: they require full client participation and break down when idle clients miss communication triggers. We introduce TAMUNA, the first algorithm to successfully intertwine LT, CC, and partial participation. By decoupling primal model updates from dual control variates, TAMUNA overcomes the architectural deadlock of prior methods. In the strongly convex setting, TAMUNA converges linearly to the exact solution, establishing a new state of the art by exhibiting doubly-accelerated convergence, while supporting arbitrary levels of client participation.

</details>


### [763] [Deep reinforcement learning for process design: Review and perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.07822)
*Qinghe Gao,Artur M. Schweidtmann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文综述了深度强化学习在化工过程设计中的应用，从信息表示、智能体架构、环境与奖励三个要素分析了现有研究，并讨论了未来挑战与发展方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 化学工业向可再生能源和原料供应转型需要新的概念过程设计方法，而人工智能（尤其是深度强化学习）有望加速这一转型，因此需要系统梳理当前研究进展。

Method: 通过三个核心要素（信息表示、智能体架构、环境与奖励）对强化学习在过程设计中的研究进行综述分析。

Result: 系统总结了强化学习在化工过程设计中的应用现状，识别出了三个关键要素的研究进展。

Conclusion: 强化学习在化工过程设计领域具有巨大潜力，但仍面临诸多挑战，未来需要进一步研究以充分发挥其作用。

Abstract: The transformation towards renewable energy and feedstock supply in the chemical industry requires new conceptual process design approaches. Recently, breakthroughs in artificial intelligence offer opportunities to accelerate this transition. Specifically, deep reinforcement learning, a subclass of machine learning, has shown the potential to solve complex decision-making problems and aid sustainable process design. We survey state-of-the-art research in reinforcement learning for process design through three major elements: (i) information representation, (ii) agent architecture, and (iii) environment and reward. Moreover, we discuss perspectives on underlying challenges and promising future works to unfold the full potential of reinforcement learning for process design in chemical engineering.

</details>


### [764] [Large Models for Time Series and Spatio-Temporal Data: A Survey and Outlook](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.10196)
*Ming Jin,Yaxuan Kong,Yuxuan Liang,Chaoli Zhang,Siqiao Xue,Xue Wang,James Zhang,Yi Wang,Haifeng Chen,Xiaoli Li,Vincent S. Tseng,Yu Zheng,Lei Chen,Hui Xiong,Shirui Pan,Qingsong Wen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文综述了面向时间序列和时空数据的大模型（LM4TS和LM4STD），从数据类型、模型类别、模型范围和应用领域四个维度进行系统梳理，并整理了相关资源与开放研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列和时空数据在现实世界中广泛存在且体量巨大，传统分析方法难以充分挖掘其信息价值。大语言模型和基础模型的快速发展为时序数据挖掘带来了新机会，但相关研究分散，缺乏系统性综述。

Method: 按照数据维度（时间序列 vs. 时空数据）、模型类别、模型范围（通用 vs. 领域专用）以及应用领域四个维度对现有工作进行分类整理，划分为LM4TS和LM4STD两大主线。

Result: 系统梳理了大模型在时序和时空数据分析中的最新进展，涵盖数据、模型实现和工具等资源，并归纳了开放研究挑战。

Conclusion: 大模型在时序和时空数据分析中展现出强大的模式识别和推理能力，有助于推动通用人工智能对时序数据的理解与处理；该领域仍有大量开放问题值得进一步探索。

Abstract: Temporal data, including time series and spatio-temporal data, are pervasive in real-world applications. Generated in massive volumes by physical and virtual sensors, they record dynamic system behaviors and enable a wide range of downstream tasks. Effectively analyzing such data is crucial to unlocking their rich information content. Recent advances in large language models and other foundation models have accelerated their use in time series and spatio-temporal data mining. These approaches not only improve pattern recognition and reasoning across diverse domains but also support progress toward artificial general intelligence that can understand and process temporal data. In this survey, we present a comprehensive, up-to-date review of large models tailored or adapted for time series and spatio-temporal data along four dimensions: data types, model categories, model scopes, and application areas/tasks. We organize existing work into two main groups: large models for time series analysis (LM4TS) and for spatio-temporal data mining (LM4STD), and further distinguish general-purpose from domain-specific models. We also curate related resources, including datasets, model implementations, and tools, organized by major application areas. Overall, this survey consolidates recent advances and highlights foundations, applications, resources, and open research opportunities in large model-centric temporal data analysis.

</details>


### [765] [Toward autocorrection of chemical process flowsheets using large language models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.02873)
*Lukas Schulze Balhorn,Marc Caballero,Artur M. Schweidtmann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于生成式AI的流程图自动纠错方法，利用大语言模型（LLMs）识别PFD和P&ID中的错误并给出修正建议，在合成数据集上达到80%的top-1准确率和84%的top-5准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PFD/P&ID（流程图）中可能存在导致安全隐患、低效操作和不必要开支的错误，而人工校对和验证流程繁琐耗时，亟需自动化纠错方法。

Method: 受LLMs在自然语言语法纠错中的启发，将流程图建模为序列数据，采用监督学习方式在合成数据集上训练LLM，输入为可能出错的流程图，输出为修正后的流程图建议。

Result: 在独立的合成流程图测试集上，模型top-1准确率达80%，top-5准确率达84%。

Conclusion: 该方法能够有效学习合成流程图的自动纠错，有望成为化学工程师的有用工具。

Abstract: The process engineering domain widely uses Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs) and Process and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs) to represent process flows and equipment configurations. However, the P&IDs and PFDs, hereafter called flowsheets, can contain errors causing safety hazards, inefficient operation, and unnecessary expenses. Correcting and verifying flowsheets is a tedious, manual process. We propose a novel generative AI methodology for automatically identifying errors in flowsheets and suggesting corrections to the user, i.e., autocorrecting flowsheets. Inspired by the breakthrough of Large Language Models (LLMs) for grammatical autocorrection of human language, we investigate LLMs for the autocorrection of flowsheets. The input to the model is a potentially erroneous flowsheet and the output of the model are suggestions for a corrected flowsheet. We train our autocorrection model on a synthetic dataset in a supervised manner. The model achieves a top-1 accuracy of 80% and a top-5 accuracy of 84% on an independent test dataset of synthetically generated flowsheets. The results suggest that the model can learn to autocorrect the synthetic flowsheets. We envision that flowsheet autocorrection will become a useful tool for chemical engineers.

</details>


### [766] [Generalization Error Curves for Analytic Spectral Algorithms under Power-law Decay](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.01599)
*Yicheng Li,Weiye Gan,Zuoqiang Shi,Qian Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在温和假设下完整刻画了核梯度下降法（及一大类解析谱算法）在核回归中的泛化误差曲线，确定了不同源条件、噪声水平和正则化参数选择下误差的确切阶数，从而澄清了核插值的近不一致性及高资格核回归算法的饱和效应，并通过神经正切核理论提升了对宽神经网络泛化行为的理解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究多关注核回归方法的极小极大最优率，但未能精确刻画泛化误差曲线在不同源条件、噪声水平和正则化参数选择下的确切阶数，且核插值的不一致性与高资格算法的饱和效应尚未被充分澄清。

Method: 在温和假设下，对核梯度下降法及一大类解析谱算法进行理论分析，提出解析泛函论证（analytic functional argument）作为关键技术贡献，完整刻画泛化误差曲线。

Result: 完整刻画了核回归方法的泛化误差曲线，精确确定了不同源条件、噪声水平和正则化参数下的误差阶数；澄清了核插值的近不一致性；阐释了高资格核回归算法的饱和效应。

Conclusion: 所提理论框架不仅统一了核回归方法的泛化误差分析，还通过神经正切核理论提升了对宽神经网络训练中泛化行为的理解；解析泛函论证这一技术贡献具有独立研究价值。

Abstract: The generalization error curve of certain kernel regression method aims at determining the exact order of generalization error with various source condition, noise level and choice of the regularization parameter rather than the minimax rate. In this work, under mild assumptions, we rigorously provide a full characterization of the generalization error curves of the kernel gradient descent method (and a large class of analytic spectral algorithms) in kernel regression. Consequently, we could sharpen the near inconsistency of kernel interpolation and clarify the saturation effects of kernel regression algorithms with higher qualification, etc. Thanks to the neural tangent kernel theory, these results greatly improve our understanding of the generalization behavior of training the wide neural networks. A novel technical contribution, the analytic functional argument, might be of independent interest.

</details>


### [767] [The Mirrored Influence Hypothesis: Efficient Data Influence Estimation by Harnessing Forward Passes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.08922)
*Myeongseob Ko,Feiyang Kang,Weiyan Shi,Ming Jin,Zhou Yu,Ruoxi Jia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出镜像影响假设，揭示训练数据与测试数据之间影响的互逆性，并据此开发了一种新的高效影响估计方法，通过计算测试样本梯度结合训练样本前向传播来估计训练数据影响，在多个场景中验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有影响估计技术需要为每个训练点计算梯度或重复训练不同子集，在大规模数据和模型上面临显著的计算挑战。作者希望找到一种更高效的方法来估计训练数据对模型预测的影响。

Method: 提出镜像影响假设（Mirrored Influence Hypothesis），认为评估训练数据对测试预测的影响可以重新表述为等价但反向的问题：评估如果模型在特定测试样本上训练，训练样本的预测会如何改变。基于此，提出新方法：只需计算特定测试样本的梯度，再对每个训练点进行一次前向传播即可估计影响，利用测试样本数远小于训练样本数的非对称场景提升效率。

Result: 在扩散模型的数据归因、数据泄露检测、记忆化分析、错误标记数据检测以及语言模型行为追踪等多个场景中验证了方法的适用性和效率优势。

Conclusion: 通过理论和实证验证了镜像影响假设的广泛适用性，提出的方法相比现有方法在测试样本远少于训练样本的场景下显著提升了计算效率。

Abstract: Large-scale black-box models have become ubiquitous across numerous applications. Understanding the influence of individual training data sources on predictions made by these models is crucial for improving their trustworthiness. Current influence estimation techniques involve computing gradients for every training point or repeated training on different subsets. These approaches face obvious computational challenges when scaled up to large datasets and models.
  In this paper, we introduce and explore the Mirrored Influence Hypothesis, highlighting a reciprocal nature of influence between training and test data. Specifically, it suggests that evaluating the influence of training data on test predictions can be reformulated as an equivalent, yet inverse problem: assessing how the predictions for training samples would be altered if the model were trained on specific test samples. Through both empirical and theoretical validations, we demonstrate the wide applicability of our hypothesis. Inspired by this, we introduce a new method for estimating the influence of training data, which requires calculating gradients for specific test samples, paired with a forward pass for each training point. This approach can capitalize on the common asymmetry in scenarios where the number of test samples under concurrent examination is much smaller than the scale of the training dataset, thus gaining a significant improvement in efficiency compared to existing approaches.
  We demonstrate the applicability of our method across a range of scenarios, including data attribution in diffusion models, data leakage detection, analysis of memorization, mislabeled data detection, and tracing behavior in language models. Our code will be made available at https://github.com/ruoxi-jia-group/Forward-INF.

</details>


### [768] [Investigating the Histogram Loss in Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.13425)
*Ehsan Imani,Kai Luedemann,Sam Scholnick-Hughes,Esraa Elelimy,Martha White*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了直方图损失（Histogram Loss）在回归任务中的表现提升原因，发现其优势主要来源于优化改进而非额外信息建模，并证明了该方法在无需繁琐超参数调优的情况下适用于常见深度学习应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管在回归任务中仅需预测均值，但训练建模完整分布的神经网络已成为常见做法，且往往带来性能提升，其背后的原因尚未完全清楚。本文旨在探究这一现象的根本原因。

Method: 通过理论分析和实证研究，系统考察了Histogram Loss中各组件对性能提升的贡献机制，并在常见深度学习应用中验证其有效性。

Result: 学习分布带来的性能提升主要源于优化过程的改进，而非对额外信息的建模能力；Histogram Loss在无需昂贵超参数调优的条件下即可在常见深度学习任务中表现良好。

Conclusion: 分布学习在回归中的增益机制被归因于优化层面，Histogram Loss是一种实用且高效的回归方法。

Abstract: It is becoming increasingly common in regression to train neural networks that model the entire distribution even if only the mean is required for prediction. This additional modeling often comes with performance gain and the reasons behind the improvement are not fully known. This paper investigates a recent approach to regression, the Histogram Loss, which involves learning the conditional distribution of the target variable by minimizing the cross-entropy between a target distribution and a flexible histogram prediction. We design theoretical and empirical analyses to determine why and when this performance gain appears, and how different components of the loss contribute to it. Our results suggest that the benefits of learning distributions in this setup come from improvements in optimization rather than modelling extra information. We then demonstrate the viability of the Histogram Loss in common deep learning applications without a need for costly hyperparameter tuning.

</details>


### [769] [Are Classification Robustness and Explanation Robustness Really Strongly Correlated? An Analysis Through Input Loss Landscape](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.06013)
*Tiejin Chen,Wenwang Huang,Linsey Pang,Dongsheng Luo,Hua Wei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文挑战了图像分类中分类鲁棒性与解释鲁棒性必然相关的传统观点。通过基于聚类的解释鲁棒性评估方法和针对解释损失调整损失景观的新型训练方法，发现两者并非强相关：调整解释损失景观可影响解释鲁棒性，但不影响分类鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 质疑并验证图像分类系统中分类鲁棒性与解释鲁棒性之间是否存在内在关联这一普遍假设。

Method: 提出基于聚类的解释鲁棒性高效评估方法，并设计一种调整解释损失对应损失景观的新型训练方法。

Result: 增强解释鲁棒性并不必然使输入损失景观（关于解释损失）变得平坦；调整解释损失景观可影响解释鲁棒性，但对分类鲁棒性无影响。

Conclusion: 分类鲁棒性与解释鲁棒性之间不存在强相关关系，为理解损失景观与解释损失之间的关系开辟了新路径。

Abstract: This paper delves into the critical area of deep learning robustness, challenging the conventional belief that classification robustness and explanation robustness in image classification systems are inherently correlated. Through a novel evaluation approach leveraging clustering for efficient assessment of explanation robustness, we demonstrate that enhancing explanation robustness does not necessarily flatten the input loss landscape with respect to explanation loss - contrary to flattened loss landscapes indicating better classification robustness. To deeply investigate this contradiction, a groundbreaking training method designed to adjust the loss landscape with respect to explanation loss is proposed. Through the new training method, we uncover that although such adjustments can impact the robustness of explanations, they do not have an influence on the robustness of classification. These findings not only challenge the prevailing assumption of a strong correlation between the two forms of robustness but also pave new pathways for understanding relationship between loss landscape and explanation loss.

</details>


### [770] [Mean Teacher based SSL Framework for Indoor Localization Using Wi-Fi RSSI Fingerprinting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.13303)
*Sihao Li,Zhe Tang,Kyeong Soo Kim,Jeremy S. Smith*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于Mean Teacher的半监督学习（SSL）框架，用于Wi-Fi RSSI指纹室内定位，通过接入点选择、模型预训练/克隆和批量级噪声注入，有效利用标记/未标记数据，在静态和动态场景下显著提升深度神经网络定位模型的精度，在UJIIndoorLoc和XJTLU数据库上分别降低3D误差7.4%-7.7%和2D误差最高49.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于Wi-Fi RSSI指纹的大规模室内定位面临三个挑战：1) 有标签数据采集耗时耗力；2) 监督学习框架无法利用无标签数据，模型泛化能力有限；3) 动态环境下模型性能因环境变化而退化。

Method: 提出基于Mean Teacher的SSL框架，包含接入点选择、模型预训练/克隆和批量级噪声注入。离线阶段利用混合标记/未标记数据库进行静态训练；在线阶段利用系统部署后用户的无标签指纹数据进行连续重训练。Mean Teacher通过对模型权重的指数移动平均生成更稳定的目标标签，在性能和计算复杂度间取得平衡。

Result: 在UJIIndoorLoc数据库上，相比监督学习框架，CNNLoc模型和SIMO-DNN模型的平均3D误差分别降低7.403%和7.748%；在XJTLU动态数据库上，动态训练场景下平均2D误差最大降低49.227%。

Conclusion: 所提出的SSL框架能有效解决传统监督学习在室内定位中的数据标注瓶颈、泛化能力不足和动态环境性能退化问题，显著提升定位精度，且Mean Teacher相比Pi-Model和Temporal Ensembling具有更优的计算效率与在线学习可扩展性。

Abstract: Conventional large-scale indoor localization based on Wi-Fi RSSI fingerprinting faces issues of time-consuming and labor-intensive labeled data collection, limited generalization of a model trained under a supervised learning (SL) framework due to its inability to leverage unlabeled data, and model performance degradation in dynamic scenarios with environmental variations. To address those challenging issues, we propose a comprehensive semi-supervised learning (SSL) framework for a deep neural network (DNN) localization model based on the Mean Teacher, which incorporates access point selection, model pre-training/cloning, and batch-level noise injection. The proposed SSL framework can not only efficiently use hybrid labeled/unlabeled databases for static training of a model during the offline phase, but also exploit unlabeled fingerprints from users of the indoor localization system deployed in the field for continuous retraining of the model during the online phase. We base the proposed SSL framework on the Mean Teacher because it can generate more stable target labels through an exponential moving average of model weights without incurring the high computational complexity of the Pi-Model and with better scalability for online learning than Temporal Ensembling, making it an optimal choice that strikes the right balance between performance and computational complexity in large-scale indoor localization. With the UJIIndoorLoc database, the proposed SSL framework reduces the mean 3D errors of the CNNLoc and SIMO-DNN models by 7.403% and 7.748%, respectively, compared with those under the conventional SL framework; with the XJTLU dynamic database, the maximum reduction in mean 2D error reaches up to 49.227% under a dynamic training scenario, demonstrating the substantial performance improvement achieved by the proposed SSL framework.

</details>


### [771] [Federated Large Language Models: Current Progress and Future Directions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.15723)
*Yuhang Yao,Jianyi Zhang,Junda Wu,Chengkai Huang,Yu Xia,Tong Yu,Ruiyi Zhang,Sungchul Kim,Ryan Rossi,Ang Li,Lina Yao,Julian McAuley,Yiran Chen,Carlee Joe-Wong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 这篇综述系统梳理了联邦学习与大语言模型结合（FedLLM）的最新进展，重点涵盖联邦微调、联邦提示学习、联邦预训练和联邦智能体等方向，分析了数据异构性、收敛不稳定、通信开销和计算约束等核心挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型训练依赖集中式数据收集，存在严重的隐私和治理风险。联邦学习提供去中心化替代方案，但将FL与LLM结合面临数据异构、收敛不稳定、通信开销和计算约束等新挑战，亟需系统性的综述来梳理现有方法并指引未来方向。

Method: 采用系统性综述方法，对FedLLM领域最新研究进行全面梳理，重点关注联邦微调和联邦提示学习两大技术路线，并从效率、个性化和安全性三个维度分析现有方法的应对策略。

Result: 系统归纳了FedLLM中应对效率、个性化和安全挑战的各类方法，总结了联邦预训练和联邦智能体等新兴方向的研究进展。

Conclusion: 提供了FedLLM领域的结构化视角，指出了该快速发展领域中有前景的未来研究方向。

Abstract: Large Language Models have achieved impressive performance across diverse applications, yet their training typically depends on centralized data collection, raising serious privacy and governance concerns. Federated Learning offers a decentralized alternative by enabling multiple clients to collaboratively train shared models without exposing raw local data. However, integrating FL with LLMs introduces new challenges, including data heterogeneity, convergence instability, communication overhead, and computational constraints. This survey provides a comprehensive and up-to-date overview of Federated Learning for Large Language Models (FedLLM). We systematically review recent advances, with particular emphasis on federated fine-tuning and federated prompt learning, and analyze how existing methods address efficiency, personalization, and security challenges. We further summarize emerging directions such as federated pre-training and federated agents. Our goal is to offer a structured perspective on this rapidly evolving field and to highlight promising avenues for future research.

</details>


### [772] [Communication-Efficient Federated Learning under Dynamic Device Arrival and Departure: Convergence Analysis and Algorithm Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.05662)
*Zhan-Lun Chang,Dong-Jun Han,Seyyedali Hosseinalipour,Mung Chiang,Christopher G. Brinton*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种针对动态设备集联邦学习的模型初始化算法，通过梯度相似性加权平均历史全局模型，实现快速适应设备加入/离开，收敛速度提升一个数量级以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实联邦学习场景中设备会动态加入或离开（如用户移动、小区切换），导致优化目标随设备集变化而变化，且当前全局模型无法作为后续轮次的有效初始化，阻碍适应、延迟收敛、降低资源效率。

Method: 首先对动态设备集下的FL进行收敛分析，考虑梯度噪声、本地训练轮次和数据异质性。基于分析，提出模型初始化算法：通过梯度相似性计算历史全局模型的加权平均，优先选择与当前设备集数据分布对齐的模型，加速分布偏移的恢复。

Result: 实验表明该方法相比基线实现通常一个数量级以上的收敛加速，并显著降低达到目标精度所需的能量消耗。

Conclusion: 该插件式算法可无缝集成现有FL方法，具有广泛适用性，有效应对动态设备集带来的优化挑战。

Abstract: Most federated learning (FL) approaches assume a fixed device set. However, real-world scenarios often involve devices dynamically joining or leaving the system, driven by, e.g., user mobility patterns or handovers across cell boundaries. This dynamic setting introduces unique challenges: (1) the optimization objective evolves with the active device set, unlike traditional FL's static objective; and (2) the current global model may no longer serve as an effective initialization for subsequent rounds, potentially hindering adaptation, delaying convergence, and reducing resource efficiency. To address these challenges, we first provide a convergence analysis for FL under a dynamic device set, accounting for factors such as gradient noise, local training iterations, and data heterogeneity in this practical setting. Motivated by this analysis, we propose a model initialization algorithm that enables rapid adaptation whenever devices join or leave the network. Our key idea is to compute a weighted average of previous global models, guided by gradient similarity, to prioritize models trained on data distributions that closely align with the current device set, thereby accelerating recovery from distribution shifts in fewer training rounds. This plug-and-play algorithm is designed to integrate seamlessly with existing FL methods, offering broad applicability. Experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves convergence speedups typically an order of magnitude or more compared to baselines, which we show drastically reduces energy consumption to reach a target accuracy.

</details>


### [773] [Discovering Data Structures: Nearest Neighbor Search and Beyond](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.03253)
*Omar Salemohamed,Laurent Charlin,Shivam Garg,Vatsal Sharan,Gregory Valiant*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种端到端学习数据结构的通用框架，该框架可以从头学习数据结构，无需人工初始化或候选算法，在近邻搜索和流数据频率估计等任务中自动发现或逼近最优算法（如二分搜索、KD树、LSH等）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统数据结构设计依赖人工专家经验和先验假设，难以自动适配底层数据分布，且无法在查询复杂度与空间复杂度之间进行细粒度的自动权衡。

Method: 提出一种端到端可微的通用框架，直接从数据中学习数据结构，无需预定义候选结构或算法初始化，框架可自动适应数据分布，并在查询与空间复杂度之间提供细粒度控制。

Result: 在1D近邻搜索中，模型自动发现了最优的分布无关/相关算法（如二分搜索、插值搜索变体）；在高维空间中，模型学到类似KD树或局部敏感哈希（LSH）的解决方案，并能学习高维数据的有效表示来设计高效数据结构；在流数据频率估计任务中同样有效。

Conclusion: 该框架是一种通用的数据结构的自动发现工具，能够在多个任务中从头学习到接近甚至等价于人工设计最优解的数据结构与查询算法，有望成为新问题的强大发现工具。

Abstract: We propose a general framework for end-to-end learning of data structures. Our framework adapts to the underlying data distribution and provides fine-grained control over query and space complexity. Crucially, the data structure is learned from scratch, and does not require careful initialization or seeding with candidate data structures/algorithms. We first apply this framework to the problem of nearest neighbor search. In several settings, we are able to reverse-engineer the learned data structures and query algorithms. For 1D nearest neighbor search, the model discovers optimal distribution (in)dependent algorithms such as binary search and variants of interpolation search. In higher dimensions, the model learns solutions that resemble k-d trees in some regimes, while in others, they have elements of locality-sensitive hashing. The model can also learn useful representations of high-dimensional data and exploit them to design effective data structures. We also adapt our framework to the problem of estimating frequencies over a data stream, and believe it could also be a powerful discovery tool for new problems.

</details>


### [774] [Modeling Stochastic Conditional Dynamics from Sparse Observations via Kernel-Stabilized Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.08314)
*Adam P. Generale,Andreas E. Robertson,Surya R. Kalidindi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出条件变量流匹配（CVFM）框架，用于从稀疏、未配对的连续条件数据中学习概率密度随时间演化的转换，通过联合采样状态与条件变量流、引入条件不匹配核与条件Wasserstein距离重加权，解决了现有方法高方差不稳定的问题，在条件映射基准和材料制造过程内部结构演化案例中表现更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在随机非线性动力系统的预测中，现有流模型通常假设离散条件且样本跨时间配对，这限制了其在科学领域的应用，因为实际中常只有稀疏的、未配对的连续条件数据可用。

Method: 提出条件变量流匹配（CVFM）框架，通过联合采样状态变量和条件变量的流，利用条件不匹配核与条件Wasserstein距离对条件最优传输目标进行重加权，实现条件概率密度转换的摊销学习。

Result: 在条件映射基准测试和材料制造过程中内部结构时间演化的案例研究中，CVFM相比现有条件变体方法展现出更好的性能和收敛特性。

Conclusion: CVFM框架能够从稀疏未配对的测量数据中学习动力学过程，有效解决了高方差不稳定性问题，拓展了流模型在科学领域中的应用范围。

Abstract: Learning to transform conditional probability densities over time is a fundamental challenge spanning probabilistic modeling and the natural sciences. This task is paramount when forecasting the evolution of stochastic nonlinear dynamical systems in biological and physical domains. While flow-based models can predict the temporal evolution of probability distributions, existing approaches often assume discrete conditioning with samples that are paired across time, limiting their scientific applicability where frequently only sparse data with unpaired continuous conditioning is available. We propose Conditional Variable Flow Matching (CVFM), a framework for learning flows transforming conditional distributions with amortization across the continuous space of conditional densities. CVFM addresses the high-variance instability of prior methods by jointly sampling flows over state and conditioning variables, utilizing a conditioning mismatch kernel alongside a conditional Wasserstein distance to reweight the conditional optimal transport objective. Collectively, these advances allow for learning dynamics from sparse unpaired measurements of state-condition across time. We evaluate CVFM on conditional mapping benchmarks and a case study modeling the temporal evolution of materials internal structure during manufacturing processes, observing improved performance and convergence characteristics over existing conditional variants. Code is available at https://github.com/agenerale/conditional-variable-flow-matching.

</details>


### [775] [Zero and Few Shot Load Forecasting with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.11350)
*Wenlong Liao,Chengrui Zhang,Zhe Yang,Mengshuo Jia,Christian Rehtanz,Jiannong Fang,Fernando Porté-Agel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出利用预训练大语言模型Chronos实现零样本和少样本电力负荷预测，在数据稀缺场景下显著优于9种基线模型，RMSE降低7.34%-84.30%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习负荷预测模型依赖大量训练数据，在数据稀缺场景下效果受限，亟需一种不依赖大量场景特定数据的预测方法。

Method: 借鉴预训练语言模型在NLP中的成功经验，将Chronos框架（一种先进的大语言模型）直接应用于负荷预测，无需针对特定负荷数据集进行微调或定制。

Result: 在5个真实世界数据集上，Chronos在确定性和概率性负荷预测中全面超越9种基线模型，RMSE降低7.34%-84.30%，CRPS降低19.63%-60.06%，QS降低22.83%-54.49%。

Conclusion: Chronos模型凭借其预训练知识，在数据稀缺场景下表现出优异的预测性能和灵活性，是负荷预测的有效解决方案。

Abstract: Deep learning models have shown strong performance in load forecasting, but they generally require large amounts of data for model training before being applied to new scenarios, which limits their effectiveness in data-scarce scenarios. Inspired by the great success of pre-trained language models (LLMs) in natural language processing, this paper proposes a zero and few shot load forecasting approach using an advanced LLM framework denoted as the Chronos model. By utilizing its extensive pre-trained knowledge, the Chronos model enables accurate load forecasting in data-scarce scenarios. Simulation results across five real-world datasets demonstrate that the Chronos model significantly outperforms nine popular baseline models for both deterministic and probabilistic load forecasting with various forecast horizons (e.g., 1 to 48 hours), even though the Chronos model is neither tailored nor fine-tuned to these specific load datasets. Notably, Chronos reduces root mean squared error (RMSE), continuous ranked probability score (CRPS), and quantile score (QS) by approximately 7.34%-84.30%, 19.63%-60.06%, and 22.83%-54.49%, respectively, compared to baseline models. These results highlight the superiority and flexibility of the Chronos model, positioning it as an effective solution in data-scarce scenarios.

</details>


### [776] [BlendServe: Optimizing Offline Inference for Auto-regressive Large Models with Resource-aware Batching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.16102)
*Yilong Zhao,Shuo Yang,Kan Zhu,Lianmin Zheng,Baris Kasikci,Yang Zhou,Jiarong Xing,Ion Stoica*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BlendServe通过资源感知的前缀树结合资源重叠与前缀共享，在离线批量推理中实现高达1.44倍的吞吐量提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线批量推理中，请求的多模态特性导致计算和内存需求多样化，资源重叠可提升吞吐量，但最大化资源重叠与最大化前缀共享的调度策略存在冲突，导致次优推理性能。

Method: 提出BlendServe系统，利用资源感知的前缀树（resource-aware prefix tree），在离线批量推理的宽松延迟约束下，重新排序和重叠具有不同资源需求的请求，同时确保高前缀共享。

Result: 在多种合成多模态工作负载上，相比vLLM和SGLang等工业标准，提供高达1.44倍的吞吐量提升。

Conclusion: BlendServe有效结合了资源重叠和前缀共享两种优化策略，证明了在离线批量推理场景下通过合理调度可以同时获得两者的收益。

Abstract: Offline batch inference, which leverages the flexibility of request batching to achieve higher throughput and lower costs, is becoming more popular for latency-insensitive applications. Meanwhile, recent progress in model capability and modality makes requests more diverse in compute and memory demands, creating unique opportunities for throughput improvement by resource overlapping. However, a request schedule that maximizes resource overlapping can conflict with the schedule that maximizes prefix sharing, a widely-used performance optimization, causing sub-optimal inference throughput. We present BlendServe, a system that maximizes resource utilization of offline batch inference by combining the benefits of resource overlapping and prefix sharing using a resource-aware prefix tree. BlendServe exploits the relaxed latency requirements in offline batch inference to reorder and overlap requests with varied resource demands while ensuring high prefix sharing. We evaluate BlendServe on a variety of synthetic multi-modal workloads and show that it provides up to $1.44\times$ throughput boost compared to widely-used industry standards, vLLM and SGLang.

</details>


### [777] [Graph-to-SFILES: Control structure prediction from process topologies using generative artificial intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.00508)
*Lukas Schulze Balhorn,Kevin Degens,Artur M. Schweidtmann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Graph-to-SFILES模型，利用图编码器（含新GNN）从流程图拓扑预测控制结构，在小型数据集上显著优于序列方法（top-5准确率28.4% vs 0.9%），大型数据集表现不如序列方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 控制结构设计是P&ID开发中重要但繁琐的步骤，现有生成式AI方法多基于序列表示，未能充分利用流程图的图结构特性（排列不变性），因此急需探索基于图的生成方法以提高开发效率。

Method: 提出Graph-to-SFILES模型：以流程图拓扑为图输入，经四种图编码器架构（含新提出的GNN）编码后，输出以SFILES 2.0记号表示的控制扩展流程图序列。

Result: 在10,000个流程图拓扑上训练达到73.2% top-5准确率；新GNN在编码器架构中表现最优；在1,000个流程图小数据集上，top-5准确率从序列方法的0.9%提升至28.4%；但在100,000个流程图大规模数据集上，序列方法表现更优。

Conclusion: 基于图的AI模型在小数据场景下能显著加速P&ID开发，但在工业规模案例中的有效性仍需进一步验证。

Abstract: Control structure design is an important but tedious step in P&ID development. Generative artificial intelligence (AI) promises to reduce P&ID development time by supporting engineers. Previous research on generative AI in chemical process design mainly represented processes by sequences. However, graphs offer a promising alternative because of their permutation invariance. We propose the Graph-to-SFILES model, a generative AI method to predict control structures from flowsheet topologies. The Graph-to-SFILES model takes the flowsheet topology as a graph input and returns a control-extended flowsheet as a sequence in the SFILES 2.0 notation. We compare four different graph encoder architectures, one of them being a graph neural network (GNN) proposed in this work. The Graph-to-SFILES model achieves a top-5 accuracy of 73.2% when trained on 10,000 flowsheet topologies. In addition, the proposed GNN performs best among the encoder architectures. Compared to a purely sequence-based approach, the Graph-to-SFILES model improves the top-5 accuracy for a relatively small training dataset of 1,000 flowsheets from 0.9% to 28.4%. However, the sequence-based approach performs better on a large-scale dataset of 100,000 flowsheets. These results highlight the potential of graph-based AI models to accelerate P&ID development in small-data regimes but their effectiveness on industry relevant case studies still needs to be investigated.

</details>


### [778] [Advancements in Machine Learning and Deep Learning for Early Detection and Management of Mental Health Disorder](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.06147)
*Kamala Devi Kannan,Senthil Kumar Jagatheesaperumal,Rajesh N. V. P. S. Kandala,Mojtaba Lotfaliany,Roohallah Alizadehsanid,Mohammadreza Mohebbi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文综述了机器学习和深度学习在精神健康障碍早期识别、诊断和治疗中的应用，涵盖医学影像、遗传学和行为评估等多模态数据，分析了其在抑郁症、双相障碍和精神分裂症等疾病中的诊断效果，同时讨论了数据整合、方法学不一致性和伦理挑战等关键问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 利用ML和DL技术改善精神健康障碍的早期识别、诊断和治疗效果，同时解决数据整合和伦理方面的独特挑战。

Method: 对现有ML和DL方法在精神健康领域的应用进行系统性综述，重点分析医学影像、遗传与生物标志物分析、行为评估三个方向，以及风险预测模型和纵向研究等预测建模方法。

Result: ML和DL能够提升诊断准确率和治疗效果，但在方法学一致性、数据融合和伦理问题上仍存在显著挑战。

Conclusion: 未来研究应聚焦于构建实时监控系统以支持个性化治疗、改进数据融合技术，并加强跨学科合作，以克服当前障碍，实现ML和DL在精神健康服务中的有价值且合乎伦理的应用。

Abstract: For the early identification, diagnosis, and treatment of mental health illnesses, the integration of deep learning (DL) and machine learning (ML) have started playing a significant role. By evaluating complex data from imaging, genetics, and behavioral assessments, these technologies have the potential to improve clinical results significantly. However, they also present unique challenges relating to data integration and ethical issues. The development of ML and DL methods for the early diagnosis and treatment of mental health issues is reviewed in this survey. It examines a range of applications, with a particular emphasis on behavioral assessments, genetic and biomarker analysis, and medical imaging for the diagnosis of diseases like depression, bipolar disorder, and schizophrenia. Predictive modeling for illness development is further discussed in the review, focusing on the function of risk prediction models and longitudinal investigations. Important discoveries show how ML and DL might improve treatment outcomes and diagnostic accuracy while tackling methodological inconsistency, data integration, and ethical concerns. The study emphasizes the significance of building real-time monitoring systems for individualized treatment, improving data fusion techniques, and interdisciplinary collaboration. Upcoming studies should concentrate on surmounting these obstacles to maximize ML and DL's valuable and moral implementation in mental health services.

</details>


### [779] [Adaptive Prior Selection in Gaussian Process Bandits with Thompson Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.01226)
*Jack Sandberg,Morteza Haghir Chehreghani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了在GP bandits中联合先验选择与遗憾最小化的两种算法（PE-GP-TS和HP-GP-TS），其中HP-GP-TS具有次线性遗憾界理论保证，实验验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GP bandits方法大多假设GP先验已知，而实际中这一假设不成立，通常使用的最大似然估计缺乏理论保证。

Method: 提出了两种基于GP Thompson sampling的算法：PE-GP-TS（剔除预测性能差的先验）和HP-GP-TS（使用双层Thompson采样机制）。

Result: 为HP-GP-TS建立了次线性遗憾界理论保证，并通过合成与真实数据的实验验证了算法有效性。

Conclusion: HP-GP-TS在理论上具有可证明的次线性遗憾界，两种算法在实际中均优于现有替代方案。

Abstract: Gaussian process (GP) bandits provide a powerful framework for performing blackbox optimization of unknown functions. The characteristics of the unknown function depend heavily on the assumed GP prior. Most work in the literature assume that this prior is known but in practice this seldom holds. Instead, practitioners often rely on maximum likelihood estimation to select the hyperparameters of the prior - which lacks theoretical guarantees. In this work, we study two algorithms for joint prior selection and regret minimization in GP bandits based on GP Thompson sampling (GP-TS): Prior-Elimination GP-TS (PE-GP-TS) that disqualifies priors with poor predictive performance, and HyperPrior GP-TS (HP-GP-TS) that utilizes a bi-level Thompson sampling scheme. We theoretically analyze the algorithms and establish a sublinear regret bound for HP-GP-TS. In addition, we demonstrate the effectiveness of these algorithms compared to the alternatives through extensive experiments with synthetic and real-world data.

</details>


### [780] [AccioScene: Compositional 3D Scene Generation via Graph Diffusion and Interaction-driven Critics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.06819)
*Yao Wei,Matteo Toso,Pietro Morerio,Changjae Oh,Michael Ying Yang,Alessio Del Bue*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种多阶段文本生成3D室内场景框架，通过图扩散生成场景图、预测物体布局，并引入人-物交互先验和空间约束，生成物理上更合理、支持人机交互的3D场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法将场景合成建模为基于单一输入模态（如文本、房间形状或场景图）的物体布局预测问题，导致物体碰撞、功能合理性有限，实际适用性不足。

Method: 多阶段流水线：1）基于文本提示，通过图扩散生成上下文一致的场景图；2）预测物体布局；3）引入轻量级人-物交互先验以鼓励以人为中心和功能合理的布局；4）显式空间约束减少物体穿插。

Result: 在3D-FRONT数据集上达到与现有方法相当或SOTA的性能，同时提升了生成场景的物理合理性。

Conclusion: 该方法生成的3D场景布局连贯、支持人类交互，具有更好的物理合理性和实际应用价值。

Abstract: This paper presents a framework for generating 3D indoor scenes from text prompts. Existing methods often formulate scene synthesis as an object layout prediction problem conditioned on a single input modality, such as a text description, room shape, or scene graph. This design can lead to object collisions and limited functional plausibility, reducing its practical applicability. To address these limitations, we introduce a multi-stage pipeline that better reflects practical scene creation scenarios. Given a text prompt describing partial scene content, our method first uses graph diffusion to produce a contextually coherent scene graph and then predicts a realistic object layout. In addition, we incorporate lightweight human-object interaction priors to encourage human-centric and functional arrangements, with explicit spatial constraints to reduce interpenetration. Our approach generates coherent 3D scenes with viable layouts that better support human interaction. Experiments on the 3D-FRONT dataset demonstrate that our method achieves competitive or state-of-the-art performance compared with existing approaches, while improving the physical plausibility of generated scenes.

</details>


### [781] [In-Context Learning of Stochastic Differential Equations with Foundation Inference Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.19049)
*Patrick Seifner,Kostadin Cvejoski,David Berghaus,Cesar Ojeda,Ramses J. Sanchez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FIM-SDE，一种预训练的识别模型，能够从含噪时间序列数据中对低维随机微分方程的漂移和扩散函数进行零样本估计，且可快速微调以适应目标数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从数据中准确估计SDE的漂移和扩散函数是机器学习中的核心问题，现有方法要么严重依赖动力学先验知识，要么涉及复杂的训练流程，缺乏高效且通用的解决方案。

Method: 利用摊销推理和神经算子概念，通过监督方式预训练FIM-SDE，将大量含噪、离散观测的SDE路径映射到漂移和扩散函数空间，实现上下文内（零样本）估计。

Result: 在多种合成和真实过程（双阱动力学、弱扰动洛伦兹吸引子、股票价格、石油价格、风速波动等）上，FIM-SDE实现了鲁棒的上下文内函数估计，性能匹配符号回归、高斯过程和神经SDE基线；微调后一致超越所有基线。

Conclusion: FIM-SDE提供了一种高效、通用的SDE函数估计框架，兼具零样本推理能力和微调灵活性。

Abstract: Stochastic differential equations (SDEs) describe dynamical systems where deterministic flows, governed by a drift function, are superimposed with random fluctuations, dictated by a diffusion function. The accurate estimation (or discovery) of these functions from data is a central problem in machine learning, with wide application across the natural and social sciences. Yet current solutions either rely heavily on prior knowledge of the dynamics or involve intricate training procedures. We introduce FIM-SDE (Foundation Inference Model for SDEs), a pretrained recognition model that delivers accurate in-context (or zero-shot) estimation of the drift and diffusion functions of low-dimensional SDEs, from noisy time series data, and allows rapid finetuning to target datasets. Leveraging concepts from amortized inference and neural operators, we (pre)train FIM-SDE in a supervised fashion to map a large set of noisy, discretely observed SDE paths onto the space of drift and diffusion functions. We demonstrate that FIM-SDE achieves robust in-context function estimation across a wide range of synthetic and real-world processes -- from canonical SDE systems (e.g., double-well dynamics or weakly perturbed Lorenz attractors) to stock price recordings and oil-price and wind-speed fluctuations -- while matching the performance of symbolic, Gaussian process and Neural SDE baselines trained on the target datasets. When finetuned to the target processes, we show that FIM-SDE consistently outperforms all these baselines.

</details>


### [782] [phepy: Visual benchmarks and improvements for out-of-distribution detectors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.05169)
*Felix Krumbiegel,Juniper Tyree,Michael Boy,Petri Clusius,Andreas Rupp*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对高维稀疏或偏斜数据中模型在分布外（OOD）输入上预测失效的问题，设计了一个包含三个可视化玩具示例的OOD检测基准，用于评估线性/非线性概念检测及高维空间中的细条ID子空间识别能力，并提出了t-poking和OOD样本加权两种改进方法以提升有监督检测器在ID-OOD边界的精度，最终给出了OOD检测器的构建与应用建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维机器学习模型在训练数据稀疏或偏斜时，容易在分布外（OOD）输入上产生不可控的错误，而现有OOD检测方法在真实数据集上测试复杂，缺乏直观且可控的评估基准。

Method: 设计包含三个可视化玩具示例的基准（检测线性/非线性概念、高维空间中的细条ID子空间）；提出t-poking和OOD样本加权两种改进方法，以解决真实ID样本与合成OOD样本之间的边界模糊问题。

Result: 通过玩具基准评估了多种现有方法；t-poking和OOD样本加权使有监督检测器在ID-OOD边界上的精度得到提升。

Conclusion: 提供了构建和应用OOD检测器的实用建议，强调玩具示例对直观理解检测能力的重要性，以及合成OOD样本的精细处理对边界精度的影响。

Abstract: Applying machine learning to increasingly high-dimensional problems with sparse or biased training data increases the risk that a model is used on inputs outside its training domain. For such out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs, the model can no longer make valid predictions, and its error is potentially unbounded. Since testing OOD detection methods on real-world datasets is complicated, we design a benchmark for OOD detection, which includes three novel and easily-visualisable toy examples. These simple examples provide direct and intuitive insight into whether the detector is able to detect (1) linear and (2) non-linear concepts and (3) identify thin in-distribution (ID) subspaces (needles) within high-dimensional spaces (haystacks). We use our benchmark to evaluate the performance of various methods from the literature. Since tactile examples of OOD inputs may benefit OOD detection, we also review several simple methods to synthesise OOD inputs for supervised training. We introduce two improvements, $t$-poking and OOD sample weighting, to make supervised detectors more precise at the ID-OOD boundary. This is especially important when conflicts between real ID and synthetic OOD sample blur the decision boundary. Finally, we provide recommendations for constructing and applying OOD detectors in machine learning.

</details>


### [783] [LoTUS: Large-Scale Machine Unlearning with a Taste of Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.18314)
*Christoforos N. Spartalis,Theodoros Semertzidis,Petros Daras,Efstratios Gavves*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LoTUS 是一种新颖的机器遗忘方法，通过信息论界限平滑模型预测概率来消除预训练模型中训练样本的影响，避免从头重新训练，在多个数据集和模型上优于现有方法，并引入了无需重新训练的 RF-JSD 评估指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器遗忘方法在效率与效果上存在不足，尤其在大型数据集（如 ImageNet1k）上重新训练不切实际，且模型因数据记忆而产生过度自信问题需要解决。

Method: LoTUS 通过信息论界限平滑模型的预测概率，抑制模型对训练数据的记忆导致的过度自信，从而实现样本影响消除。

Result: 在 Transformer 和 ResNet18 模型上，针对五个公开数据集（包括 ImageNet1k）的实验表明，LoTUS 在效率和效果上均优于八种基线方法。

Conclusion: LoTUS 提出了一种高效且有效的机器遗忘方案，结合新的 RF-JSD 评估指标，使得在大规模真实场景下无需重新训练即可评估遗忘效果。

Abstract: We present LoTUS, a novel Machine Unlearning (MU) method that eliminates the influence of training samples from pre-trained models, avoiding retraining from scratch. LoTUS smooths the prediction probabilities of the model up to an information-theoretic bound, mitigating its over-confidence stemming from data memorization. We evaluate LoTUS on Transformer and ResNet18 models against eight baselines across five public datasets. Beyond established MU benchmarks, we evaluate unlearning on ImageNet1k, a large-scale dataset, where retraining is impractical, simulating real-world conditions. Moreover, we introduce the novel Retrain-Free Jensen-Shannon Divergence (RF-JSD) metric to enable evaluation under real-world conditions. The experimental results show that LoTUS outperforms state-of-the-art methods in terms of both efficiency and effectiveness. Code: https://github.com/cspartalis/LoTUS.

</details>


### [784] [Enhancing Strawberry Yield Forecasting with Backcasted IoT Sensor Data and Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.18451)
*Tewodros Alemu Ayall,Andy Li,Matthew Beddows,Milan Markovic,Georgios Leontidis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究通过在草莓生产隧道中部署物联网传感器收集两个生长季的环境和操作数据，并结合四个生长季的人工产量记录，利用AI反向预测方法合成缺失的传感器数据，证明将合成数据与真实数据结合训练可显著提高产量预测模型的准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全球人口快速增长需要数字化农业系统支持可持续粮食生产，但AI产量预测模型的效果常受限于动态农场环境中数据可用性不足的问题，尤其是物联网观测数据需要多个生长季积累。

Method: 在草莓生产隧道中部署IoT传感器（收集用水量、温湿度、土壤湿度/温度、光合有效辐射等），结合四个生长季的人工产量数据；针对两个无传感器覆盖的生长季，开发基于AI的反向预测方法，利用邻近气象站历史数据和现有隧道测量数据合成缺失传感器观测；分别训练基于真实数据、合成数据及两者结合的产量预测模型并进行回顾性评估。

Result: 结合真实数据与合成数据训练的模型在产量预测准确性上优于仅使用真实传感器、天气和产量数据的模型。

Conclusion: AI反向预测合成的传感器数据能有效弥补物联网数据缺口，提升产量预测模型的性能，为数据有限的动态农场环境提供可行解决方案。

Abstract: Rapid global population growth underscores the need for digitally enabled agricultural systems that support sustainable food production and data-driven resource management for farmers and stakeholders. The adoption of Internet of Things (IoT) technologies, capable of capturing real-time environmental (e.g., temperature, humidity) and operational (e.g., irrigation) parameters, is a crucial step toward enabling advanced applications such as AI-based yield forecasting. However, the effectiveness of such models is often constrained by limited data availability, particularly in dynamic farm environments where IoT observations must be accumulated over multiple growing seasons. In this study, we deployed IoT sensors in strawberry production polytunnels over two growing seasons to collect data on water usage, internal and external temperature and humidity, soil moisture, soil temperature, and photosynthetically active radiation. These observations were combined with manually recorded yield data spanning four seasons. To address gaps in IoT data for the two seasons without sensor coverage, we developed an AI-based backcasting approach that synthesizes missing sensor observations using historical weather data from a nearby station and existing polytunnel measurements. We then trained AI-based yield forecasting models using both real and synthetic datasets. In this retrospective evaluation, results show that incorporating synthetic data improved yield forecasting accuracy, with models trained on the combined dataset outperforming those using only real sensor, weather, and yield data.

</details>


### [785] [LLMSynthor: Macro-Aligned Micro-Records Synthesis with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.14752)
*Yihong Tang,Menglin Kong,Junlin He,Tong Nie,Wei Ma,Lijun Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LLMSynthor利用预训练大语言模型作为宏观感知模拟器，通过迭代生成微观记录并与目标宏观统计量对齐，解决了大规模微观数据不可获取的问题。该方法将LLM视为非参数Copula，结合LLM提案采样高效生成真实且统计一致的合成数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 宏观对齐的微观记录对社会科学和城市研究的可信模拟至关重要（如流行病模型需要个体层面的移动和接触数据与宏观统计数据一致），但大规模收集此类细粒度数据不可行，研究人员仅有宏观数据可用。

Method: 将预训练LLM转化为宏观感知模拟器，迭代构建合成数据集：每步让LLM生成一批记录以最小化合成聚合与目标聚合之间的差异；将LLM视为非参数Copula以捕捉变量间的真实联合依赖关系；提出LLM提案采样（LLM Proposal Sampling）指导LLM生成有针对性的记录批次，指定变量范围和数量以高效纠正差异并保持模型先验的现实性。

Result: 在移动性、电子商务、人口等多个领域的评估表明，LLMSynthor实现了强现实性、统计保真度和实用效用。

Conclusion: LLMSynthor可广泛应用于经济学、社会科学和城市研究领域。

Abstract: Macro-aligned micro-records are crucial for credible simulations in social science and urban studies. For example, epidemic models are only reliable when individual-level mobility and contacts mirror real behavior, while aggregates match real-world statistics like case counts or travel flows. However, collecting such fine-grained data at scale is impractical, leaving researchers with only macro-level data. LLMSynthor addresses this by turning a pretrained LLM into a macro-aware simulator that generates realistic micro-records consistent with target macro-statistics. It iteratively builds synthetic datasets: in each step, the LLM generates batches of records to minimize discrepancies between synthetic and target aggregates. Treating the LLM as a nonparametric copula allows the model to capture realistic joint dependencies among variables. To improve efficiency, LLM Proposal Sampling guides the LLM to propose targeted record batches, specifying variable ranges and counts, to efficiently correct discrepancies while preserving realism grounded in the model's priors. Evaluations across domains (mobility, e-commerce, population) show that LLMSynthor achieves strong realism, statistical fidelity, and practical utility, making it broadly applicable to economics, social science, and urban studies.

</details>


### [786] [SpectraLDS: Provable Distillation for Linear Dynamical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.17868)
*Devan Shah,Shlomo Fortgang,Sofiia Druchyna,Elad Hazan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SpectraLDS，首个可证明的对称线性动态系统识别方法，其精度保证与系统状态维度或有效记忆无关，通过将对称LDS表示为可学习的卷积并反转该表示，实现端到端凸优化，推理时达到常时间和常空间复杂度，在语言建模等任务上保持精度同时提升推理效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LDS识别方法的精度保证依赖于状态维度或有效记忆长度，缺乏可证明的、与这些参数无关的识别方法，且推理效率随序列长度线性增长。

Method: 将对称LDS表示为可通过固定谱变换学习的卷积，然后反转该谱变换表示以恢复LDS模型，构建端到端凸优化流程。

Result: 实现了与状态维度和有效记忆无关的精度保证，推理时达到常时间和常空间复杂度（与序列长度无关），在语言建模等任务中保持预测精度。

Conclusion: SpectraLDS作为序列预测架构的组件，能够在提升推理效率的同时保持准确性，为高效序列建模提供了理论保证的新途径。

Abstract: We present the first provable method for identifying symmetric linear dynamical systems (LDS) with accuracy guarantees that are independent of the systems' state dimension or effective memory. Our approach builds upon recent work that represents symmetric LDSs as convolutions learnable via fixed spectral transformations. We show how to invert this representation, thereby recovering an LDS model from its spectral transform and yielding an end-to-end convex optimization procedure. This distillation preserves predictive accuracy while enabling constant-time and constant-space inference per token, independent of sequence length. We evaluate our method, SpectraLDS, as a component in sequence prediction architectures and demonstrate that accuracy is preserved while inference efficiency is improved on tasks such as language modeling.

</details>


### [787] [ePC: Fast and Deep Predictive Coding in Digital Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.20137)
*Cédric Goemaere,Gaspard Oliviers,Rafal Bogacz,Thomas Demeester*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出error-based PC (ePC)方法，解决了标准predictive coding (sPC)在数字仿真中信号指数衰减导致训练效率低下的根本问题，在多种架构和数据集上匹配反向传播性能，且比sPC快数个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准predictive coding (sPC)在数字仿真中存在严重的硬件-算法不匹配问题，信号指数衰减导致训练停滞，无法扩展到深层架构，计算开销巨大。

Method: 提出error-based PC (ePC)，通过重新参数化PC公式，避免信号指数衰减，数值上精确计算PC权重梯度。

Result: ePC比sPC快数个数量级，在多种架构和数据集上匹配反向传播性能，能处理sPC无法胜任的深层模型。

Conclusion: 揭示了sPC在数字仿真中的根本效率缺陷，ePC为PC方法扩展到深层架构和数字硬件提供了理论基础和实用方案。

Abstract: Predictive Coding (PC) offers a brain-inspired alternative to backpropagation for neural network training, described as a physical system minimizing its internal energy. However, in practice, PC is predominantly digitally simulated, requiring excessive amounts of compute while struggling to scale to deeper architectures. This paper reformulates PC to overcome this hardware-algorithm mismatch. First, we uncover how the canonical state-based formulation of PC (sPC) is, by design, deeply inefficient in digital simulation, inevitably resulting in exponential signal decay that stalls the entire minimization process. Then, to overcome this fundamental limitation, we introduce error-based PC (ePC), a novel reparameterization of PC which does not suffer from signal decay.
