Although POET provides strong training stability, its original implementation incurs high memory consumption and computational overhead due to intensive matrix multiplications. To overcome these limitations, we introduce POET-X, a scalable and memory-efficient variant that performs orthogonal equivalence transformations with significantly reduced computational cost. POET-X maintains the generalization and stability benefits of POET while achieving substantial improvements in throughput and memory efficiency. In our experiments, POET-X enables the pretraining of billion-parameter LLMs on a single Nvidia H100 GPU, and in contrast, standard optimizers such as AdamW run out of memory under the same settings.

</details>


### [866] [Integral Formulas for Vector Signal Tensor Products](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.08630)
*Valentin Heyraud,Zachary Weller-Davies,Jules Tilly*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文推导了Vector Signal Tensor Product的积分公式，获得了反对称Gaunt系数的闭式表达式，实现了用单个Vector Signal Tensor Product模拟Clebsch-Gordan Tensor Product，减少了最多9倍的计算量，并探讨了Gaunt与Vector Signal Tensor Product在表达性-运行时间权衡中的作用，以及低秩分解方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 简化Xie等人提出的Vector Signal Tensor Product，获得反对称Gaunt系数的显式闭式表达式，从而更高效地实现该算子，为其在SO(3)-等变神经网络中的应用铺平道路。

Method: 推导积分公式获得反对称Gaunt系数的显式闭式表达式；利用单个Vector Signal Tensor Product模拟Clebsch-Gordan Tensor Product；分析Gaunt和Vector Signal Tensor Product在表达性-运行时间权衡中的作用；研究相关张量积归一化后的低秩分解。

Result: 获得了反对称Gaunt系数的闭式表达式；实现了用单个Vector Signal Tensor Product替代Clebsch-Gordan Tensor Product，减少了最多9倍的计算量。

Conclusion: 所提方法使Vector Signal Tensor Product的实现更高效实用，为Gaunt Tensor Product在SO(3)-等变神经网络中的泛化应用奠定了基础；同时揭示了Gaunt和Vector Signal Tensor Product在控制表达性与运行时间权衡方面的作用。

Abstract: We derive integral formulas that simplify the Vector Signal Tensor Product recently introduced by Xie et al., which generalizes the Gaunt tensor product to anti-symmetric couplings. In particular, we obtain explicit closed-form expressions for the anti-symmetric analogues of the Gaunt coefficients. This enables us to simulate the Clebsch-Gordan tensor product using a single Vector Signal Tensor Product, yielding up to a $9\times$ reduction in the required tensor product evaluations. Our results enable efficient and practical implementations of the Vector Signal Tensor Product, paving the way for applications of this generalization of Gaunt Tensor Products in $\mathrm{SO}(3)$-equivariant neural networks. Moreover, we discuss how the Gaunt and the Vector Signal Tensor Products allow to control the expressivity-runtime tradeoff associated with the usual Clebsch-Gordan Tensor Products. Finally, we investigate low rank decompositions of the normalizations of the considered tensor products in view of their use in equivariant neural networks.

</details>


### [867] [Graph-GRPO: Training Graph Flow Models with Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.10395)
*Baoheng Zhu,Deyu Bo,Delvin Ce Zhang,Xiao Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Graph-GRPO是一个在线强化学习框架，用于在可验证奖励下训练图流模型（GFM），通过推导GFM转移概率的解析表达式实现完全可微的强化学习训练，并提出节点/边扰动再生策略实现局部探索与自我改进，在分子优化任务上达到最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管基于离散流匹配的图生成模型（GFM）在性能上表现优异且支持灵活采样，但如何有效地将GFM与复杂的人类偏好或特定任务目标对齐仍是一个重大挑战。

Method: (1) 推导了GFM转移概率的解析表达式，替代蒙特卡洛采样，使强化学习训练的全过程可微；(2) 提出细化策略，通过随机扰动图中的特定节点和边并重新生成，实现局部探索和生成质量的自我改进。

Result: 仅用50步去噪，在平面图和树数据集上分别达到95.0%和97.5%的Valid-Unique-Novelty分数；在分子优化任务上达到最先进性能，超越基于图、基于片段的强化学习方法以及经典遗传算法。

Conclusion: Graph-GRPO证明了通过在线强化学习框架和可微的GFM转移概率，能够有效对齐图流模型与复杂任务目标，在分子优化等任务中取得显著效果。

Abstract: Graph generation is a fundamental task with broad applications, such as drug discovery. Recently, discrete flow matching-based graph generation, \aka, graph flow model (GFM), has emerged due to its superior performance and flexible sampling. However, effectively aligning GFMs with complex human preferences or task-specific objectives remains a significant challenge. In this paper, we propose Graph-GRPO, an online reinforcement learning (RL) framework for training GFMs under verifiable rewards. Our method makes two key contributions: (1) We derive an analytical expression for the transition probability of GFMs, replacing the Monte Carlo sampling and enabling fully differentiable rollouts for RL training; (2) We propose a refinement strategy that randomly perturbs specific nodes and edges in a graph, and regenerates them, allowing for localized exploration and self-improvement of generation quality. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of Graph-GRPO. With only 50 denoising steps, our method achieves 95.0\% and 97.5\% Valid-Unique-Novelty scores on the planar and tree datasets, respectively. Moreover, Graph-GRPO achieves state-of-the-art performance on the molecular optimization tasks, outperforming graph-based and fragment-based RL methods as well as classic genetic algorithms.

</details>


### [868] [RetroReasoner: A Reasoning LLM for Strategic Retrosynthesis Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.12666)
*Hanbum Ko,Chanhui Lee,Ye Rin Kim,Rodrigo Hormazabal,Sehui Han,Sungbin Lim,Sungwoong Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RetroReasoner 是一种逆向合成推理模型，通过监督微调（生成结构化断键理由+反应物预测）和强化学习（基于前向合成模型的往返奖励）训练，在单步和多步逆向合成预测任务上超越了现有分子大语言模型和专家模型，能生成更多样化且可行的反应物方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分子大语言模型在逆向合成预测中，要么直接生成反应物，要么仅提供粗略的产物级分析，缺乏对化学键断裂策略的显式推理，无法解释为何选择特定反应物。

Method: 提出 RetroReasoner 模型，结合监督微调（SyntheticRetro 生成结构化断键理由与反应物对）和强化学习（往返奖励：将预测反应物输入前向合成模型，奖励能重构原始产物的预测）。同时集成到并行化蒙特卡洛树搜索中实现多步规划。

Result: RetroReasoner 在多个基准上优于现有分子大语言模型和逆向合成专用专家模型，尤其在挑战性反应实例上能生成更广泛、更多样化的可行反应物方案，同时搜索效率更高、合成路径多样性更丰富。

Conclusion: 通过显式建模化学家式的断键推理并结合前向验证的强化学习信号，可以有效提升逆向合成预测的准确性与可解释性，且该方法可扩展至多步规划任务。

Abstract: Retrosynthesis prediction aims to identify reactants that can synthesize a given product molecule. Although molecular large language models (LLMs) have recently shown promising results, most existing methods either generate reactants directly or provide only generic product-level analysis, without explicitly reasoning about bond-disconnection strategies that justify specific reactant choices. This paper proposes RetroReasoner, a retrosynthetic reasoning model that captures chemists' strategic disconnection-based thinking. RetroReasoner is trained with supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. For supervised fine-tuning, SyntheticRetro generates structured disconnection rationales paired with reactant predictions. For reinforcement learning, a round-trip reward evaluates predicted reactants by passing them through a forward synthesis model and rewarding predictions that reconstruct the original product. RetroReasoner can also be applied to multi-step retrosynthetic planning by incorporating it into a parallelized Monte Carlo tree search framework, reducing search time while increasing the number and diversity of valid synthetic pathways. Experimental results show that RetroReasoner outperforms prior baselines, including not only molecular LLMs but also retrosynthesis-specific expert models, and generates a broader range of feasible reactant proposals, especially for challenging reaction instances.

</details>


### [869] [CHIMERA-Bench: A Benchmark Dataset for Epitope-Specific Antibody Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.13431)
*Mansoor Ahmed,Nadeem Taj,Imdad Ullah Khan,Hemanth Venkateswara,Murray Patterson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了CHIMERA-Bench，一个针对抗体CDR序列-结构共设计的统一基准测试，包含2922个抗体-抗原复合物的去重数据集、三种生物学意义的数据划分、五种评估指标组，并对11种方法进行了基准测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 抗体计算方法在过去三年快速发展，出现了大量深度生成方法，但缺乏标准化基准用于公平比较和模型开发。现有方法使用不同的SAbDab快照、非重叠测试集和不兼容的指标进行评估，且文献将设计问题碎片化为众多子任务，缺乏统一定义。

Method: 构建CHIMERA-Bench基准，包含三个核心组件：(1) 经筛选去重的2922个抗体-抗原复合物数据集，带有表位和互补位注释；(2) 三种生物学意义的数据划分：未见表位、未见抗原折叠、前瞻性时间序列；(3) 综合评估协议，包含五组指标（包括新型表位特异性度量）。对涵盖六种生成范式的11种方法进行基准测试。

Result: 构建了当前最大的抗体设计基准数据集，并在所有数据划分上报告了11种方法的基准测试结果。

Conclusion: CHIMERA-Bench为抗体设计领域提供了统一的标准化基准，使社区能够开发和测试新方法并评估其泛化能力。

Abstract: Computational antibody design has seen rapid methodological progress, with dozens of deep generative methods proposed in the past three years, yet the field lacks a standardized benchmark for fair comparison and model development. These methods are evaluated on different SAbDab snapshots, non-overlapping test sets, and incompatible metrics, and the literature fragments the design problem into numerous sub-tasks with no common definition. We introduce CHIMERA-Bench: (CDR Modeling with Epitope-guided Redesign), a unified benchmark built around a single canonical task: epitope-conditioned CDR sequence-structure co-design. CHIMERA-Bench provides three components. The first is a curated, deduplicated dataset of 2,922 antibody-antigen complexes with epitope and paratope annotations. The second is a set of three biologically motivated splits that test generalization to unseen epitopes, unseen antigen folds, and prospective temporal targets. The third is a comprehensive evaluation protocol with five metric groups, including novel epitope-specificity measures. We benchmark eleven methods spanning six generative paradigms and report results across all splits. CHIMERA-Bench is the largest dataset of its kind for the antibody design problem, allowing the community to develop and test novel methods and evaluate their generalizability.

</details>


### [870] [GraphER: An Efficient Graph-Based Enrichment and Reranking Method for Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.24925)
*Ruizhong Miao,Yuying Wang,Rongguang Wang,Chenyang Li,Tao Sheng,Sujith Ravi,Dan Roth*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GraphER是一个无需额外图基础设施的图增强检索重排序框架，通过在查询时基于数据组织关系构建图并进行图排序，有效提升了复杂查询下多源证据的检索完整性，在表格检索、多跳检索和长文档检索任务上均取得一致改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RAG系统在处理跨多源分布的复杂查询时，语义搜索难以检索完整证据集；迭代式智能体检索效率低下，而知识图谱等额外结构带来存储和维护开销。

Method: (1) 利用数据组织结构捕捉超越语义相似性的邻近关系；(2) 在查询时基于这些邻近关系构建图；(3) 应用基于图的排序算法筛选出最相关的候选文档。该框架与检索器无关，支持多种邻近形式，查询时延极小。

Result: 在表格检索、多跳检索和长文档检索基准测试上，GraphER在检索完整性方面取得一致的改进。

Conclusion: GraphER无需额外图基础设施即可与标准向量存储无缝集成，是一种高效、轻量且通用的检索增强方案。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems that rely on semantic search often fail to retrieve the complete set of evidence for complex queries, particularly when information is distributed across multiple sources. Existing approaches either rely on iterative agentic retrieval, which can be inefficient, or maintain additional structures such as knowledge graphs, which introduce storage and maintenance overhead. In this paper, we propose GraphER, a graph-based enrichment and reranking framework that (1) leverages the organizational structure of data to capture proximity relationships beyond semantic similarity, (2) constructs a graph at query time based on these proximities, and (3) applies graph-based ranking to surface the top candidate documents. Experiments across table retrieval, multi-hop retrieval, and long-document retrieval benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements in terms of retrieval completeness. Additionally, GraphER requires no additional graph infrastructure and integrates seamlessly with standard vector stores. The framework is retriever-agnostic, supports multiple forms of proximity, and introduces minimal query-time latency.

</details>


### [871] [Train at Moving Edge: Online-Verified Prompt Selection for Efficient RL Training of Large Reasoning Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.25184)
*Jiahao Wu,Ning Lu,Shengcai Liu,Kun Wang,Yanting Yang,Bailong Lin,Chen Jason Zhang,Li Qing,Ke Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出HIVE框架，通过历史奖励轨迹和实时熵值代理，在RL训练前筛选高效用提示，从而在保持性能的同时显著降低推理任务中LLM后训练的计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RL算法（如GRPO）对每个提示都进行多次rollout，计算成本高昂，而大量提示产生的梯度可忽略不计，利用率低。亟需一种能在rollout阶段之前筛选高效用提示的方法，以降低计算开销。

Method: 提出HIVE（History-Informed and online-VErified prompt selection）双阶段框架：第一阶段利用历史奖励轨迹进行粗粒度筛选；第二阶段采用提示熵作为实时代理，剔除效用已过时的实例，聚焦于"学习边缘"（中等难度与高不确定性的交集区域）。

Result: 在多个数学推理基准和模型上的实验表明，HIVE在不牺牲性能的前提下，显著提升了rollout效率。

Conclusion: 样本效用是非均匀且动态变化的，最强的学习信号集中在随训练进程推移的"学习边缘"；通过历史信息和在线验证相结合的双阶段筛选策略，可以有效实现数据高效的RL训练。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become essential for post-training large language models (LLMs) in reasoning tasks. While scaling rollouts can stabilize training and enhance performance, the computational overhead is a critical issue. In algorithms like GRPO, multiple rollouts per prompt incur prohibitive costs, as a large portion of prompts provide negligible gradients and are thus of low utility. To address this problem, we investigate how to select high-utility prompts before the rollout phase. Our experimental analysis reveals that sample utility is non-uniform and evolving: the strongest learning signals concentrate at the ``learning edge", the intersection of intermediate difficulty and high uncertainty, which shifts as training proceeds. Motivated by this, we propose HIVE (History-Informed and online-VErified prompt selection), a dual-stage framework for data-efficient RL. HIVE utilizes historical reward trajectories for coarse selection and employs prompt entropy as a real-time proxy to prune instances with stale utility. By evaluating HIVE across multiple math reasoning benchmarks and models, we show that HIVE yields significant rollout efficiency without compromising performance.

</details>


### [872] [Stochastic Dimension Implicit Functional Projections for Global Integral Conservation in High-Dimensional PINNs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.29237)
*Zhangyong Liang,Huanhuan Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出随机维度隐式函数投影（SDIFP）方法，通过全局仿射修正和随机算子子集采样，在无网格神经PDE求解器中高效强制执行指定的第一、二阶空间矩，避免张量积求积和高阶微分算子的内存开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在高维无网格神经PDE求解器（如PINNs）中强制执行全局积分约束（如矩约束）具有挑战性：现有投影方法依赖固定网格或均匀求积，与随机采样点冲突且随维度扩展性差；高阶微分算子导致反向模式自动微分内存成本过高。

Method: SDIFP框架包含：(1) 全局仿射修正：通过两个标量系数对神经网络输出进行加权求积范数下的最近点投影，使经验二阶矩约束精确满足指定求积规则；(2) 可分解高维线性算子下，结合仿射矩修正与随机算子子集采样；(3) 独立残差与导数采样及条件无偏系数梯度估计，实现求积残差目标的无偏估计。

Result: 对于选定求积规则，指定矩精确满足；连续误差表现为修正场的求积误差；共享子集快速模式存在偏差，但独立采样模式可得到无偏估计。避免了张量积求积、将前向求积评估与反向图分离，保持了点推断效率。

Conclusion: SDIFP提供了一种高效、可扩展的框架，用于在无网格神经PDE求解器中强制执行全局矩约束，解决了高维、随机采样场景下的关键瓶颈。

Abstract: Enforcing prescribed global integral constraints in mesh-free neural PDE solvers is challenging in high-dimensional domains. Existing projection methods for spatial integrals are often tied to fixed grids or uniform quadrature, which can conflict with randomly sampled physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) and scale poorly with dimension. High-order differential operators also increase reverse-mode automatic differentiation memory costs. We propose Stochastic Dimension Implicit Functional Projection (SDIFP), a quadrature-level framework for enforcing prescribed first and second spatial moments. SDIFP replaces tensor-product nodal projection by a global affine correction of the neural-network output, with two scalar coefficients determined from a weighted quadrature rule. Under positive target variance and nonzero empirical raw variance, this correction is the nearest-point projection, in the weighted quadrature norm, onto the empirical two-moment constraint set. Thus, the prescribed moments are exact for the selected quadrature rule, while continuum errors are quadrature errors of the corrected field. For decomposable high-dimensional linear operators, SDIFP combines affine moment correction with stochastic operator-subset sampling. With independent residual and derivative sampling and conditionally unbiased coefficient-gradient estimation, the resulting estimator is unbiased for the specified quadrature-based residual objective; the shared-subset fast mode is biased in general. SDIFP avoids tensor-product quadrature for moment enforcement, separates forward quadrature evaluation from the reverse-mode graph, and retains pointwise inference efficiency once the affine coefficients are fixed or precomputed.

</details>


### [873] [Curvature-Guided LoRA: Matching Full Fine-Tuning in Function Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.29824)
*Frédéric Zheng,Alexandre Proutière*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Curvature-Guided LoRA (CG-LoRA)，通过函数空间视角将LoRA与全参数微调的输出对齐，利用曲率信息引导低秩更新方向，在自然语言理解任务上实现更快收敛和更好性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA等参数高效微调方法虽然高效，但收敛速度和最终性能往往落后于全参数微调。已有的参数空间对齐方法只能间接控制模型预测，需要更直接的对齐方式。

Method: 从函数空间视角构建预测对齐问题，目标是将LoRA微调的输出与全参数微调的输出匹配。该目标自然导出曲率感知的二阶优化形式，最优低秩更新对应牛顿型曲率白化梯度。据此提出CG-LoRA，利用局部曲率信息选择适配方向，避免显式构造二阶矩阵。

Result: 在标准自然语言理解基准上，CG-LoRA相比现有LoRA变体提升了性能并加快了收敛速度。

Conclusion: 基于函数空间预测对齐和曲率引导的方法能有效缩小LoRA与全参数微调之间的性能差距，且计算高效。

Abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods such as LoRA enable efficient adaptation of large pretrained models, but often lag behind full fine-tuning in both convergence speed and final performance. Recent approaches aim to reduce this gap by aligning LoRA parameter updates with those of full fine-tuning, but such parameter-space alignment only indirectly controls model predictions. Instead, we adopt a function-space perspective and formulate the \emph{prediction alignment problem}, whose objective is to match the outputs of LoRA fine-tuning to those of full fine-tuning. We show that this objective naturally leads to a curvature-aware, second-order formulation, where optimal low-rank updates correspond to a Newton-like, curvature-whitened gradient. Based on this insight, we propose Curvature-Guided LoRA (CG-LoRA), an algorithm that selects adaptation directions using local curvature information. Our method is computationally efficient and avoids explicit second-order matrix construction. Experiments on standard natural language understanding benchmarks demonstrate improved performance and faster convergence compared to existing LoRA variants.

</details>


### [874] [SPAMoE: Spectrum-Aware Hybrid Operator Framework for Full-Waveform Inversion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07421)
*Zhenyu Wang,Peiyuan Li,Yongxiang Shi,Ruoyu Wu,Chenfei Liao,Lei Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SPAMoE框架，通过频谱保持的DINO编码器和频谱分解路由机制，将多尺度地质特征的不同频段分配给混合专家模型（FNO、MNO、LNO），在OpenFWI十个子数据集上MAE降低44.4%，显著优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全波形反演计算成本高且病态，现有CNN和单范式神经算子难以解决多尺度地质特征的频率纠缠问题，导致高频信息丢失。

Method: 提出SPAMoE框架：(1) 频谱保持DINO编码器，通过约束高-低频能量比的下界来缓解高频坍缩；(2) 频谱分解与路由机制，将不同频段动态分配给由FNO、MNO、LNO组成的混合专家模型。

Result: 在OpenFWI十个子数据集上，平均MAE相比最佳官方基线降低44.4%，建立新的学习型全波形反演架构基准。

Conclusion: SPAMoE通过显式的频谱保持与频段分解路由策略，有效解决了多尺度地质特征频率纠缠问题，为基于学习的全波形反演提供了新的架构范式。

Abstract: Full-waveform inversion (FWI) is pivotal for reconstructing high-resolution subsurface velocity models but remains computationally intensive and ill-posed. While deep learning approaches promise efficiency, existing Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and single-paradigm Neural Operators (NOs) struggle with one fundamental issue: frequency entanglement of multi-scale geological features. To address this challenge, we propose Spectral-Preserving Adaptive MoE (SPAMoE), a novel spectrum-aware framework for solving inverse problems with complex multi-scale structures. Our approach introduces a Spectral-Preserving DINO Encoder that enforces a lower bound on the high-to-low frequency energy ratio of the encoded representation, mitigating high-frequency collapse and stabilizing subsequent frequency-domain modeling. Furthermore, we design a novel Spectral Decomposition and Routing mechanism that dynamically assigns frequency bands to a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) ensemble comprising FNO, MNO, and LNO. On the ten OpenFWI sub-datasets, experiments show that SPAMoE reduces the average MAE by 44.4% relative to the best officially reported OpenFWI baseline, thereby establishing a new architectural framework for learning-based full-waveform inversion. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/zhenyuwang12366/SPAMoE

</details>


### [875] [Information-Theoretic Requirements for Gradient-Based Task Affinity Estimation in Multi-Task Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07848)
*Jasper Zhang,Bryan Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现多任务学习中的梯度分析需要样本重叠（>40%）才能反映真实任务关系，低于30%则完全失效，解释了七年来MTL结果不一致的根本原因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多任务学习结果高度不一致，有时联合训练有益、有时有害，但领域缺乏解释这些结果的预测框架。

Method: 识别出梯度分析中样本重叠这一隐含假设，通过实验验证30%以下重叠时梯度-任务相关性统计上与噪声无异，40%以上可可靠恢复生物学结构。

Result: 样本重叠存在相变阈值：低于30%重叠梯度分析无效，高于40%可恢复真实结构；现有基准（MoleculeNet <5%，TDC 8-14%）远低于此阈值。

Conclusion: 首次为七年来MTL不一致结果提供了原则性解释，指出样本重叠不足是根因。

Abstract: Multi-task learning shows strikingly inconsistent results -- sometimes joint training helps substantially, sometimes it actively harms performance -- yet the field lacks a principled framework for predicting these outcomes. We identify a fundamental but unstated assumption underlying gradient-based task analysis: tasks must share training instances for gradient conflicts to reveal genuine relationships. When tasks are measured on the same inputs, gradient alignment reflects shared mechanistic structure; when measured on disjoint inputs, any apparent signal conflates task relationships with distributional shift. We discover this sample overlap requirement exhibits a sharp phase transition: below 30% overlap, gradient-task correlations are statistically indistinguishable from noise; above 40%, they reliably recover known biological structure. Comprehensive validation across multiple datasets achieves strong correlations and recovers biological pathway organization. Standard benchmarks systematically violate this requirement -- MoleculeNet operates at <5% overlap, TDC at 8-14% -- far below the threshold where gradient analysis becomes meaningful. This provides the first principled explanation for seven years of inconsistent MTL results.

</details>


### [876] [Muon$^2$: Boosting Muon via Adaptive Second-Moment Preconditioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09967)
*Ziyue Liu,Ruijie Zhang,Zhengyang Wang,Yequan Zhao,Yupeng Su,Zi Yang,Zheng Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Muon$^2$ 通过在正交化前引入 Adam 风格的自适应二阶矩预处理，改善了 Muon 优化器的极分解质量和效率，将 Newton-Schulz 迭代减少 40%，在 13B 参数规模的 GPT、LLaMA 和 MoE 预训练中节省高达 1/4 的训练时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Muon 优化器在大规模基础模型预训练中表现优异，但其正交化质量严重依赖 Newton–Schulz (NS) 迭代次数，导致计算和通信成本高昂。作者旨在通过改善动量矩阵的条件数来加速极分解过程，在保证正交化质量的同时减少 NS 迭代次数，提升训练效率。

Method: 提出 Muon$^2$，在 Muon 的正交化步骤之前，引入 Adam 风格的自适应二阶矩（second-moment）预处理。核心洞察是 Muon 中极近似的根本挑战在于动量矩阵的病态性（ill-conditioned），而二阶矩预处理能显著改善其谱分布，从而加速收敛到实际足够好的正交化。此外，定义了方向对齐（directional alignment）来刻画实际正交化质量。

Result: 在 GPT、LLaMA 和 Mixture-of-Experts 预训练实验中，参数规模达到 13B：(1) Muon$^2$ 及其内存高效变体 Muon$^2$-F 在保持大部分收益的同时，显著优于 Muon 及其变体；(2) NS 迭代次数减少 40%；(3) 在达到相同损失时，相比 Muon 节省高达 1/4 的训练时间。

Conclusion: 通过二阶矩预处理改善动量矩阵的条件数，可以大幅提升 Muon 优化器的正交化效率与质量，为大规模模型预训练提供更高效、可扩展的优化方案。

Abstract: Muon has emerged as a promising optimizer for large-scale foundation model pre-training by exploiting the matrix structure of neural network updates through iterative orthogonalization. However, the orthogonalization quality of Muon hinges on the number of Newton--Schulz (NS) iterations performed, which poses efficiency challenges due to its non-trivial computation and communication cost. We propose Muon$^2$, an extension of Muon, to improve both quality and efficiency by applying Adam-style adaptive second-moment preconditioning before orthogonalization. Our key insight is that the core challenge of polar approximation in Muon lies in the ill-conditioned momentum matrix, of which the spectrum is substantially improved by Muon$^2$, leading to faster convergence toward a practically sufficient orthogonalization. We further characterize the practical orthogonalization quality via directional alignment, under which Muon$^2$ demonstrates dramatic improvement over Muon at each polar step. Across GPT, LLaMA, and Mixture-of-Experts pre-training experiments up to 13B parameters, Muon$^2$ (and its memory-efficient variant Muon$^2$-F that preserves most of its benefits) consistently outperforms Muon and its variants while reducing NS iterations by 40%, and saves up to 1/4 training time over Muon when achieving the same loss.

</details>


### [877] [Models Know Their Shortcuts: Deployment-Time Shortcut Mitigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.12277)
*Jiayi Li,Shijie Tang,Gün Kaynar,Shiyi Du,Carl Kingsford*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个无需训练数据和标注的部署时捷径缓解框架Shortcut Guardrail，仅利用已收敛模型的无监督梯度归因信号，即可在分布偏移下恢复预训练文本编码器的性能，理论上证明了部署时缓解的信息论上限，实验表明该方法在情感分类、毒性检测和自然语言推理任务上匹配或超越训练时基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练文本编码器容易受到捷径学习的影响，依赖训练数据中token与标签之间的虚假相关性，导致分布偏移时性能严重下降。现有缓解方法主要在训练阶段进行，需要访问训练数据、训练动态或捷径标注，而这些在部署阶段通常不可用，因此亟需一种仅在部署时、仅依赖已收敛模型就能有效缓解捷径学习的方法。

Method: 提出Shortcut Guardrail框架：(1) 利用无监督梯度归因方法从已收敛模型中捕获其习得的捷径信号；(2) 基于该梯度信号在部署时进行捷径缓解，无需训练数据或标注；(3) 理论上证明了部署时缓解的信息论上限受限于训练时缓解的上限。

Result: 在情感分类、毒性检测和自然语言推理三个任务上，Shortcut Guardrail在捷径分布偏移下能够恢复大量性能，匹配甚至超越了需要训练数据或标注的训练时基线方法。

Conclusion: 仅凭已收敛模型本身就可以在部署时有效缓解捷径学习，无监督梯度归因信号足以捕获模型内化的捷径信息，为实际部署场景下的鲁棒性提升提供了可行的解决方案。

Abstract: Pretrained text encoders are prone to shortcut learning, relying on token-label correlations that fail once the distribution shifts in deployment. Existing shortcut mitigation methods mainly operate at training time and assume access to training data, training dynamics, or shortcut annotations, which are hardly available during deployment, where only the converged model remains. We show that this model alone suffices to mitigate shortcuts during deployment: a biased model internalizes a signal of its learned shortcuts that can be captured via unsupervised gradient-based attribution. We further prove that deployment-time mitigation is information-theoretically upper-bounded by training-time mitigation. Nevertheless, exploiting this gradient signal, our proposed unsupervised deployment-time shortcut mitigation framework for pretrained text encoders, Shortcut Guardrail, recovers substantial performance under shortcut distribution shift, matching or outperforming training-time baselines across sentiment classification, toxicity detection, and natural language inference.

</details>


### [878] [Capacity-Controlled Global Attention for Graph Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17324)
*Yang Liu,Dongxin Guo,Tom Zheng,Siu Ming Yiu,Liam Ning,Jikun Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出图Transformer中softmax的“质量守恒”约束（每头输出是值向量的凸组合）是导致过平滑、低秩瓶颈和优化脆弱三个病理现象的共同根源。受sigmoid门控在语言模型中消除注意力汇的启发，提出SigGate-GT，在GraphGPS框架内对注意力输出应用可学习的、输入条件化的sigmoid门控，作为逐维“音量控制”以放松该约束。门控提高了每头输出的稳定秩，在五个分子和长程基准上取得最优或竞争性结果，机制分析证实门控减缓过平滑（表示多样性相对提升30%）、防止注意力熵崩溃并稳定训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: softmax注意力机制强制每行非负且和为1，使每个头输出是值向量的质量守恒凸组合，节点无法“什么都不关注”。作者认为这一守恒约束是过平滑、低秩瓶颈和优化脆弱三个通常被孤立研究的病理现象的共同根本原因。

Method: 提出SigGate-GT，在GraphGPS框架中引入一个可学习的、输入条件化的sigmoid门控，作用于注意力输出。该门控是平滑的逐维“音量控制”，可将头输出推向零，在不放弃注意力概率解释的前提下放松守恒约束。

Result: 在ZINC上匹配最优（0.059 MAE）；ogbg-molhiv上取得最强结果（82.47% ROC-AUC）；在ogbg-molpcba和长程图基准上具有竞争力；在五个数据集上均显著优于GraphGPS（p<0.05）。门控在4-16层间带来表示多样性30%的相对提升，防止注意力熵崩溃，在10倍学习率范围内稳定训练，仅增加约1%参数开销和不到3%的墙钟时间成本。

Conclusion: 通过放松softmax的质量守恒约束，sigmoid门控有效缓解了图Transformer中的过平滑、低秩和优化不稳定问题，验证了三个病理现象共享同一根源的分析，且实用代价极小。

Abstract: Global self-attention drives modern graph transformers, yet the softmax at its core imposes a structural constraint rarely examined directly: every attention row is non-negative and sums to one, so each per-head output is a mass-conserving convex combination of value vectors. A node can never "attend to nothing." We argue this conservation constraint is a single root cause behind three pathologies usually studied in isolation: the collapse of node representations with depth (over-smoothing), a low-rank bottleneck on per-head outputs, and brittle optimization in deep stacks. Drawing on how sigmoid gating removes analogous attention sinks in language models, we introduce SigGate-GT, a graph transformer that applies a learned, per-head, input-conditioned sigmoid gate to the attention output inside the GraphGPS framework. The gate is a smooth, per-dimension "volume control" that can drive head outputs toward zero, relaxing the constraint without abandoning attention's probabilistic interpretation. Analytically and through synthetic experiments, we show the gate strictly increases the stable rank of per-head outputs, and connect this rank gain to all three manifestations. On five molecular and long-range benchmarks, SigGate-GT matches the prior best on ZINC (0.059 MAE), records the strongest result among the graph-transformer baselines we evaluate on ogbg-molhiv (82.47% ROC-AUC), and is competitive on ogbg-molpcba and the Long-Range Graph Benchmark, with statistically significant gains over GraphGPS on all five datasets (p < 0.05). Mechanism analyses confirm the diagnosis: gating slows over-smoothing (a 30% mean relative gain in representation diversity across 4-16 layers), keeps attention entropy from collapsing, and stabilizes training across a 10x learning-rate range, at about 1% parameter overhead on OGB and under 3% wall-clock cost.

</details>


### [879] [ML-Guided Primal Heuristics for Mixed Binary Quadratic Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.23053)
*Weimin Huang,Natalie M. Isenberg,Ján Drgoňa,Draguna L Vrabie,Bistra Dilkina*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于机器学习的原始启发式方法求解混合二元二次规划（MBQP），通过新神经网络架构、数据收集流程和组合损失函数，在标准与真实基准上显著超越现有启发式方法和求解器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MBQP由于组合复杂性与非线性双重挑战难以求解，现有ML引导方法多集中于混合整数线性规划（MILP），缺乏针对MBQP的ML引导原始启发式方法。

Method: 提出新的神经网络架构用于MBQP解预测；设计新的训练数据收集流程；扩展现有损失函数，提出对比损失与加权交叉熵损失的组合。

Result: 在标准和真实MBQP基准上，ML引导方法显著优于现有原始启发式和最先进求解器；组合损失训练的模型在跨区域泛化（如风电场布局优化）中优于从MILP改编的ML方法。

Conclusion: ML引导的原始启发式方法可有效扩展至MBQP，组合损失函数有助于提升泛化性能，为非线性组合优化问题提供新思路。

Abstract: Mixed Binary Quadratic Programs (MBQPs) are an important and complex set of problems in combinatorial optimization. As solving large-scale combinatorial optimization problems is challenging, primal heuristics have been developed to quickly identify high-quality solutions within a short amount of time. Recently, a growing body of research has also used machine learning to accelerate solution methods for challenging combinatorial optimization problems. Despite the increasing popularity of these ML-guided methods, a large body of work has focused on Mixed-Integer Linear Programs (MILPs). MBQPs are challenging to solve due to the combinatorial complexity coupled with nonlinearities. This work proposes ML-guided primal heuristics for Mixed Binary Quadratic Programs (MBQPs) by adapting and extending existing work on ML-guided MILP solution prediction to MBQPs. We introduce a new neural network architecture for MBQP solution prediction and a new training data collection procedure. Moreover, we extend existing loss functions in solution prediction and propose to combine contrastive and weighted cross-entropy losses. We evaluate the methods on standard and real-world MBQP benchmarks and show that the developed ML-guided methods significantly outperform existing primal heuristics and state-of-the-art solvers. Furthermore, models trained with our proposed extension with combined losses outperform other ML-based methods adapted from MILPs and improve generalization in cross-regional inference on a real-world wind farm layout optimization problem.

</details>


### [880] [Advancing Ligand-based Virtual Screening and Molecular Generation with Pretrained Molecular Embedding Distance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.24474)
*Shiyun Wa,Yifei Wang,Simone Sciabola,Ye Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出预训练嵌入距离（PED）作为一种无需任务特定训练即可直接计算的新型分子相似性度量方法，在虚拟筛选和分子生成中表现有效，可作为传统相似性度量的可扩展替代方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统分子相似性度量（如指纹Tanimoto系数、3D形状叠加）在大规模计算时成本高昂或依赖手工分子描述符，而深度学习方法通常需要相似性特定的监督或昂贵的数据整理，限制了其在不同靶点间的通用性。

Method: 提出预训练嵌入距离（PED），直接从预训练分子模型中计算嵌入向量间的距离，无需任务特定训练。

Result: PED与传统相似性度量具有明显相关性，在虚拟筛选的分子排序和基于奖励设计的分子生成引导中均表现有效。

Conclusion: 预训练分子嵌入能够捕获丰富的结构信息，可作为现代AI辅助药物发现中一种有前景且可扩展的相似性度量方法。

Abstract: Molecular similarity plays a central role in ligand-based drug discovery, such as virtual screening, analog searching, and goal-directed molecular generation. However, traditional similarity measures, ranging from fingerprint-based Tanimoto coefficients to 3D shape overlays, are often computationally expensive at scale or rely on hand-crafted molecular descriptors. Meanwhile, many deep learning approaches to similarity-aware design still depend on similarity-specific supervision or costly data curation, limiting their generality across targets. In this work, we propose pretrained embedding distance (PED) as an effective alternative, computed directly from pretrained molecular models without task-specific training. Experimental results show that PED exhibits distinct correlations with traditional similarity metrics, and performs effectively in both ranking molecules for virtual screening and guiding molecular generation via reward design. These findings suggest that pretrained molecular embeddings capture rich structural information and can serve as a promising and scalable similarity measurement for modern AI-aided drug discovery.

</details>


### [881] [Do Larger Models Really Win in Drug Discovery? A Benchmark Assessment of Model Scaling in AI-Driven Molecular Property and Activity Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26498)
*Jinjiang Guo,Sheng Ding*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究通过26个ADME/毒性/生物活性终点、78个实验条目的大规模基准测试，对比经典机器学习、预训练分子序列模型、图神经网络和LLM在药物发现中的表现。结果显示经典ML以47.4%的最佳表现占比主导，尤其在随机分裂场景；GNN和序列模型在较难分裂中有竞争力但对训练设置敏感；LLM的SAR基线仅占1.9%。研究表明模型性能取决于模型-任务-验证场景的匹配，而非单纯规模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 验证药物发现中“大规模预训练模型必将取代紧凑型化学信息学模型”这一主流假设是否成立。

Method: 在26个ADME/毒性/生物活性终点（165,541条标签记录）上，构建78个端点与分裂条目，采用随机、Murcko骨架和结构分离三种5折交叉验证协议，对经典ML、GNN、分子序列模型和LLM进行156项任务与指标比较。

Result: 经典ML提供最大比例的最佳表现（47.4%），其次是分子序列模型（28.8%）、GNN（21.8%）、LLM（1.9%）。经典ML主导随机分裂；GNN和序列模型在较难分裂中有竞争力，但优势在固定最终窗口读取下减弱。成对bootstrap分析显示微小数值差异不应视为决定性胜利。

Conclusion: 紧凑型专用模型仍高度有效，预测性能取决于模型、任务和验证场景的匹配，而非单纯依赖模型规模。

Abstract: The rapid growth of molecular foundation models and large language models (LLMs) has encouraged a scale centred view of AI in drug discovery, in which larger pretrained models are expected to supersede compact cheminformatics models. We test this assumption across 26 ADME, toxicity and bioactivity endpoints, covering 165,541 endpoint level compound label records. The benchmark contains 78 endpoint and split entries evaluated under random, Murcko scaffold and structure separated 5-fold cross validation protocols, representing increasing chemical generalization difficulty. Across 156 task and metric comparisons, classical machine learning (ML) provides the largest share of best performing entries (47.4%), followed by pretrained molecular sequence models (28.8%), graph neural networks (21.8%) and LLM based SAR baselines (1.9%). Classical ML dominates random split interpolation and remains the largest winner family overall. GNN and sequence models are competitive in selected harder splits, but their strict winner shares decrease under a fixed final-window readout, indicating sensitivity to training settings and model selection. Paired bootstrap analyses show that small numerical differences between individual models should not be read as decisive victories. SAR knowledge from training folds improves GPT5.5-SAR and Opus4.7-SAR metrics but does not make rule based reasoning a universal substitute for supervised predictors. Compact specialized models remain highly effective, and predictive performance depends on the fit among model, task and validation scenario, not on scale alone.

</details>


### [882] [Simple Self-Conditioning Adaptation for Masked Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26985)
*Michael Cardei,Huu Binh Ta,Ferdinando Fioretto*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出自条件掩码扩散模型(SCMDM)，通过在去噪步骤中利用模型自身的先前干净状态预测进行条件化，改进了标准掩码扩散模型。该方法无需从头训练，仅需少量后训练调整，在多个领域（自然语言、图像、小分子、基因组）显著提升了生成质量，困惑度降低近50%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准掩码扩散模型中，若某位置在反向更新后仍为掩码状态，模型会丢弃该位置之前预测的干净状态，导致仍需从掩码标记单独推断，限制了跨步骤的信息精炼能力。

Method: 提出SCMDM，对预训练好的MDM进行后训练适配，使每个去噪步骤以模型自身前一步预测的干净状态为条件。仅需最小架构改动，无需引入循环隐状态路径，无需辅助参考模型，不增加采样时的去噪器评估次数。

Result: 在OWT数据集上生成困惑度从42.89降至23.72（降幅近50%）；在离散图像合成、小分子生成、基因组分布建模等多个领域均显著优于基线MDM。

Conclusion: 后训练阶段中，部分自条件的50% dropout策略是次优的；一旦模型自身生成的干净状态估计变得有信息量，专注于精炼比混合条件与非条件目标更好。SCMDM是一种简单、有效、通用的MDM增强方法。

Abstract: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) generate discrete sequences by iterative denoising under an absorbing masking process. In standard masked diffusion, if a token remains masked after a reverse update, the model discards its clean-state prediction for that position. Thus, still-masked positions must be repeatedly inferred from the mask token alone. This design choice limits cross-step refinement. To address this limitation, this paper proposes a simple, yet effective, post-training adaptation for MDMs that conditions each denoising step on the model's own previous clean-state predictions. The resulting method, called Self-Conditioned Masked Diffusion Models (SCMDM), requires minimal architectural change, does not introduce a recurrent latent-state pathway, does not rely on an auxiliary reference model, and adds no extra denoiser evaluations during sampling. This is an important departure from partial self-conditioning approaches which requires expensive model training from scratch. In particular, the paper shows that partial self-conditioning, including the commonly used 50% dropout strategy for training self-conditioned models from scratch, is suboptimal in the post-training regime. Instead, once the model's self-generated clean-state estimates become informative, the specialization to refinement is preferable to mixing conditional and unconditional objectives. SCMDM is evaluated across multiple domains, demonstrating consistent improvement over vanilla MDM baselines, achieving nearly a 50% reduction in generative perplexity on OWT-trained models (42.89 to 23.72), alongside strong improvements in discretized image synthesis quality, small molecular generation, and enhanced fidelity in genomic distribution modeling.

</details>


### [883] [Hyper-Dimensional Fingerprints as Molecular Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27810)
*Jonas Teufel,Luca Torresi,André Eberhard,Pascal Friederich*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出超维度指纹（HDF），用高维向量的代数运算替代图神经网络的学习变换，无需训练即可生成确定性的分子表示，在性质预测基准上优于传统指纹，并在低维度下保持分子相似性忠实度，显著提升贝叶斯分子优化的样本效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统分子指纹通过哈希压缩丢失结构信息，尤其在低维度下退化严重；而基于图神经网络的学习表示虽然表达力强，但需要任务特定训练和大量计算资源。作者希望设计一种既确定性、无需训练，又能保持结构忠实度的分子表示方法。

Method: 将消息传递神经网络中的学习变换替换为高维向量上的代数运算（如绑定、捆绑、置换），生成确定性的超维度指纹（HDF），无需任何训练过程。

Result: HDF在多种性质预测基准上优于传统指纹；在32维时，HDF空间的图编辑距离皮尔逊相关系数达0.9（Morgan指纹仅0.55）；64维时简单最近邻回归仍具预测能力；在贝叶斯分子优化中，基于HDF的代理模型样本效率显著提升。

Conclusion: HDF提供了一种通用、无需训练的传统分子指纹替代方案，证明了长期以来被认为是定长指纹固有缺陷的信息损失实际上是哈希编码方案的限制，而非指纹范式本身的问题。

Abstract: Computational molecular representations underpin virtual screening, property prediction, and materials discovery. Conventional fingerprints are efficient and deterministic but lose structural information through hash-based compression, particularly at low dimensionalities. Learned representations from graph neural networks recover this expressiveness but require task-specific training and substantial computational resources. Here we introduce hyperdimensional fingerprints (HDF), which replace the learned transformations of message-passing neural networks with algebraic operations on high-dimensional vectors, producing deterministic molecular representations without any training. Across diverse property prediction benchmarks, HDF outperforms conventional fingerprints in the majority of tasks while exhibiting greater consistency across datasets and models. Crucially, HDF embeddings preserve molecular similarity faithfully: at 32 dimensions, distances in HDF space achieve a 0.9 Pearson correlation with graph edit distance, compared to 0.55 for Morgan fingerprints at equivalent size. This structural fidelity persists at low dimensions where hash-based methods degrade, allowing simple nearest-neighbor regression to remain predictive with as few as 64 components. We further demonstrate the practical impact in Bayesian molecular optimization, where HDF-based surrogate models achieve substantially improved sample efficiency in regimes where Morgan fingerprints perform comparably to random search. HDF thus provides a general-purpose, training-free alternative to conventional molecular fingerprints, suggesting that the information loss long accepted as inherent to fixed-length fingerprints is a limitation of the hash-based encoding scheme rather than the fingerprint paradigm itself.

</details>


### [884] [Label-Conditioned Cross-Modal Fusion for Adult-to-Pediatric ECG Transfer via Curriculum-Gated Contrastive Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.00647)
*Xinran Liu,Yuwen Li,Hongxiang Gao,Heyang Xu,Jianqing Li,Zongmin Wang,Chengyu Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出PEACE框架，通过成人ECG预训练结合跨模态语义对齐和课程自适应融合，在标签稀缺条件下实现高效儿科ECG诊断迁移，零样本AUC达59.39%，全微调达91.56%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 儿童ECG自动解读面临发育差异导致成人模型迁移受限、专家标注儿科数据稀缺的双重挑战，亟需一种能从大规模成人数据迁移知识到儿科场景的框架。

Method: 提出PEACE框架：1）基于MIMIC-IV ECG预训练；2）标签特定双向对比学习(LSBC)对齐ECG表示与诊断语义；3）课程自适应融合(CAF)在有限儿科监督下稳定优化；4）标签条件短文本描述符提供辅助语义监督，推理阶段仅需ECG信号。

Result: 在ZZU-pECG上零样本、50样本和全微调宏平均AUC分别为59.39%、81.74%和91.56%；在PTB-XL上全微调达96.90%；梯度注意力图显示与临床解读一致的波形区域显著性。

Conclusion: 成人尺度ECG预训练结合节律、形态和ST-T复极语义描述符可改善标签稀缺下的儿科诊断迁移，同时保持临床可解释的波形关注。

Abstract: Automated pediatric electrocardiogram (ECG) interpretation remains challenging because developmental differences in heart rate, intervals, and waveforms limit the transferability of models trained mainly on adult data, while expert-labeled pediatric ECG cohorts are scarce. We propose PEACE (Pediatric-Adult ECG Alignment via Cross-modal Enhancement), an adult-to-pediatric ECG transfer framework pretrained on MIMIC-IV ECGs and adapted to pediatric targets. PEACE integrates label-specific bidirectional contrastive learning (LSBC) to align ECG representations with diagnostic semantics and curriculum adaptive fusion (CAF) to stabilize optimization under limited pediatric supervision. Label-conditioned short text descriptors provide auxiliary semantic supervision during training, whereas inference requires ECG signals only. On ZZU-pECG, PEACE achieves macro-average AUCs of 59.39%, 81.74%, and 91.56% under zero-shot, 50-shot, and full fine-tuning settings, respectively, outperforming ECG-only, multimodal, and generic domain adaptation baselines including DANN and MMD. On PTB-XL, it reaches 96.90% macro-average AUC after full fine-tuning over nine harmonized labels with nonzero mapped incidence. Gradient-based attention maps show increased saliency around QRS voltage and morphology regions for chamber-related RVH and around QRS-to-T/repolarization intervals for LQTS, broadly consistent with ECG regions commonly inspected during routine interpretation. These results suggest that adult-scale ECG pretraining coupled with rhythm, morphology, and ST-T repolarization semantic descriptors improves transferable pediatric diagnosis under label scarcity while preserving clinically interpretable waveform focus.

</details>


### [885] [Kernel Affine Hull Machines as Compute-Efficient Encoders for Frozen Semantic Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.02950)
*Mohit Kumar,Somayeh Kargaran,Bernhard A. Moser,Manuela Geiß*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无需反向传播的查询端编码器KAHM，在固定教师表示空间和语料库索引的条件下，通过核仿射包络机几何从廉价词汇特征估计语义向量，替代繁重的神经查询编码。在奥地利法律检索基准上，KAHM在保持强重建性能和排序敏感性的同时，将在线查询时间减少了8.53倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在实际部署中，基于Transformer的语义编码器在检索任务中，在线查询编码（而非离线语料库索引）成为重复性瓶颈。论文旨在研究能否用更轻量且解析显式的估计器替代反复的神经查询编码，同时保持固定的教师表征空间和语料库索引不变。

Method: 将固定教师词汇到语义的编码建模为条件均值估计问题：目标语义向量表示为语义原型加权的噪声混合，权重由后验聚类概率确定。利用核仿射包络机(KAHM)几何在显式识别的RKHS假设空间中从廉价词汇特征估计后验权重，并通过归一化最小均方更新从含噪教师嵌入中精炼语义原型。整个框架无反向传播，端到端误差分解为后验逼近项、有限样本/泛化项和教师噪声项。

Result: 在奥地利法律检索基准（5000测试查询，84条候选法律，10762个对齐检索单元）上，使用冻结的Mixedbread嵌入空间，KAHM在所有评估截断值上取得最强教师空间重建性能和最佳排序敏感检索表现：MRR@20=0.504，Hit@20=0.694，Top-1准确率=0.411；在CPU设置下将在线每查询时间减少8.53倍。

Conclusion: KAHM可作为监督式固定表征部署场景下的计算高效编码器，有效降低了在线查询编码的计算代价，同时保持优异的检索性能。

Abstract: Transformer-based semantic encoders are effective for retrieval, but in many deployments the recurring bottleneck is online query encoding rather than offline corpus indexing. This paper studies whether, once a strong teacher representation space and corpus index are fixed, repeated neural query encoding can be replaced by a substantially lighter and analytically explicit estimator. We formulate fixed-teacher lexical-to-semantic encoding as a conditional-mean estimation problem in which the target semantic vector is represented as a noisy mixture of semantic prototypes weighted by posterior cluster probabilities. Kernel Affine Hull Machine (KAHM) geometry is used to estimate these posterior weights from inexpensive lexical features in an explicitly identified RKHS hypothesis space, and the semantic prototypes are refined by normalized least-mean-squares updates from noisy teacher embeddings. This yields a backpropagation-free query-side encoder together with an end-to-end error decomposition into posterior-approximation, finite-sample/generalization, and teacher-noise terms. We instantiate the approach on a controlled Austrian-law retrieval benchmark with 5,000 test queries, 84 candidate laws, and 10,762 aligned retrieval units, using law-specific encoders into a frozen Mixedbread embedding space. Among evaluation-matched learned adapters, KAHM achieves the strongest teacher-space reconstruction and the best rank-sensitive retrieval performance at all evaluated cutoffs. At k=20, it obtains MRR@20 = 0.504, Hit@20 = 0.694, and Top-1 Accuracy = 0.411, while reducing online per-query time by 8.53 relative to direct transformer query encoding in the reported CPU setting. The results support KAHMs as compute-efficient encoders for supervised fixed-representation deployment regimes.

</details>


### [886] [Neuron-Anchored Rule Extraction for Large Language Models via Contrastive Hierarchical Ablation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.03058)
*Francesco Sovrano,Gabriele Dominici,Marc Langheinrich*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MechaRule是一种通过定位稀疏激动子激活来提取LLM电路规则的方法，在算术和越狱任务上以仅2.14%的穷举消融成本，召回97.0%的高效激动子，并消除97.6-100.0%的相关行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有规则提取方法通常学习不基于内部机制的符号代理，而机械可解释性虽能将行为关联到神经元但需要手工假设和昂贵干预。MechaRule旨在将规则提取扎根于LLM电路，实现高效、可扩展的机制性规则发现。

Method: 基于两个关键发现：1) 在固定基线/翻转机制下，稀疏激动子效应存在"超越"(overtopping)现象，即少数高效激活在大组中可被检测并主导弱效应；2) 激动子在忠实规则行为的数据分片上定位更可靠。方法采用自适应组测试与置信引导保守剪枝，复杂度为O(k log(N/k) + k)。

Result: 在算术和越狱任务上，MechaRule以平均仅2.14%的穷举消融成本召回97.0%的最高效激动子；消融定位的激动子消除97.6-100.0%的正确算术答案和越狱行为，并能通过至多72.8%和32.5%的比例修正算术错误或诱导越狱。

Conclusion: MechaRule成功将符号规则提取与LLM内部电路机制相结合，实现了高效、可验证的规则发现，为可解释AI提供了从机制到行为的有力工具。

Abstract: A central goal of explainable AI is to express large language model (LLM) decision logic symbolically and ground it in internal mechanisms. Existing rule-extraction methods usually learn ungrounded symbolic surrogates, while mechanistic interpretability links behavior to neurons but often requires hand-crafted hypotheses and costly interventions. We introduce MechaRule, a pipeline that grounds rule extraction in LLM circuits by localizing sparse agonist activations whose ablation disrupts rule-related behavior. MechaRule rests on two findings. First, in a fixed baseline/flip regime, sparse agonist effects can exhibit overtopping: a few high-effect activations remain detectable within larger groups, dominate weaker ones, and flip many of the same examples. In such regimes, adaptive group testing with confidence-guided conservative pruning requires O(k log(N/k) + k) interventions over N candidates when k << N are agonists. Second, agonists are localized more reliably on data splits aligned with close-to-faithful rule behavior; spectral splits provide a rule-free fallback, whereas unfaithful splits degrade localization. Empirically, on arithmetic and jailbreaking, MechaRule recalls 97.0% of highest-effect agonists in matched brute-force validations at only 2.14% of exhaustive-ablation cost on average. Ablating the localized agonists eliminates 97.6--100.0% of eligible correct arithmetic answers and jailbreaks, and can correct arithmetic errors or induce jailbreaks by up to 72.8% and 32.5%.

</details>


### [887] [Self-Mined Hardness for Safety Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.03226)
*Prakhar Gupta,Garv Shah,Donghua Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于模型自身难度评分筛选对抗性提示的安全微调方法。在Llama-3-8B-Instruct和Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct上，该方法将WildJailbreak攻击成功率从11.5%和20.1%降至1-3%，但导致拒绝率飙升。通过混合训练对抗性框架的良性提示可将拒绝率降低，但攻击成功率略有上升。在混合训练中，使用最困难的一半提示进行训练比随机一半效果更好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统安全微调需要精心策划的对抗数据集，本研究旨在探索一种无需人工标注、自动评估提示难度并筛选最难样本进行安全微调的方法，以提高安全微调的效率和效果。

Method: 1) 使用目标模型自身的rollout结果，根据是否被判定为有害来计算每个候选提示的难度分数；2) 选择难度最高的提示，配对模型自身的非越狱rollout进行微调；3) 为解决过度拒绝问题，以1:1比例混合对抗性框架的良性提示（看似越狱但意图良性）进行训练；4) 在混合训练中，对比使用最困难的一半提示与随机一半提示的效果。

Result: 1) 纯困难提示训练：Llama-3-8B-Instruct攻击成功率从11.5%降至1-3%，但拒绝率从14-22%飙升至74-94%；2) 混合训练：拒绝率降至30-51%（8B）和52-72%（3B），攻击成功率上升2-6个百分点；3) 在混合训练中使用最困难的一半提示，攻击成功率额外降低35-50%（约3个百分点）。

Conclusion: 基于模型自身rollout自动评估提示难度是一种有效的安全微调策略，能够显著提升模型安全性，但需要平衡安全性与过度拒绝问题。混合训练和难度筛选策略能够在这两者之间取得更好的权衡。

Abstract: Safety fine-tuning of language models typically requires a curated adversarial dataset. We take a different approach: score each candidate prompt's difficulty by how often the target model's own rollouts are judged harmful, then fine-tune on the hardest prompts paired with the model's own non-jailbroken rollouts. On Llama-3-8B-Instruct and Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, this approach cuts the WildJailbreak attack success rate from 11.5% and 20.1% down to 1-3%, but pushes refusal on jailbreak-shaped benign prompts from 14-22% to 74-94%. Interleaving the same hard prompts 1:1 with adversarially-framed benign prompts (prompts that look like jailbreaks but have benign intent) cuts that refusal back down to 30-51% on 8B and 52-72% on 3B, at a cost of 2-6 percentage points of attack success rate. Within the mixed regime, training on the hardest half of the eligible pool rather than a random half cuts the remaining ASR by 35-50% (about 3 percentage points) on both models.

</details>


### [888] [Population-Aware Imitation Learning in Mean-field Games with Common Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.03357)
*Grégoire Lambrecht,Mathieu Laurière*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了共同噪声下平均场博弈中的模仿学习问题，提出了两种学习目标（恢复纳什均衡和对抗专家群体），建立了贝叶斯克隆和对抗散度的有限样本误差界，并通过广义虚构博弈和深度学习框架验证了群体感知策略的重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在共同噪声驱动的平均场博弈中，群体分布随机演化，迫使智能体必须采用群体感知策略以应对聚合冲击。现有方法通常忽略这一特性，导致策略失效。本文旨在为共同噪声MFG中的模仿学习建立理论基础，并验证群体感知策略的必要性。

Method: 1. 形式化两种学习目标：恢复纳什均衡和最大化与专家群体的性能差异。2. 研究两种模仿代理：行为克隆（BC）和对抗散度（ADV）。3. 建立有限样本误差界，证明最小化这些代理能有效控制策略的可利用性和性能差距。4. 提出基于广义虚构博弈和深度学习的数值框架，用于计算专家群体感知策略。

Result: 在三个环境上的实验表明，标准的群体无关策略无法捕捉均衡动力学。学习群体感知策略对于避免被共同噪声中的随机性误导至关重要。

Conclusion: 群体感知策略是共同噪声MFG中模仿学习的关键，所提出的框架和误差界为安全且高效的策略学习提供了理论保障。

Abstract: Mean Field Games (MFGs) provide a powerful framework for modeling the collective behavior of large populations of interacting agents. In this paper, we address the problem of Imitation Learning (IL) in MFGs subject to common noise, where the population distribution evolves stochastically. This stochasticity compels agents to adopt population-aware policies to respond to aggregate shocks. We formulate two distinct learning objectives: recovering a Nash equilibrium and maximizing performance against an expert population. We investigate two imitation proxies: Behavioral Cloning (BC) and Adversarial (ADV) divergence. We then establish finite-sample error bounds showing that minimizing these proxies effectively controls both the policy's exploitability and its performance gap relative to the expert. Furthermore, we propose a numerical framework using generalized Fictitious Play and Deep Learning to compute expert population-aware policies. Through experiments on three environments we demonstrate that standard population-unaware policies fail to capture the equilibrium dynamics. Our results highlight that learning population-aware policies is crucial to avoid being misled by the randomness inherent in common noise.

</details>


### [889] [MinMax Recurrent Neural Cascades](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06384)
*Alessandro Ronca*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MinMax循环神经级联（MinMax RNCs），一种基于MinMax代数的新型循环神经网络架构，兼具强形式表达能力、高效并行计算、稳定动力学和非消失状态梯度等理想特性，在合成任务和语言建模上表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有循环神经网络在形式表达能力（如完全正则语言识别）、计算效率（能否并行扫描）、动力学稳定性（状态有界性）和梯度稳定性（非消失/爆炸）等关键性质上难以同时满足，本文旨在设计一种能同时实现这些特性的新架构。

Method: 基于MinMax代数（最大值和最小值运算）构建新型循环神经级联（RNC）架构，利用Max-plus和Min-plus线性结构实现状态空间的有界性和梯度保持特性，同时支持对数深度并行扫描算法。

Result: 理论证明MinMax RNCs的表达能力等价于正则语言，状态和激活值一致有界，损失梯度几乎处处存在且一致有界，状态梯度不随时间距离消失。实验上完美解决合成任务并泛化到长序列，在1.12亿参数的语言模型上取得有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: MinMax RNCs是一种理论上优越且实践中可扩展的循环神经网络架构，为序列建模提供了一种兼具形式化保证和计算效率的新方案。

Abstract: We introduce MinMax Recurrent Neural Cascades (MinMax RNCs), a class of recurrent neural networks built from a novel form of recurrence over the MinMax algebra. We show that MinMax RNCs enjoy key properties that are difficult to obtain simultaneously: strong formal expressivity, efficient evaluation, stable dynamics, and non-vanishing state gradients. First, their formal expressivity corresponds to the regular languages, arguably the maximal expressivity for finite-memory systems. Second, in addition to evaluation in recurrent form, they also admit parallel-scan evaluation with logarithmic depth and linear work in the input length. Third, their states and activations are uniformly bounded for all sequence lengths. Fourth, their loss gradients exist almost everywhere and are uniformly bounded for all sequence lengths. Fifth, they do not exhibit vanishing state gradients: the gradient of a state with respect to a past state can retain norm one independently of the temporal distance between the states. Empirically, we find that these theoretical properties translate into strong practical performance. MinMax RNCs solve the considered synthetic tasks perfectly, generalise to long sequences, and outperform the recurrent baselines considered in our experiments. We also train a 112M-parameter MinMax RNC for next-token prediction, obtaining competitive performance for its size and providing initial evidence that MinMax recurrence can scale to real-world sequence-modelling tasks.

</details>


### [890] [PairAlign: A Framework for Sequence Tokenization via Self-Alignment with Applications to Audio Tokenization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06582)
*Adhiraj Banerjee,Vipul Arora*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PairAlign是一种通过序列级自对齐实现紧凑音频标记化的框架，将标记化视为条件序列生成，通过内容保持视图间的相互预测学习离散符号序列，在语音检索中减少55%的标记数量同时保持编辑距离搜索性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有音频标记化方法依赖量化、聚类或编解码重建，局部分配标记，很少直接优化序列一致性、紧凑性、长度控制、终止符和编辑相似性。需要一种能学习序列级一致性的音频标记化方法。

Method: PairAlign将标记化视为条件序列生成：编码器将语音映射为连续条件，自回归解码器从BOS生成标记，学习标记身份、顺序、长度和EOS位置。给定两个内容保持视图，每个视图的序列在对方表示下具有高似然，无关样本提供竞争序列，作为编辑距离保持的可扩展替代方案并防止多对一坍缩。从VQ风格标记化开始，使用EMA教师目标、交叉配对教师强制、前缀破坏、似然对比和长度控制进行优化。

Result: 在3秒语音上，PairAlign学习了紧凑、非退化的序列，具有广泛的词汇使用和强跨视图一致性。检索测试中保持编辑距离搜索，同时将存档标记计数减少55%。连续扫描探测显示比密集几何标记器更低的局部重叠，但在100毫秒偏移下具有更强的长度控制和有界编辑轨迹。

Conclusion: PairAlign是一种序列符号预测学习器：类似JEPA风格目标，它从一个视图预测另一个视图的抽象目标，输出为可学习的变长符号序列而非连续潜变量。

Abstract: Many operations on sensory data -- comparison, memory, retrieval, and reasoning -- are naturally expressed over discrete symbolic structures. In language this interface is given by tokens; in audio, it must be learned. Existing audio tokenizers rely on quantization, clustering, or codec reconstruction, assigning tokens locally, so sequence consistency, compactness, length control, termination, and edit similarity are rarely optimized directly.
  We introduce PairAlign, a framework for compact audio tokenization through sequence-level self-alignment. PairAlign treats tokenization as conditional sequence generation: an encoder maps speech to a continuous condition, and an autoregressive decoder generates tokens from BOS, learning token identity, order, length, and EOS placement. Given two content-preserving views, each view's sequence is trained to be likely under the other's representation, while unrelated examples provide competing sequences. This gives a scalable surrogate for edit-distance preservation while discouraging many-to-one collapse.
  PairAlign starts from VQ-style tokenization and refines it with EMA-teacher targets, cross-paired teacher forcing, prefix corruption, likelihood contrast, and length control.
  On 3-second speech, PairAlign learns compact, non-degenerate sequences with broad vocabulary usage and strong cross-view consistency. On retrieval tests, it preserves edit-distance search while reducing archive token count by 55%. A continuous-sweep probe shows lower local overlap than a dense geometric tokenizer, but stronger length control and bounded edit trajectories under 100 ms shifts. PairAlign is a sequence-symbolic predictive learner: like JEPA-style objectives, it predicts an abstract target from another view as a learned variable-length symbolic sequence, not a continuous latent.

</details>


### [891] [OTora: A Unified Red Teaming Framework for Reasoning-Level Denial-of-Service in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.08876)
*Xinyu Li,Ronghui Mu,Lin Li,Tianjin Huang,Gaojie Jin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 OTora，首个统一的红队测试框架，用于针对大语言模型智能体的推理级拒绝服务攻击。通过两阶段优化（触发词优化+推理负载生成），在保持任务正确性的同时，可使推理token数增加10倍、延迟显著增大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM作为自主智能体执行工具增强的多步任务时，延迟是实际应用的关键因素。然而，一个被忽视的威胁是推理级拒绝服务攻击——攻击者保持任务正确性但通过膨胀推理深度或工具使用预算来降低可用性。现有研究缺乏统一框架来实例化此类攻击。

Method: OTora采用两阶段框架：Stage I通过插入感知评分和动态目标共进化优化对抗触发词，诱导特定工具调用，支持黑盒和白盒设置；Stage II通过ICL引导的遗传搜索生成智能体感知的推理负载，放大过度思考行为同时保持任务正确性。

Result: 在基于LLaMA-70B和GPT-OSS-120B等多个骨干模型的WebShop、Email和OS智能体上，OTora实现了推理token最多增加10倍、延迟数量级下降，同时保持接近基线的任务准确率。

Conclusion: 论文讨论了检测和约束异常推理及延迟尖峰的缓解策略，并开源了代码。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents that execute tool-augmented, multi-step tasks, where latency is a critical factor for real-world applications. Yet an overlooked threat is Reasoning-Level Denial-of-Service (R-DoS), in which an attacker preserves task correctness but degrades availability by inflating an agent's reasoning depth or tool-use budget. We introduce OTora, the first unified, two-stage red-teaming framework for instantiating R-DoS attacks. Stage I optimizes an adversarial trigger that induces targeted tool invocations using insertion-aware scoring and dynamic target co-evolution, supporting both black-box and white-box settings. Stage II generates agent-aware reasoning payloads via an ICL-guided genetic search that amplifies overthinking while maintaining correct task outcomes. Across WebShop, Email, and OS agents built on multiple backbone models such as LLaMA-70B and GPT-OSS-120B, OTora achieves up to 10 times increases in reasoning tokens and order-of-magnitude latency slowdowns, all while preserving near-baseline task accuracy. Finally, we discuss mitigation strategies for detecting and constraining abnormal reasoning and latency spikes. The code is available at https://github.com/llm2409/OTora.

</details>


### [892] [Improving the Performance and Learning Stability of Parallelizable RNNs Designed for Ultra-Low Power Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.11855)
*Julien Brandoit,Arthur Fyon,Damien Ernst,Guillaume Drion*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出累积记忆循环单元（CMRU）及其松弛变体αCMRU，通过累积更新公式恢复梯度流，在保留量化状态和持久记忆的同时，显著提升了BMRU的收敛稳定性和初始化鲁棒性，在多项基准测试中匹配或超越LRU和minGRU，尤其擅长离散长程依赖任务，且保持适合模拟硬件实现的噪声鲁棒特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BMRU虽然通过量化状态和迟滞实现了超低功耗的硬件-软件协同设计，但在复杂序列任务上性能落后于可并行化的RNN。作者识别出状态更新过程中的梯度阻塞是关键限制，旨在恢复梯度流的同时保持持久记忆特性。

Method: 提出累积更新公式，在状态更新中建立跨时间的跳跃连接（skip-connections through time）以恢复梯度流，同时保留BMRU的量化状态和迟滞特性。由此衍生出CMRU及其松弛变体αCMRU。

Result: 累积公式显著提升了收敛稳定性和初始化鲁棒性；CMRU和αCMRU在小型模型规模下匹配或超越LRU和minGRU；在需要离散长程记忆保持的任务上表现尤为突出；同时保留量化状态、持久记忆和适合模拟实现的噪声鲁棒动力学特性。

Conclusion: CMRU在保持硬件友好特性的同时大幅提升了性能，填补了超低功耗可模拟RNN与高性能并行化RNN之间的性能差距，为硬件-软件协同设计的序列模型提供了更有竞争力的方案。

Abstract: Sequence learning is dominated by Transformers and parallelizable recurrent neural networks (RNNs) such as state-space models, yet learning long-term dependencies remains challenging, and state-of-the-art designs trade power consumption for performance. The Bistable Memory Recurrent Unit (BMRU) was introduced to enable hardware-software co-design of ultra-low power RNNs: quantized states with hysteresis provide persistent memory while mapping directly to analog primitives. However, BMRU performance lags behind parallelizable RNNs on complex sequential tasks. In this paper, we identify gradient blocking during state updates as a key limitation and propose a cumulative update formulation that restores gradient flow while preserving persistent memory, creating skip-connections through time. This leads to the Cumulative Memory Recurrent Unit (CMRU) and its relaxed variant, the $α$CMRU. Experiments show that the cumulative formulation dramatically improves convergence stability and reduces initialization sensitivity. The CMRU and $α$CMRU match or outperform Linear Recurrent Units (LRUs) and minimal Gated Recurrent Units (minGRUs) across diverse benchmarks at small model sizes, with particular advantages on tasks requiring discrete long-range retention, while the CMRU retains quantized states, persistent memory, and noise-resilient dynamics essential for analog implementation.

</details>


### [893] [High-Rate Quantized Matrix Multiplication II](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13768)
*Or Ordentlich,Yury Polyanskiy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究量化矩阵乘法，重点关注权重仅后训练量化场景。利用协方差矩阵信息，通过逆向水填充方法改进GPTQ算法，并分析WaterSIC方案在高速率下的性能，证明其具有基无关性和接近信息论极限的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM量化算法（如GPTQ）在各坐标间均匀分配比特率，未利用协方差矩阵信息，导致量化效率非最优。作者希望利用经典逆向水填充理论来优化比特分配，提升量化性能。

Method: 将权重仅量化建模为加权均方误差（WMSE）源编码问题，应用逆向水填充方法优化比特分配；分析WaterSIC方案（仅使用标量INT量化器）在高速率下的性能，推导其与信息论极限的差距；通过随机旋转实验比较GPTQ与WaterSIC的性能。

Result: (a) WaterSIC是基无关的，其性能由Σ_X的行列式决定，对随机旋转免疫；(b) 其性能距离信息论失真极限仅差2πe/12的乘性因子（约0.25比特/条目）；(c) 在Llama-3-8B上，GPTQ加随机旋转的性能距离WaterSIC仅差0.1比特，说明GPTQ在高速率下也接近最优。

Conclusion: 逆向水填充可改进实际LLM量化算法；WaterSIC具有理论上的近最优性能；GPTQ配合随机旋转在实践中也接近最优，特别是在高速率区域。

Abstract: This is the second part of the work investigating quantized matrix multiplication (MatMul). In part I we considered the case of calibration-free quantization, whereas here we discuss the setting where covariance matrix $Σ_X$ of the columns of the second factor is available. This setting arises in the ubiquitous task of weight-only post-training quantization of LLMs.
  Weight-only quantization is related to the problem of weighted mean squared error (WMSE) source coding, whose classical (reverse) waterfilling solution dictates how one should distribute rate between coordinates of the vector. We show how waterfilling can be used to improve practical LLM quantization algorithms (GPTQ), which at present allocate rate equally. A recent scheme (known as ``WaterSIC'') that only uses scalar INT quantizers is analyzed and its high-rate performance is shown to be (a) basis free (i.e., characterized by the determinant of $Σ_X$ and, thus, unlike existing schemes, is immune to applying random rotations); and (b) within a multiplicative factor of $\frac{2πe}{12}$ (or 0.25 bit/entry) of the information-theoretic distortion limit. GPTQ's performance, in turn, is affected by the choice of basis, but for a random rotation and actual $Σ_X$ from Llama-3-8B we find it to be within 0.1 bit (depending on the layer type) of WaterSIC, suggesting that GPTQ with random rotation is also near optimal, at least in the high-rate regime.

</details>


### [894] [Margin-Adaptive Confidence Ranking for Reliable LLM Judgement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.15416)
*Gaojie Jin,Yong Tao,Lijia Yu,Tianjin Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对LLM与人类判断一致性保证中置信度估计单调性假设可能失效的问题，提出通过学习专用置信度估计器（利用模拟标注者多样性和基于间隔的排序公式）来替代启发式置信度信号，并推导泛化保证，在固定序列测试中提升排序准确率和一致性达成率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有假设检验框架依赖LLM估计置信度与人类分歧风险之间的单调性假设，但该假设在实践中可能被违反，且置信度估计器的泛化行为未被明确分析。

Method: 1) 学习专用置信度估计器替代启发式信号；2) 利用模拟标注者多样性增强数据；3) 采用基于间隔的排序公式显式建模LLM区分人类一致/分歧案例的置信度；4) 推导泛化保证，揭示间隔相关的权衡，指导自适应估计器训练过程。

Result: 集成到固定序列测试中，学习的置信度估计器提升了排序准确率，增强了置信度与分歧风险之间的单调关系，在多个数据集和评判模型上实现了更高的目标一致性水平达成率。

Conclusion: 通过学习专用置信度估计器并显式建模其泛化行为，可以有效缓解单调性假设失效问题，提升LLM与人类判断一致性保证的可靠性和成功率。

Abstract: Jung et al. (2025) introduce a hypothesis testing framework for guaranteeing agreement between large language models (LLMs) and human judgments, relying on the assumption that the model's estimated confidence is monotonic with respect to human-disagreement risk. In practice, however, this assumption may be violated, and the generalization behavior of the confidence estimator is not explicitly analyzed. We mitigate these issues by learning a dedicated confidence estimator instead of relying on heuristic confidence signals. Our approach leverages simulated annotator diversity and a margin-based ranking formulation to explicitly model how confidently an LLM distinguishes between human-agreement and human-disagreement cases. We further derive generalization guarantees for this estimator, revealing a margin-dependent trade-off that informs the design of an adaptive estimator training procedure. When integrated into fixed-sequence testing, the learned confidence estimator yields improved ranking accuracy and empirically strengthens the monotonic relationship between confidence and disagreement risk, leading to higher success rates in satisfying target agreement levels across multiple datasets and judge models.

</details>


### [895] [Ghosted Layers: Unconstrained Activation Alignment for Recovering Layer-Pruned LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.15491)
*Vincent-Daniel Yun,Junhyuk Jo,Sai Praneeth Karimireddy,Sunwoo Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Ghosted Layers，一种无需训练的恢复模块，通过闭式最优线性算子解决层剪枝后隐藏状态分布不匹配问题，在多个LLM和剪枝策略上显著优于现有无训练基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 层剪枝移除了Transformer解码器块，导致幸存的下一层接收到的隐藏状态与其训练时的分布不匹配，造成性能严重下降。现有方法只能求解受限算子子空间上的约束解，无法达到全局最优。

Method: 将问题建模为边界激活对齐问题，利用少量校准集推导出闭式最优线性算子，该算子重构被剪枝层引入的激活差异，对应于对齐目标的无约束最优解。

Result: 在多个LLM骨干网络和剪枝策略上，该方法在准确率和困惑度指标上一致优于现有无训练基线方法，同时保持层剪枝的效率优势。

Conclusion: Ghosted Layers通过闭式最优线性算子有效恢复了层剪枝导致的性能损失，且无需额外训练，为高效模型压缩提供了实用解决方案。

Abstract: Layer pruning removes entire Transformer decoder blocks from large language models, but introduces a mismatch between the hidden state received by the next surviving layer and the distribution it was trained to process, leading to significant performance degradation. We propose Ghosted Layers, a training-free recovery module that addresses this issue by solving a boundary activation alignment problem. Our method derives a closed-form optimal linear operator from a small calibration set to reconstruct the activation discrepancy introduced by the pruned layers. We show that this solution corresponds to the unconstrained optimum of the alignment objective, whereas existing methods are restricted to constrained solutions over limited operator subspaces. Experiments across multiple LLM backbones and pruning strategies demonstrate that our method consistently improves accuracy and perplexity over prior training-free baselines, while preserving the efficiency gains of layer pruning. Official code repository: https://github.com/daniel-eai/ghosted_layers_official_repository/.

</details>


### [896] [FRWKV+: Periodic-Aware Adaptive Gating for Frequency-Space Linear Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.15690)
*Qingyuan Yang,Dongyue Chen,Da Teng,Junhua Xiao,Jiaji Pan,Shizhuo Deng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FRWKV-Plus是一种轻量级周期感知频域时序预测模型，通过跨分支谱门控和信任门控残差校正两项机制，在不增加计算负担的前提下提升多变量长时序预测性能，在七个基准上达到与主流方法相当或更优的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有频域模型将实部和虚部频谱作为弱耦合流处理，并将周期性线索当作普通输入特征，忽视了周期性线索可能不可靠的问题，导致长期多变量时间序列预测的准确性和效率难以兼得。

Method: FRWKV-Plus基于高效的FRWKV骨干，引入跨分支谱门控（利用兄弟分支摘要重加权各频谱分支）和信任门控残差校正（将周期内上下文转化为有界、符号可调的调整量，受学习到的数据依赖信任分数控制），校正项初始化为恒等映射且严格有界，确保周期性证据仅能细化而非主导基础交互。

Result: 在七个标准基准上，FRWKV-Plus与强线性模型、频域模型、递归风格模型和Transformer模型相比具有竞争力，同时保持轻量级特性。三种子消融实验表明各组件均有贡献，在强周期数据上增益适中，在较难的Exchange和ILI数据集上增益显著，其中周期内上下文是最具影响力的单一组件。

Conclusion: FRWKV-Plus通过轻量级的周期感知频域设计，有效平衡了长期多变量时序预测的准确性与效率，特别是对弱周期性或复杂数据场景具有明显优势。

Abstract: Accurate and efficient long-term multivariate time series forecasting requires capturing recurring temporal structure while keeping inference cheap across many variables and horizons. Frequency-space models represent long-range and periodic variation compactly, but they typically process the real and imaginary spectral components as weakly coupled streams and treat periodic cues as ordinary input features, even when such cues are unreliable. This paper proposes FRWKV-Plus, a lightweight periodic-aware frequency-space forecasting model built on the efficient FRWKV backbone. FRWKV-Plus introduces a cross-branch spectral gate that reweights each spectral branch using a summary of its sibling branch, and a trust-gated residual correction that converts compact within-period context into a bounded, sign-flexible adjustment of these gates under a learned, data-dependent trust score. By construction, the correction is identity-preserving at initialization and strictly bounded, so periodic evidence can refine but never dominate or invert the base interaction. On seven standard benchmarks, FRWKV-Plus is consistently competitive with strong linear, frequency-domain, recurrent-style, and Transformer-based forecasters while preserving the lightweight profile of the backbone. Controlled three-seed ablations show that each component contributes, that the benefit is modest on strongly periodic data and pronounced on the harder Exchange and ILI datasets, and that the within-period context is the most influential single component. The implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/yangqingyuan-byte/FRWKV-plus.

</details>


### [897] [VQ-Atom: Semantic Discretization of Local Atomic Environments for Molecular Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16823)
*Takayuki Kimura*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: VQ-Atom提出了一种基于向量量化的语义分子标记化框架，通过离散原子级标记编码局部化学环境，在药物-靶点相互作用预测中优于SMILES和连续表示，并实现约3倍训练加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分子机器学习广泛使用SMILES作为标记表示，但SMILES本质上是分子图的线性化格式，缺乏对化学语义的分解，限制了模型对化学知识的编码能力。

Method: 提出VQ-Atom框架，利用向量量化（Vector Quantization）为每个原子分配基于局部化学环境的离散标记，使标记编码图局部的化学上下文信息并与分子结构对齐。

Result: 在KIBA数据集上的蛋白质-冷药物-靶点相互作用预测任务中，AUROC达到0.79，显著优于基于SMILES和连续分子表示的方法；同时下游训练速度相比连续原子级表示提升约3倍。

Conclusion: 分子标记化不仅是预处理步骤，更是核心设计选择；良好结构的标记能编码实质性化学语义，减轻下游学习负担。标记设计可成为与架构、目标函数和优化并列的机器学习研究新维度。

Abstract: Large language models succeed by combining large-scale pretraining with meaningful discrete tokens. In molecular machine learning, SMILES is widely used as a token representation, but it is primarily a linearization format for molecular graphs rather than a semantic decomposition of chemistry. We propose VQ-Atom, a semantic tokenization framework that assigns discrete atom-level tokens based on local chemical environments via vector quantization. Unlike SMILES tokens, VQ-Atom tokens encode graph-local chemical context and are aligned with molecular structure. On protein-cold drug--target interaction prediction using the KIBA dataset, VQ-Atom substantially improves global ranking performance, achieving AUROC of 0.79 while substantially outperforming both SMILES-based and continuous molecular representations under an identical downstream architecture. Furthermore, VQ-Atom enables approximately 3 times faster downstream training than continuous atom-level representations by replacing per-atom continuous features with reusable discrete tokens. These results suggest that molecular tokenization is not merely a preprocessing step, but a central design choice. In particular, well-structured tokens can encode substantial chemical semantics, reducing the burden on downstream learning. VQ-Atom can be interpreted as defining a molecular language, where tokens correspond to chemically meaningful atomic environments, suggesting that token design may constitute an additional axis of machine learning research alongside architecture, objectives, and optimization.

</details>


### [898] [LEAP: Learnable End-to-End Adaptive Pruning of Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17289)
*Mohammad Mozaffari,Younes Hourri,Mohammad Rastegari,Mahyar Najibi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LEAP通过基于Gumbel-sigmoid松弛的逐权重Bernoulli建模，实现了端到端的非结构化掩码学习，在0.5B-8B参数规模的LLM上，50%-60%稀疏度下平均零样本准确率比最优逐层基线ADMM提升2.59个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有非结构化LLM剪枝方法存在两难：基于OBS原则的逐层代理方法牺牲端到端精度，而端到端可学习掩码方法（如MaskLLM、PATCH）在非结构化场景下因参数化方式不可行而失效。需要一种在非结构化剪枝中实现端到端可学习掩码的高效方法。

Method: 将每个权重的剪枝决策建模为Bernoulli分布，并通过Gumbel-sigmoid松弛实现可微化，从而替代传统基于模式的分类参数化，使得端到端非结构化掩码学习变得可行。

Result: 在0.5B到8B参数的五个LLM家族上，50%和60%稀疏度下，LEAP比最优逐层基线ADMM平均提升2.59个百分点的六任务平均零样本准确率。

Conclusion: LEAP通过Gumbel-sigmoid松弛的Bernoulli建模，成功将端到端可学习掩码方法扩展到非结构化剪枝场景，显著优于传统逐层剪枝方法。

Abstract: Unstructured sparsity is now natively accelerated by recent GPU kernels and dataflow hardware, shifting the bottleneck from inference execution to the pruning algorithm. State-of-the-art methods for unstructured LLM pruning are layer-wise surrogates derived from the Optimal Brain Surgeon principle, and they sacrifice end-to-end accuracy, especially under aggressive sparsity. End-to-end alternatives such as MaskLLM and PATCH show that learnable masks can close this gap, but their categorical-over-patterns parameterization scales with the number of valid masks per row and does not port to the unstructured setting. We introduce LEAP, which replaces this intractable parameterization with a per-weight Bernoulli-via-Gumbel-sigmoid relaxation that makes end-to-end unstructured mask learning tractable. Across five LLM families from 0.5B to 8B parameters at 50% and 60% sparsity, LEAP improves six-task average zero-shot accuracy by +2.59 points on average over ADMM, the best layer-wise baseline in our sweep.

</details>


### [899] [Adaptive Generate-Rank-Verify: Inference-Time Search with Costly Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17609)
*Shaddin Dughmi,Mahdi Haghifam,Yusuf Hakan Kalayci*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文形式化了推理时语言模型管线中的生成式主动搜索问题，提出了一种自适应生成-排序-验证算法ADAP，在理论上证明其期望成本与分布感知最优策略仅差常数因子，并通过数学推理和编程竞赛任务验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理管线通常先使用廉价奖励信号筛选候选，再使用昂贵验证器（如精确答案检查、隐藏测试执行）确认最终结果。但如何自适应地调度生成与验证过程以最小化期望成本，缺乏系统的理论形式化和最优策略分析。

Method: 提出ADAP（Adaptive Generate-Rank-Verify）算法，采用Shellwise策略：逐轮递增采样的候选数量，对每组候选排序后仅对top-k进行验证。理论分析基于单调性假设（高分更可能通过验证），证明期望成本在常数因子内逼近分布感知最优策略，并给出基于中心星数的学习理论下界。

Result: 在数学推理和竞争性编程任务上，ADAP相比固定非自适应策略和难度自适应基线均取得显著优势，实验验证了理论预期的成本节约。

Conclusion: 本文为推理时语言模型管线提供了第一个严格的主动搜索理论框架，证明了在分数-标签关系满足单调性时自适应策略的最优性近似保证，并指出结构假设的必要性。

Abstract: Many inference-time language-model pipelines combine a cheap reward signal with an expensive verifier, such as exact answer checking in mathematical reasoning or hidden-test execution in code generation. We formalize this setting using a learning-theoretic lens as generative active search: a cost-sensitive first-positive search problem in which a policy adaptively samples candidates from an unknown distribution, observes cheap scores, and pays for verifier labels until it finds a positive example. For a fixed prompt, the generator and reward model induce two unknown objects: a distribution over reward scores and a score-conditioned success function. When these quantities are known, we characterize the distribution-aware optimal policy using a dynamic programming approach. In the realistic and practical setting where both the score distribution and success function are unknown, we propose ADAP, a shellwise adaptive generate-rank-verify algorithm that progressively increases the number of sampled responses and top-ranked verifications. Under the monotonicity assumption that higher reward scores are no less likely to pass verification, we show that ADAP achieves expected cost within a constant factor of the distribution-aware optimum. We complement this result with learning-theoretic lower bounds, based on a centered star number, showing that structural assumptions on the score--label relationship are necessary. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and competitive programming validate the predicted advantage over both fixed non-adaptive policies and difficulty-adaptive baselines.

</details>


### [900] [Post-Trained MoE Can Skip Half Experts via Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18643)
*Xingtai Lv,Li Sheng,Kaiyan Zhang,Yichen You,Siyan Gao,Xueheng Luo,Yuxin Zuo,Yuchen Fan,Junlin Yang,Ganqu Cui,Bingning Wang,Fan Yang,Youbang Sun,Ning Ding,Bowen Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ZEDA（零专家自蒸馏适配）框架，通过注入参数无关的零输出专家和两阶段自蒸馏，将训练好的静态MoE模型高效转换为动态MoE，在Qwen3-30B-A3B和GLM-4.7-Flash上消除超过50%的专家FLOPs，性能损失极小，并实现约1.20倍端到端推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动态MoE方法通常需要从头预训练或任务特定适配，尚缺乏如何将已训练好的静态MoE模型转化为动态MoE的实际方案。这种转化可直接降低推理成本，使简单token绕过不必要的专家计算。

Method: ZEDA在每层MoE中注入参数无关的零输出专家，通过两阶段自蒸馏适配增强后的模型：将原始MoE作为冻结教师，并应用分组级别平衡损失。

Result: 在Qwen3-30B-A3B和GLM-4.7-Flash上覆盖数学、代码和指令跟随共11个基准测试，ZEDA消除了超过50%的专家FLOPs，边际精度损失可忽略，比最强动态MoE基线高出6.1和4.0个点，实现约1.20倍端到端推理加速。

Conclusion: ZEDA是一个低成本框架，能有效将静态MoE转化为动态MoE，显著降低推理计算量，同时保持模型性能，是实际部署MoE模型的高效方案。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) scales language models efficiently through sparse expert activation, and its dynamic variant further reduces computation by adjusting the activated experts in an input-dependent manner. Existing dynamic MoE methods usually rely on pre-training from scratch or task-specific adaptation, leaving the practical conversion of fully trained MoE underexplored. Enabling such adaptation would directly alleviate the inference costs by allowing easy tokens to bypass unnecessary expert during serving. This paper introduces Zero-Expert Self-Distillation Adaptation (ZEDA), a low-cost framework that transforms post-trained static MoE models into efficient dynamic ones. To stabilize this architectural conversion, ZEDA injects parameter-free zero-output experts into each MoE layer and adapts the augmented model through two-stage self-distillation, utilizing the original MoE as a frozen teacher and applying a group-level balancing loss. On Qwen3-30B-A3B and GLM-4.7-Flash across 11 benchmarks spanning math, code, and instruction following, ZEDA eliminates over 50% of expert FLOPs at marginal accuracy loss. It outperforms the strongest dynamic MoE baseline by 6.1 and 4.0 points on the two models, and delivers ~1.20$\times$ end-to-end inference speedup.

</details>


### [901] [SPHERICAL KV: Angle-Domain Attention and Rate-Distortion Retention for Efficient Long-Context Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18856)
*Anay Chauhan,Gurucharan Marthi Krishna Kumar,Arion Das,Amit Dhanda,Vinija Jain,Aman Chadha,Amitava Das*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Spherical KV 提出了一种基于注意力几何的长上下文推理方法，通过角度域注意力（ADA）和率失真保留（RDR）两个组件，在压缩KV缓存的同时避免解码时的密集向量重建，从而减少HBM流量并提升解码效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文推理中KV缓存占用随上下文长度增长，解码过程受限于HBM流带宽而非计算能力。现有压缩方法（如驱逐、窗口化、量化、卸载）虽减少存储占用，但未充分解决关键路径瓶颈——压缩状态在解码时仍需重建为密集向量，导致HBM流量问题依然存在。

Method: 将KV分配建模为率失真优化问题，基于注意力几何设计。包含两个组件：(i) 角度域注意力（ADA）：将键存储为球面参数化（标量半径+紧凑角度码），直接从角度码计算注意力logits，无需重建密集键，保持分页、块局部、融合友好的解码路径；(ii) 率失真保留（RDR）：在固定预算下联合选择每个token和头的保留/丢弃决策及精度层级，生成层级同质页，附带轻量元数据和合并读取。

Result: ADA和RDR共同减少了KV驻留内存，同时保持了解码效率，直接针对真实服务场景中的HBM流量问题。

Conclusion: Spherical KV提供了一种面向部署的长上下文推理机制，在降低KV缓存占用与保持解码效率之间取得了有效平衡。

Abstract: Long-context inference is increasingly constrained by the KV cache: resident memory grows with context length, and decoding becomes limited by repeated High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) streaming rather than arithmetic. Existing methods such as eviction, windowing, quantization, and offloading reduce footprint, but often leave the critical-path bottleneck only partially addressed, especially when compressed states must still be reconstructed into dense vectors during decoding.
  We present Spherical KV, a long-context inference method that treats KV allocation as a rate-distortion problem grounded in attention geometry for efficient decoding.
