The method is built on two ideas: (i) represent directional information cheaply in the decode hot loop, and (ii) allocate retention and precision according to estimated future utility. Its first component, Angle-Domain Attention (ADA), stores keys in a spherical parameterization consisting of a scalar radius and compact angle codes, and computes attention logits directly from these codes without reconstructing dense keys. This preserves a paged, block-local, fusion-friendly decode path and directly targets HBM traffic in realistic serving settings. Its second component, Rate-Distortion Retention (RDR), jointly chooses keep/drop decisions and precision tiers per token and head under a fixed budget, producing tier-homogeneous pages with lightweight metadata and coalesced reads. Together, ADA and RDR provide a deployment-oriented mechanism for reducing KV residency while preserving decode efficiency.

</details>


### [902] [Causal Unlearning in Collaborative Optimization: Exact and Approximate Influence Reversal under Adversarial Contributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20341)
*Ali Mahdavi,Azadeh Zamanifar,Amirfarhad Farhadi,Omid Kashefi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出HF-KCU方法，通过Krylov子空间共轭梯度迭代近似影响函数，实现联邦学习中高效且精确的客户端数据删除，将复杂度从O(d³)降至O(kd)，并配备因果加权机制确保仅更新受影响客户端。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习系统必须支持数据删除请求以符合隐私法规，但每次删除后重新训练计算成本过高，亟需高效的卸载学习方法。

Method: 利用Krylov子空间中的共轭梯度迭代近似影响函数（复杂度O(kd)），结合因果加权机制确保仅持有被删除数据的客户端接收参数更新，并设计了针对Hessian和梯度有界对抗扰动的鲁棒处理机制。

Result: 在CIFAR-10上比重新训练快47.75倍，测试精度与基线仅差0.60%（71.16% vs 71.76%）；成员推理攻击成功率为0.499，与重训练模型一致；提供了收敛保证，Krylov近似误差以O((√κ-1)/(√κ+1))衰减。

Conclusion: HF-KCU在效率、精度和隐私保护方面均达到生产级要求，适用于异步删除请求和计算预算受限的联邦学习系统。

Abstract: Federated learning systems must support data deletion requests to comply with privacy regulations, yet retraining from scratch after each deletion is computationally prohibitive. We present HF-KCU, a method that removes a client's contribution by approximating the influence function through conjugate gradient iterations in Krylov subspaces, reducing complexity from O(d^3) to O(kd) where k<<d.A causal weighting mechanism ensures that only clients holding the deleted data receive parameter updates, preventing spurious changes to unaffected clients. Our method is designed to handle bounded adversarial perturbations to the Hessian and gradient, providing graceful degradation under realistic threat models. We validate HF-KCU across convolutional (ResNet-18, SimpleCNN) and transformer (ViT-Lite) architectures on CIFAR-10, MNIST, and Fashion-MNIST. On CIFAR-10 under Dirichlet (alpha=0.5) partitioning, HF-KCU achieves 47.75 times speedup over retraining while maintaining test accuracy within 0.60% of the rational baseline(71.16 vs 71.76 %). Membership inference attacks on the forget set yield success rates of 0.499 matching the retrained model and confirming effective privacy restoration. We provide convergence guarantees showing that the Krylov approximation error decreases as O((k ^1/2-1)/(k^1/2+1)) where k is the Hessian condition number. The causal weighting mechanism ensures surgical updates, where only clients holding deleted data are modified, preserving model quality for unaffected participants and avoiding the instability of gradient-based approaches in asynchronous federated settings. This design provides interpretability as each update is directly traceable to the influence of the deleted data. The method's efficiency and precision make it suitable for production federated systems where deletion requests arrive asynchronously and computational budgets are constrained.

</details>


### [903] [Latent Cache Flow: Model-to-Model Communication Without Text](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22863)
*Maximillian Rossi,Prajwal Raghunath,Eugene Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Latent Cache Flow (LCF)，一种通过联合翻译和压缩KV缓存来实现高效LLM间通信的方法，相比C2C将适配器大小缩减至4%，并支持不同上下文间的信息传输，在共享上下文设置中超越C2C，在不同上下文设置中比文本通信快8.5倍且准确率更高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体间文本通信存在延迟高和信息丢失问题；C2C方法虽通过KV缓存交换改进通信，但适配器庞大昂贵且要求接收模型与共享模型上下文完全相同，不适用于智能体间上下文不同的实际场景。

Method: LCF通过联合翻译和压缩键值对，将适配器大小缩减至C2C的约4%；针对不同上下文设计适配器，仅传输目标模型缺失的新信息摘要。

Result: 在共享上下文设置中，裁剪后的13MB LCF适配器比956MB的C2C更准确；在不同上下文设置中，LCF的F1提升7.5%，Exact Match提升23%，速度比文本通信快8.5倍。

Conclusion: LCF通过压缩适配器和针对性信息传输，解决了LLM智能体间高效通信的效率和上下文差异两大核心问题，在准确率和速度上均优于现有方法。

Abstract: LLM agents today communicate via text, which incurs considerable latency and information loss due to the need to autoregressively decode the sharer model's state and encode at the receiver model. Recent work such as Cache-to-Cache (C2C; Fu et al., 2026) seeks to exchange KV caches by learning adapters that translate sharer KV matrices to the receiver model. However, the adapters are large and expensive to train, and translate individual tokens, which requires the target context to be identical. This is unsuitable for agent communication, where the LLMs have differing context. We introduce Latent Cache Flow (LCF). To address efficiency, we observe that keys and values can be jointly translated and compressed, reducing the adapter to about 4% of C2C's size. To address differing context, we design the adapter to transmit a summary of new information that the target model does not have. Our early experiments show that a pruned 13 MB LCF adapter can be more accurate than C2C at 956 MB in shared-context settings; for different contexts, LCF improves F1 by 7.5% and Exact Match by 23% while 8.5 times faster than text-based communication.

</details>


### [904] [Accelerating Divisible Load Processing Through Machine Learning: A Practical Framework for Large-Scale Workloads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23247)
*Bharadwaj Veeravalli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次提出基于机器学习的框架，利用前馈神经网络预测单层树状网络结构中的最优处理时间，在约1毫秒推理时间内达到97-99%的R²准确率，为可分负载理论提供了一种高效替代方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统DLT最优处理时间计算需要显式求解复杂方程，计算开销大，难以满足实时调度和大规模设计空间探索的需求。因此，需要一种快速、准确且可扩展的替代方法。

Method: 构建包含16个工程化特征的前馈神经网络，使用100,000个合成生成的配置进行训练，隐式学习DLT中的负载守恒和同时完成约束等数学结构。

Result: 模型R²达到97-99%，平均绝对百分比误差为1-5%，推理时间低于1毫秒。在节点数3-20、负载大小1-100 GB的范围内保持一致准确性，但在超大型或高度异构系统中性能略有下降。

Conclusion: 证明了使用机器学习加速分布式计算优化的可行性，在保持近最优精度的同时显著提升计算效率，适用于实时调度、设计空间探索和云资源分配等场景。

Abstract: In this paper, we introduce the first machine learning framework for predicting optimal processing times in Single-Level Tree Network (SLTN) architectures for the Divisible Load Theory (DLT) paradigm. Using a feedforward neural network(FNN) with 16 engineered features, we train a model on 100,000 synthetically generated configurations to predict optimal processing times without explicit formulation of DLT equations. The model achieves 97-99% accuracy (R-square factor) with mean absolute percentage error of 1-5%, demonstrating that neural networks can effectively learn complex load distribution relationships. Feature importance analysis reveals that the model implicitly captures DLT mathematical structure, including load conservation and simultaneous finishing constraints. With inference times under 1 millisecond, the approach serves as a viable option over traditional DLT computation, enabling applications in real-time scheduling, design space exploration, and cloud resource allocation. The method generalizes well across diverse system configurations (n=3 to 20, load size =1 to 100 GB) with consistent accuracy, though performance degrades slightly for very large or highly heterogeneous systems. This work demonstrates the feasibility of using machine learning to accelerate distributed computing optimization while maintaining near-optimal accuracy.

</details>


### [905] [Riemannian-Manifold Steering: Geometry-Aware Generative Autoencoders for Label-Free Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24942)
*Narmeen Oozeer,Shivam Raval,Philip Quirke,Manikandan Ravikiran,Jeff Phillips,Shriyash Upadhyay,Amirali Abdullah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将语言模型流形操控重新定义为黎曼测地线计算问题，并基于输出空间的Hellinger距离学习一个无标签的度量，实现了无需标签中心点和预设边界条件的统一操控框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有流形操控方法要么需要带标签的类别中心点和预设的循环/顺序结构（如标签样条方法），要么缺乏对激活空间中路径几何的显式学习（如线性插值、核方法），这些假设限制了流形操控的适用范围。本文旨在提供一个更通用的黎曼几何框架，消除对标签和拓扑先验的依赖。

Method: 将流形操控重新表述为激活空间上的黎曼测地线计算，其中线性操控和标签样条操控可以看作特定度量选择下的测地线。提出以输出空间的Hellinger距离拉回到激活空间作为原则性度量，通过在一个小规模概念-词元模式上训练编码器来近似该度量，无需逐提示标签、拓扑先验和逐任务曲线拟合。

Result: 在标准四任务语言模型算术基准上，该方法能够可靠地将模型驱动到目标类别；在较小输出空间的任务上，相比基线方法，模型遵循了更符合行为自然的轨迹。

Conclusion: 本文提供了一个统一的黎曼流形操控框架，并通过基于模式监督、无标签的实例化方法验证了该框架的有效性，无需标签中心点或预设边界条件即可实现操控。

Abstract: Steering a language model - intervening on its internal activations to change downstream behaviour - has recently expanded beyond linear interpolation to nonlinear methods such as angular and kernelized steering, which define intervention transformations without learning an explicit geometry over paths in activation space. Freshly introduced geometry-aware manifold methods do learn such a geometry, but require labelled class centroids together with prescribed cyclic or sequential structure. These assumptions restrict where manifold steering can be applied, since existing constructions require labelled centroids and compatible boundary conditions. We recast manifold steering more broadly as \textbf{Riemannian geodesic computation} on activation space, recovering linear and labelled-spline steering as geodesics under particular choices of metric. A principled metric within this framework is the output-space Hellinger distance pulled back to activations; we approximate this with a learned encoder trained on output distances over a small concept-token schema - no per-prompt labels, no topology prior, and no per-task curve fitting. Empirically, the method reliably drives the model onto the target class across all tasks in a standard four-task language-model arithmetic benchmark, while following more behaviourally natural trajectories than baselines on smaller output spaces. We thereby provide a unified Riemannian framework for manifold steering together with a schema-supervised, label-free instantiation that operates without labelled centroids or prescribed boundary conditions.

</details>


### [906] [Global Convergence of Wasserstein Policy Gradient for Entropy-Regularized Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26078)
*Zhaoyu Zhu,Rui Gao,Shuang Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文建立了熵正则强化学习中Wasserstein策略梯度（WPG）方法的全局收敛理论。通过利用Bellman结构，证明了软Bellman残差与Gibbs策略之间的状态级KL表示、Bellman压缩性与全局最优间隙的关系、以及Bellman预解恒等式连接价值改进与相对Fisher信息。结合均匀对数Sobolev不等式，推导出分布式的Polyak–Łojasiewicz条件，并控制了离散化误差，最终获得了几何收敛率。该工作揭示了熵正则RL虽非传统凸问题，但Bellman递归诱导了支持WPG全局收敛的PL几何结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: WPG方法在连续控制问题中表现优异，但其全局收敛性质尚不明确。标准Langevin分析无法直接应用，因为RL目标通过Bellman递归依赖于策略，而非静态凸泛函，且Langevin漂移由软Q函数决定，其正则性在策略迭代过程中需要控制。因此需要发展专门的理论来证明WPG的全局收敛性。

Method: 利用熵正则RL的Bellman结构：1) 软Bellman残差的状态级KL表示；2) Bellman压缩性将残差与全局最优间隙关联；3) Bellman预解恒等式连接价值改进与相对Fisher信息。结合均匀对数Sobolev不等式（LSI）推导分布式Polyak–Łojasiewicz条件，并建立正则性和均匀界来控制离散化误差。

Result: 获得了WPG的几何收敛率（含离散化偏差），证明了熵正则RL虽非传统凸问题，但Bellman递归诱导了有利的PL几何结构，支持WPG全局收敛。

Conclusion: 本文通过Bellman结构分析首次建立了WPG的全局收敛理论，证明了熵正则RL中Bellman递归可替代传统凸性假设，为连续控制策略优化提供了理论保证。

Abstract: Wasserstein policy gradient (WPG) is a policy optimization method for reinforcement learning (RL) that exploits the optimal-transport geometry of action distributions. For the entropy-regularized RL objective, WPG evolves each state-conditional policy by transporting it along the action gradient of the soft Q-function together with a Langevin-type diffusion. Despite its appeal for continuous-control problems, its global convergence properties remain poorly understood. Standard Langevin analyses do not directly apply, because the RL objective depends on the policy through the Bellman recursion rather than through a static convex functional, and the Langevin drift is determined by the soft Q-function, whose regularity must be controlled along the policy iterates.
  In this paper, we develop a global convergence theory for WPG by exploiting the Bellman structure of entropy-regularized RL. We show that the role usually played by convexity can be replaced by a Bellman-based argument: the soft Bellman residual admits a statewise KL representation with respect to a Gibbs policy; Bellman contraction relates this residual to the global optimality gap; and a Bellman resolvent identity connects value improvement to relative Fisher information. Combined with a uniform log-Sobolev inequality (LSI) for the evolving Gibbs family, these ingredients yield a distributional Polyak--Łojasiewicz condition. We further establish the regularity and uniform bounds needed to control the discretization error, thereby obtaining geometric contraction up to a discretization bias. Conceptually, our analysis shows that although entropy-regularized RL is not convex in the usual flat sense, the Bellman recursion induces a favorable Polyak--Lojasiewicz-type (PL) geometry that supports global convergence of WPG.

</details>


### [907] [The Strongest Teacher Is Not Always the Best Teacher: Student-Centric Answer Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26872)
*Zhengyu Hu,Zheyuan Xiao,Linxin Song,Fengqing Jiang,Yuetai Li,Zhengyu Chen,Zhihan Xiong,Yue Liu,Junhao Lin,Yao Su,Lijie Hu,Kaize Ding,Teng Xiao,Radha Poovendran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出以学生为中心的教学信号选择框架SCAS，证明教师测试性能不能作为教学质量的代理指标，而应根据学生当前的学习成本选择最优的教师答案进行知识蒸馏，实验表明该方法在多种模型和任务上均优于传统做法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM训练中普遍采用表现最强的教师模型生成训练数据，隐含地假设教师测试性能等同于教学质量，但这一假设可能不成立：即使多位教师对同一问题给出正确答案，最强教师的答案也未必是对特定学生最优的监督信号。因此需要一种以学生为中心的教学信号选择方法。

Method: 提出Student-Centric Answer Sampling (SCAS)框架：首先从多个教师模型中收集经过验证的正确答案；然后基于token级别的梯度分解推导出高效的前向传播代理指标，用于估计学生中心的学习成本；最后根据该指标选择最优答案用于学生训练。

Result: 在30个教师模型、6个学生基座模型、6个任务上的实验表明，SCAS一致性地提升了学生模型的性能，验证了有效蒸馏应优先选择与学生当前状态匹配的教学信号，而非仅依赖教师自身强度。

Conclusion: 教师测试性能不能直接等同于教学质量；知识蒸馏中应优先考虑教学信号与学生当前学习状态的匹配程度，而非教师强度本身；SCAS提供了一种高效且可扩展的以学生为中心的教学信号选择方案。

Abstract: LLM training increasingly relies on teacher-generated supervision, from synthetic responses to reasoning traces and tool-use demonstrations. Current practice often chooses the highest-performing teacher to generate student training data, implicitly treating teacher test performance as a proxy for teaching quality. We show that this assumption can fail: even when multiple teachers provide correct answers to the same question, the answer from the strongest teacher is not necessarily the best supervision for a given student. To address this gap, we propose Student-Centric Answer Sampling (SCAS), a framework that selects from verified teacher-generated answers according to their estimated student-centric learning cost. Motivated by a token-wise gradient decomposition, we derive an efficient forward-only proxy for this cost and use it to guide answer selection during training. Experiments across 30 teacher models, 6 student base models, and 6 tasks show that SCAS consistently improves student performance, suggesting that effective distillation should prioritize supervision matched to the current student rather than teacher strength alone.

</details>


### [908] [Locality-Aware Redundancy Pruning for LLM Depth Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27786)
*Vincent-Daniel Yun,Youngrae Kim,Woosang Lim,YoungJin Heo,Minkyu Kim,Sunwoo Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LoRP是一种无需训练的、一次性深度剪枝框架，通过表示局部性（Representation Locality）引导，利用表示局部性分数（RLS）聚类相似层并分配剪枝，在多个LLM族上提升了困惑度和下游任务准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的一次性剪枝方法依赖局部层重要性或固定的冗余假设，忽略了跨架构的表示冗余差异，需要更通用的、架构感知的剪枝策略。

Method: 提出LoRP框架：1) 通过少量校准集计算全局层间隐藏状态相似性，导出表示局部性分数（RLS）；2) 对表示相似的层进行聚类；3) 根据聚类内残余冗余分配剪枝比例，实现无需训练的、一次性深度剪枝。

Result: 在多种LLM族上，LoRP在困惑度和下游任务准确率上均优于现有方法。

Conclusion: LoRP利用层间表示局部性这一架构依赖特性，实现了更有效的、通用的一次性深度剪枝。

Abstract: Large language models are known to contain representational redundancy across network depth, making depth pruning an effective approach for improving inference efficiency. Existing one-shot pruning methods rely on local layer importance or fixed redundancy assumptions across architectures. We propose Locality-Aware Redundancy Pruning (LoRP), a training-free one-shot depth pruning framework guided by representation locality. We show that inter-layer redundancy can be either localized or globally distributed depending on the LLM architecture. To characterize this phenomenon, we introduce Representation Locality Score (RLS), derived from global inter-layer hidden-state similarity. Using a small calibration set, LoRP computes pairwise layer similarity, clusters layers by representational similarity, and allocates pruning according to residual intra-cluster redundancy. Experiments across diverse LLM families show improvements in both perplexity and downstream task accuracy. Official github repository: https://github.com/daniel-eai/LoRP-Locality-Aware-Redundancy-Pruning/

</details>


### [909] [Mechanistic origins of catastrophic forgetting: why RL preserves circuits better than SFT?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28860)
*Jeanmely Rojas Nunez,Viraj Sawant,Nathan Allen,Nomgondalai Amgalanbaatar,Yannis Zongo,Vasu Sharma,Maheep Chaudhary*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究RL和SFT两种微调方式对LLM内部计算电路的影响，发现SFT适应目标任务更快但导致更严重的电路破坏和灾难性遗忘，而RL保留更多基础电路但适应速度较慢。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索RL相比SFT更能抵抗灾难性遗忘的机制原因，从行为层面深入到机械层面，研究两种微调方式对内部计算电路的不同影响。

Method: 提出"差分电路脆弱性"（differential circuit vulnerability）这一head级别的度量指标，用于衡量微调过程中电路的退化程度。在Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct模型上针对科学问答任务进行比较分析。

Result: SFT适应目标任务更快，但导致更大的电路破坏和先前能力遗忘；RL保留更多基础电路但任务适应速度较慢。存在明显的机制权衡。

Conclusion: 电路保留程度可能解释了为什么RL对灾难性遗忘更具鲁棒性。

Abstract: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) frequently induces catastrophic forgetting of prior capabilities. Recent work has shown that reinforcement learning (RL) retains prior capabilities more effectively than supervised fine-tuning (SFT), attributing this to policy-gradient updates remaining closer to the base policy \cite{shenfeld2025rl}. We extend this behavioral account to the mechanistic level and ask whether RL's advantage is mirrored by stronger preservation of internal computational circuits. We introduce differential circuit vulnerability, a head-level measure of how much a circuit degrades under fine-tuning, and use it to compare RL and SFT on Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct adapted to scientific question-answering. We find a clear mechanistic trade-off: SFT adapts more rapidly to the target task but produces substantially greater circuit disruption and forgetting of prior capabilities, whereas RL preserves a larger fraction of the base circuit at the cost of slower task adaptation. These findings suggest that circuit preservation may help explain why RL is more robust to catastrophic forgetting. We released our code here: https://github.com/rl-sft-circuit-research/differential-circuit-vulnerability.

</details>


### [910] [Cycle-Space Informed Detection of Autoencoded Blind False Data Injection Attacks on Power Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28912)
*Xin Li,Chenhan Xiao,Jonathan Cohen,Aviad Elyashar,Yang Weng,Rami Puzis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于循环空间的拓扑感知检测器（CSD），用于检测利用自编码器学习测量流形并沿雅可比零空间生成扰动的盲目虚假数据注入攻击。CSD利用电网拓扑的循环空间施加结构约束，通过最小循环基实现最优泛化误差，无需精确线路参数，在IEEE标准系统上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于统计或数据驱动的检测方法容易被攻击者利用相同的数据结构精心设计扰动（如自编码器学习测量流形后沿零空间生成扰动）所绕过，这暴露了单纯依赖数值分析的局限性。

Method: 提出拓扑感知的循环空间检测器（CSD），利用电网网络的循环空间（Cycle-Space）施加结构约束以增强零空间估计；采用最小循环基（MCB）实现最优泛化误差；方法不依赖精确线路参数，仅需拓扑信息。

Result: 在IEEE 14、30、57和118节点系统上的仿真结果表明，CSD能够有效检测数据驱动的FDIA，且在有实际测量噪声的条件下仍保持良好性能。

Conclusion: 基于拓扑循环约束的检测方法比单纯依赖数值零空间估计更鲁棒，能够有效分离正常测量与被攻击测量，且对线路参数不敏感。

Abstract: The rapid growth of AI-driven data centers and large-scale energy storage systems is increasing the reliance of power system operation on real-time measurement data and automated decision-making. However, many existing detection methods rely on statistical or data-driven analysis of measurements and can fail when attackers exploit the same data structure to craft stealthy perturbations. To illustrate this limitation, we demonstrate a blind False Data Injection Attack (FDIA) in which an Autoencoder learns the measurement manifold and generates perturbations aligned with the Jacobian null space, thereby allowing the attack to evade both residual-based baddata detectors and time-series anomaly detectors. To mitigate data-driven FDIAs which exploit the null space, we propose a topology-informed Cycle-Space Detector (CSD) that leverages the Cycle-Space of the network to impose structural constraints that enhance null space estimation. In addition, we prove that by using the Minimum Cycle Basis (MCB), the proposed CSD achieves the optimal generalization error for attack detection. By exploiting topology-derived cycle constraints rather than relying solely on numerical null space estimation, the proposed method does not require precise line parameters and improves the separation between normal and attacked measurements. Simulation results on IEEE 14-, 30-, 57-, and 118-bus systems demonstrate that the proposed method effectively detects data-driven FDIAs under realistic measurement noise.

</details>


### [911] [Midpoint Generative Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29920)
*Daniil Shlenskii,Nikita Gushchin,Lev Novitskiy,Dmitry V. Dylov,Alexander Korotin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出中点生成模型(MGM)，利用流匹配中线性插值的对称性，导出了中点散度作为分布差异度量，并通过随机插值扩展为广义中点散度，最终构建了可训练一步生成模型的目标函数，取得了有竞争力的生成效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有一步生成模型的训练缺乏原则性的理论框架，作者希望利用流匹配中线性插值的对称性，建立一种理论上严谨且可扩展的一步生成模型训练方法。

Method: 1) 观察到线性插值流匹配中当两个端点分布相同时，中点(t=1/2)处的漂移场为零，由此定义中点散度作为分布间差异度量；2) 引入随机翻转插值将中点散度扩展到任意时间点；3) 用对称随机插值替代确定性线性插值，得到广义中点散度；4) 推导广义散度的变分形式，得到可计算的目标函数用于训练一步生成器。

Result: MGM算法在一步生成建模任务上取得了与现有方法相当的竞争性能。

Conclusion: MGM提供了一种有效且理论扎实的一步生成建模方法，基于流匹配对称性给出了训练一步生成器的原则性框架。

Abstract: We introduce Midpoint Generative Models (MGM), a principled framework for training one-step generative models. MGM is based on a simple symmetry of Flow Matching with linear interpolation: when the two endpoint distributions coincide, the corresponding drift field vanishes at the midpoint time, $t=1/2$. We show that the norm of this field defines a valid discrepancy between distributions, which we call the Midpoint Divergence. We extend this discrepancy beyond the midpoint by introducing randomly flipped interpolations and further generalize it by replacing deterministic linear Flow Matching interpolations with symmetric stochastic interpolants, yielding a generalized Midpoint Divergence. Finally, we derive a variational formulation of our generalized divergence, yielding a tractable objective for training a one-step generator. The resulting MGM algorithm offers an effective and theoretically grounded approach to generative modeling, achieving competitive performance against existing one-step generative modeling methods.

</details>


### [912] [Can AI Weather Models Predict Beyond Two Weeks? A Quantitative Benchmark and Analysis of Long Rollouts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30184)
*Fanny Lehmann,Firat Ozdemir,Yun Cheng,Torsten Hoefler,Sebastian Schemm,Benedikt Soja,Siddhartha Mishra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对AI天气预报模型在长期滚动预测中出现的“不稳定性”问题，首次建立了正式的分类体系，将失败模式分为三类：发散、漂移和季节性丢失。通过对9个先进AI天气模型进行为期一年的滚动预测分析，发现稳定性取决于对小尺度时空信息的处理方式——不稳定模型会放大高频能量，而稳定模型则起到去噪作用。研究还通过ViT架构的消融实验验证了相关发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI天气模型在短期到中期预报（15天内）表现优异，但在长期滚动预测中频繁出现定义不明确的“不稳定性”问题，缺乏对这些失败模式的正式分类和系统性理解。

Method: 对9个最先进的AI天气模型进行为期一年的滚动预测，将失败模式分为发散、漂移和季节性丢失三类；通过向输入添加噪声分析模型行为；使用ViT架构进行消融实验验证设计选择的影响。

Result: 不稳定模型会放大高频能量，而稳定模型在输入添加噪声时起到去噪作用。稳定模型并非随机鹦鹉，而是能够根据初始状态生成独特的天气轨迹。

Conclusion: AI天气模型的长期稳定性关键在于对小尺度时空信息的处理方式，稳定模型具有去噪能力并能生成条件于初始状态的独特天气轨迹。

Abstract: While AI weather models excel at short-to-medium range forecasts (up to 15 days), they frequently suffer from ill-defined "instabilities" when rolled out over longer horizons. This work addresses the lack of a formal taxonomy by categorizing these failures into three distinct regimes: blow-up, drift, and loss of seasonality, through year-long rollouts of nine state-of-the-art AI weather models. Our analysis reveals that stability hinges on the treatment of small spatio-temporal scales: unstable models amplify high-frequency energy, while stable models act as denoisers when noise is added to their inputs. Far from reducing these models to mere stochastic parrots, our findings highlight that stable models generate unique weather trajectories, conditioned on the initial state. We verify our findings through ablation studies on architectural design choices, conducted using state-of-the-art Vision Transformer (ViT) AI weather model architectures.

</details>


### [913] [Cross-Layer Subspace Coupling for LLM Compression: A Unifying Framework and Its Empirical Limits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30836)
*Snigdha Chandan Khilar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出，基于SVD的LLM压缩方法（如SVD LLM和Basis Sharing）可统一为一个优化问题。虽然统一方法在数学上能将权重重建误差降低高达46%，但在实际任务中失败，困惑度和准确率严重下降。原因是残差流在前向传播中解耦了相邻层，使得逐层最优比跨层联合优化更重要。结论是权重空间重建不适合跨层压缩，未来应专注于逐层激活重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一现有SVD压缩方法（SVD LLM和Basis Sharing）到一个优化框架，并验证其有效性。

Method: 提出统一优化问题，将跨层SVD压缩形式化；在Pythia模型上进行数学证明和实验验证，并通过机制分析（残差流解耦）解释失败原因。

Result: 统一方法在权重重建误差上提升高达46%，但在下游任务（困惑度、准确率）上显著劣于逐层SVD LLM。

Conclusion: 权重空间重建是跨层压缩的 flawed objective，未来应聚焦于逐层激活重建。

Abstract: Recent SVD based compression methods for large language models like SVD LLM and Basis Sharing can be unified under one optimization problem. While mathematical proofs and tests on Pythia models show this unified approach improves weight reconstruction error by up to 46% percent it fails in practical tasks. Downstream metrics like perplexity and accuracy severely degrade compared to standard per layer SVD LLM. The authors explain this failure mechanistically. Although the bundle method mathematically couples adjacent layers the transformer residual stream actually decouples them during forward passes. Thus per layer optimality matters more than joint cross layer optimization. The paper concludes that weight space reconstruction is a flawed objective for cross layer compression and future methods must focus on per layer activation reconstruction instead.

</details>


### [914] [SDM-Q: Cost-Aware Staged Decision-Making for Multi-Omics Classification with Deep Q-Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31014)
*Nan Mu,Yangfan Xiao,Ling Wang,Xiaoning Li,Yue Kang,Chen Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SDM-Q，一种基于强化学习的自适应、成本感知的多组学分类框架，将多组学诊断建模为有限时序决策问题，通过后向阶段优化策略平衡诊断效用与采集成本，在四个公开数据集上有效减少冗余模态获取并保持竞争性分类性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 完整多组学数据获取昂贵且耗时，现有深度学习方法在推理时假设全模态可用，导致冗余且临床实用性有限。

Method: 将多组学诊断建模为有限时序序贯决策问题；定义状态为当前已获取的组学模态；使用动作-价值函数决定是否获取新模态或终止并输出预测；仅在终止阶段定义奖励，由分类正确性和累积模态获取成本共同决定；引入后向阶段优化策略提升策略一致性和训练稳定性。

Result: 在ROSMAP、LGG、BRCA、KIPAN四个数据集上有效降低冗余模态获取，同时保持与全模态输入方法相当的分类性能。BRCA和KIPAN中分别有超过99%和95%的受试者仅用单一组学模态即可准确分类；ROSMAP和LGG平均获取模态数低于2。

Conclusion: 成本感知的序贯决策为提升精准医学工作流程效率提供了有效范式。

Abstract: Multi-omics data provide complementary molecular characterizations of disease phenotypes and play an important role in disease diagnosis and subtype classification in precision medicine. However, acquiring complete multi-omics profiles is expensive and time-consuming, while most existing deep learning methods assume full modality availability during inference, resulting in substantial redundancy and limited practicality in clinical settings. To address this issue, we propose SDM-Q, a reinforcement learning framework for adaptive and cost-aware multi-omics classification. Specifically, multi-omics diagnosis is reformulated as a finite-horizon sequential decision problem, where the currently acquired omics modalities define the diagnostic state at each stage. An action--value function determines whether to acquire an additional modality or terminate the decision process and output the final prediction. To balance diagnostic utility and acquisition cost, the reward is defined only at the terminal stage and jointly determined by classification correctness and cumulative modality acquisition cost. A backward stage-wise optimization strategy is introduced to improve policy consistency and training stability. Experiments on four public multi-omics datasets, including ROSMAP, LGG, BRCA, and KIPAN, demonstrate that SDM-Q effectively reduces redundant modality acquisition while maintaining competitive classification performance compared with methods using complete multi-omics inputs. In the BRCA and KIPAN datasets, more than 99\% and 95\% of subjects, respectively, achieve accurate classification using only a single omics modality, while the average number of acquired modalities remains below two for ROSMAP and LGG. These results suggest that cost-aware sequential decision-making provides an effective paradigm for improving the efficiency of precision medicine workflows.

</details>


### [915] [Scalable Inference-Time Annealing with Surrogate Likelihood Estimators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31498)
*Daniel Peñaherrera,Rishal Aggarwal,David Ryan Koes*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SITA是一种可扩展的推理时退火方法，利用基于流的生成模型和基于能量的模型进行快速代理似然估计，在避免昂贵的散度项计算的同时，实现了对丙氨酸二肽和三肽体系玻尔兹曼分布的高效采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算化学和生物物理学中长期存在的一个挑战是高效采样分子的玻尔兹曼分布。现有的基于扩散模型的退火方法需要在推理时计算分数场的散度来估计重要性权重，这对于大分子系统而言计算代价过高且不可行。

Method: 提出SITA（可扩展推理时退火），该方法沿温度阶梯迭代微调基于流的生成模型，利用基于能量的模型（EBM）作为快速代理似然函数，从而在退火过程中避免直接计算昂贵的散度项。

Result: 在丙氨酸二肽和丙氨酸三肽体系上取得了最先进的性能表现，同时避免了代价高昂的散度项计算。

Conclusion: SITA通过引入基于能量的模型作为代理似然，有效解决了现有扩散模型退火方法在大分子系统中的可扩展性问题，为计算化学中的玻尔兹曼分布采样提供了更实用的方案。

Abstract: A long standing challenge in computational chemistry and biophysics is efficiently sampling the Boltzmann distribution of molecules. Advances in generative modeling have been proposed to address the limitations of conventional sampling techniques by eliminating the computational cost of simulation. A promising direction is iteratively finetuning diffusion models along a temperature ladder whereby training data is generated via importance sampling during inference-time annealing. Unfortunately, these methods require computing a divergence over the score field to estimate importance weights, rendering them intractable for larger systems. Here we present scalable inference-time annealing (SITA), which retrains flow-based models to generate samples at progressively lower temperatures using an energy-based model to facilitate fast surrogate likelihoods. We demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on both Alanine Dipeptide and Alanine Tripeptide while avoiding costly divergence terms. Our code is available at https://github.com/countrsignal/sita.git

</details>


### [916] [On the Recoverability of Causal Relations from Bulk Gene Expression Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00568)
*Gongxu Luo,Boyang Sun,Kun Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了从聚合的批量基因表达数据中恢复因果关系的问题，证明了只有在线性聚合（如均值/和）结合仿射结构方程的条件下，因果关系才能被恢复。通过对多个数据集的分析，发现基因调控关系通常偏离线性，因此对从批量数据恢复因果关系提出警告。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 批量基因表达谱在单细胞时代仍然重要，但聚合过程是有损的、不可逆的粗化过程。现有大量计算方法试图从批量表达数据中恢复基因间的因果关系，但聚合是否以及何种条件下能够恢复因果关系尚不清楚。

Method: 通过功能形式一致性和条件独立性一致性两种概念形式化定义了聚合下的可恢复性，推导了可恢复的充分必要条件，并利用4个批量数据和4个单细胞数据集的基因表达数据评估了线性假设的实证合理性。

Result: 因果关系只有在线性聚合（如和/均值）结合仿射结构方程的情况下才能保持。实证分析表明，在批量数据和单细胞数据中，估计的成对调控函数均偏离线性，不支持可恢复性所需的线性假设。

Conclusion: 在没有强额外假设的情况下，从聚合的批量表达数据中恢复因果关系应持谨慎态度。

Abstract: Bulk gene expression profiling, which aggregates pooled RNA across cells within a biological sample, remains important in the single-cell era because it is typically less noisy, more sensitive, and more cost-effective than single-cell assays. Accordingly, a growing body of computational methods seeks to recover causal relations among genes from bulk expression data. However, aggregation is a lossy, non-invertible coarsening of the underlying cellular system, and it remains unclear whether and under what conditions causal relations are recoverable from aggregated bulk gene expression data. To answer this, we formalize recoverability under aggregation through two notions of consistency: functional-form consistency and conditional-independence consistency. We then derive necessary and sufficient conditions for recoverability, showing that these properties are preserved only under linear aggregations (e.g., sum/mean) coupled with affine structural equations. To assess the practical plausibility of these conditions, analyses of four bulk and four single-cell gene expression datasets further reveal that the estimated pairwise regulatory functions among genes deviate from linearity in both data types, providing limited empirical support for the linearity assumptions required for recoverability. Together, these results caution against recovering causal relations from aggregated bulk expression data without strong additional assumptions.

</details>


### [917] [Beyond Independent Manipulation: Individual Fairness-aware Strategic Classification with Peer Imitation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00827)
*Xinpeng Lv,Chunyuan Zheng,Yunxin Mao,Renzhe Xu,Jinxuan Yang,Yuanlong Chen,Wangrong Huang,Shaowu Yang,Wenjing Yang,Xinwang Liu,Peng Cui,Haotian Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出个体公平感知的博弈分类（IFSC）框架，解决个体公平要求下智能体因模仿同类已接受个体而产生的相互依赖操纵问题，通过基于相似性的模仿学习和鲁棒优化，提升个体公平一致性并减少模仿扭曲。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公平感知博弈分类方法主要关注群体公平，且假设智能体独立响应。然而，当要求个体公平（相似个体获得相似结果）时，智能体的操纵会因相互模仿同类已接受个体而产生相互依赖，导致经典博弈分类框架与公平决策设置不匹配。

Method: 提出IFSC框架，将战略操纵建模为基于相似性对可见已接受同伴的模仿；学习操纵后分布下的分类器；采用鲁棒学习过程，在操纵模拟中引入随机扰动以处理同伴可观测的不确定性。

Result: 在合成和真实数据集上，IFSC提升了个体公平一致性，并缓解了模仿引起的分布扭曲。

Conclusion: IFSC有效解决了个体公平场景下智能体相互依赖操纵的问题，为公平感知的战略分类提供了新范式。

Abstract: Strategic classification (SC) investigates scenarios where agents manipulate their features to obtain favorable decisions from predictive models. Existing fairness-aware SC approaches primarily focus on group fairness and typically assume that agents respond independently. However, when individual fairness is required, ensuring similar individuals receive similar outcomes, agents' manipulation becomes interdependent: an agent's preferred manipulation depends on the neighborhoods' outcomes. This induces a mismatch between classical SC formulations and fairness-aware decision settings, where independent models no longer accurately characterize strategic manipulations. To address this issue, we introduce individual fairness-aware strategic classification (IFSC), a framework that models peer-driven manipulation arising from individual fairness, where agents imitate nearby positively decided peers to obtain favorable outcomes. IFSC characterizes strategic manipulation as similarity-based imitation toward visible accepted peers and learns classifiers under the resulting post-manipulation distributions. To account for uncertainty in peer observability, IFSC employs a robust learning process that introduces stochastic perturbations during manipulation simulation. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that IFSC improves individual-fairness consistency and mitigates imitation-induced distortions.

</details>


### [918] [When Hard Negatives Hurt: Bridging the Generative-Discriminative Gap in Hard Negative Synthesis for Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01304)
*Zhicheng Zhang,Jiwei Tang,Kuicai Dong,Xiaopeng Li,Jieming Zhu,Jingyu Li,Qianhui Zhu,Fengyuan Lu,Wang Jiaheng,Gang Wang,Hai-Tao Zheng,Zhaocheng Du*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CausalNeg框架，通过因果推理生成的负样本和查询视角熵最大化方法，解决生成式-判别式差距导致的检索性能下降问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 硬负样本挖掘存在语料库局限性、基于检索器分数而非诊断价值选择负样本、以及随着检索器性能提升假阳性污染加剧等固有问题。LLM合成负样本虽是有前途的替代方案，但简单引入生成数据到对比学习中往往降低检索性能，根本原因是生成式-判别式差距。

Method: 提出CausalNeg框架，包含两个模块：(1) CoT引导的反事实扰动数据构建：将文档满足查询的原因分解为显式信息需求，然后精确违反单个需求以构造具有可控、可解释难度的负样本；(2) 查询视角熵最大化训练：将生成负样本分散到相似度谱中，最小化来源身份与相似度分数之间的互信息，抑制捷径利用。

Result: 通过识别和形式化生成式-判别式差距的两个复合失效模式——判别式无关生成（LLM缺乏查询信息需求模型，生成通用或主题漂移文本）和源依赖捷径（分布特征使模型按来源而非相关性区分负样本，导致梯度漂移），证明了CausalNeg能有效解决这些问题。

Conclusion: CausalNeg通过因果反事实扰动构造高质量负样本，结合查询视角熵最大化抑制捷径学习，有效弥合了生成式-判别式差距，提升了检索器性能。

Abstract: Hard negative mining has become the dominant strategy for training retrievers, yet it faces intrinsic limitations: negatives are bounded by corpus availability, selected by retriever score rather than diagnostic value, and increasingly contaminated by false positives as the retriever improves. LLM-based synthesis offers a principled alternative, where negatives that are unconstrained, targeted, and free from false positive risk. But we show that naively incorporating generated negatives into contrastive learning often degrades retrieval performance. We identify and formalize the root cause as a generative-discriminative gap: LLM generation optimizes for fluent, plausible text, while contrastive learning demands strategic violations of relevance at the decision boundary. Our analysis reveals two compounding failure modes: discriminative-agnostic generation, where the LLM lacks an explicit model of query information needs and defaults to generic or topic-drifted text that provides no contrastive signal; and source-dependent shortcuts, where distributional artifacts enable the model to distinguish negatives by origin rather than relevance, causing gradient drift that actively corrupts optimization. To close this gap, we propose CausalNeg consisting of two main modules: (1) CoT-guided counterfactual perturbation for data construction: decomposes why a document satisfies a query into explicit information requirements, then surgically violates individual requirements to construct negatives with controlled, interpretable hardness. (2) Query-view entropy maximization during training: disperses generated negatives across the similarity spectrum, minimizing the mutual information between source identity and similarity scores to suppress shortcut exploitation. We make our code publicly available at https://github.com/mzhangzhicheng/CausalNeg.

</details>


### [919] [Turning Back Without Forgetting: Selective Backward Refinement for Parameter-Efficient Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01379)
*Anushka Tiwari,Kaiyi Ji*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SABER是一种无需回放的提示参数高效持续学习框架，通过选择性后向精炼实现正向后向知识迁移，利用提示梯度几何和损失分布相似性判断何时精炼，并限制更新为非干扰方向，在多个骨干网络上取得正向后向迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于提示的参数高效持续学习通过隔离任务特定提示来缓解灾难性遗忘，但这种隔离也限制了后期任务对前期任务的改进，后向知识迁移问题未被充分探索。

Method: 提出SABER框架：1) 利用提示梯度几何和损失分布相似性两种互补的任务相关性准则判断何时进行后向精炼有益；2) 通过将更新限制在提示参数空间中的非干扰方向来安全执行精炼。

Result: 在多个持续学习基准和多种预训练骨干网络（T5-Large, LLaMA, Qwen）上，SABER一致实现正向后向迁移，同时保持强大的整体平均性能。

Conclusion: SABER有效解决了提示隔离导致的后向迁移缺失问题，是一种无需重放即可实现可控后向迁移的持续学习方案。

Abstract: While prompt-based parameter-efficient continual learning mitigates catastrophic forgetting by isolating task-specific prompts, this isolation also limits later tasks from improving earlier ones, leaving backward knowledge transfer underexplored. We address this limitation by proposing Selective bAckward refinement for positive Backward knowledge transfER (SABER), a replay-free framework that enables controlled backward transfer in prompt-based continual learning. SABER determines when backward refinement is beneficial using complementary task-correlation criteria based on prompt-gradient geometry and loss-distribution similarity, and how to perform refinement safely by restricting updates to non-interfering directions in the prompt parameter space. Extensive experiments across multiple continual learning benchmarks and diverse pretrained backbones, including T5-Large, LLaMA, and Qwen, demonstrate that SABER consistently achieves positive backward transfer while maintaining strong overall average performance. Code is available at https://github.com/OptMN-Lab/SABER-ICML-2026/.

</details>


### [920] [Flexible Online Representation Learning Based on Similarity Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01546)
*Shagesh Sridharan,Yanis Bahroun,Anirvan M. Sengupta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种在线且符合生物 plausibility 的学习算法，能够学习稀疏、位移不变的表示，适用于聚类、流形分割和稀疏编码，解决了传统方法在处理高维稀疏表示时计算复杂度过高、难以扩展的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏高维表示有助于发现无监督数据探索中的非平凡结构（如社区检测、流形分割），然而现有方法要么在计算上不可行的完全正定矩阵空间中优化，要么松弛为双非负矩阵但随样本量增长而难以扩展，且缺乏在线学习能力。

Method: 提出一种通用的在线生物 plausible 学习算法，该算法能够学习稀疏位移不变表示，通过对输出相似性矩阵的行施加约束（如双随机性）实现位移不变性，并设计了相应的在线学习规则。

Result: 该算法能够根据数据结构灵活应用于聚类、流形分割或稀疏编码，同时保持稀疏性和位移不变性，解决了传统方法在大规模数据上的可扩展性问题。

Conclusion: 该在线生物 plausible 算法为稀疏位移不变表示的学习提供了一种实用且可扩展的解决方案，在无监督学习的多个任务中具有广泛适用性。

Abstract: Sparse high-dimensional representations are conducive to uncovering nontrivial structures in unsupervised exploration of data. Such a representation can deal with the dense connectivity in graphs relevant to community detection problems. However, sparse high-dimensional representations are capable of doing more, including manifold tiling and feature learning. Conventional algorithms optimize in the space of computationally intractable completely positive matrices or relax the problem to the space of doubly nonnegative matrices that scale with sample size in a way rendering them impractical for large data sets. Some of these methods also impose a row sum constraint, such as double stochasticity. Row sum constraints have the added advantage of being shift-invariant, in the context of manifold tiling. Constraints on the row sum of output similarity matrices require nontrivial online learning rules. Addressing these needs, we propose a versatile online biologically plausible learning algorithm capable of learning sparse shift-invariant representations, useful for clustering, manifold tiling, or sparse coding, depending on the data structure.

</details>


### [921] [Local Preferential Bayesian Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02351)
*Johanna Menn,Miriam Kober,Paul Brunzema,David Stenger,Sebastian Trimpe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出局部偏好贝叶斯优化方法族，将信任域和导数信息局部搜索扩展到偏好反馈场景，在高维和复杂优化问题上显著优于全局方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有偏好贝叶斯优化（PBO）方法采用全局搜索策略，在低中维问题上有效，但难以高效优化高维问题，需要开发适用于高维偏好优化场景的局部方法。

Method: 将高维BO中的信任域局部搜索和导数信息局部搜索扩展到偏好反馈设置，利用Laplace近似GP后验的一阶和二阶导数信息进行偏好引导的局部优化。

Result: 在GP样本路径、标准优化基准函数和策略搜索任务上，局部PBO方法在处理高维和陡峭最优点的复杂景观时特别有效，相比全局偏好基线方法显著降低了累积遗憾。

Conclusion: 局部PBO方法在高维和复杂偏好优化任务中优于全局方法，尤其适用于策略搜索等真实世界的偏好优化场景。

Abstract: Bayesian optimization (BO) is a popular and effective approach for tuning expensive, noisy experiments, but requires the formulation of an explicit objective function. Preferential BO (PBO) removes this requirement by learning from pairwise human feedback, yet existing methods struggle to efficiently optimize beyond low- and medium-dimensional problems due to their global search approaches. We address this limitation by developing a family of local PBO methods that transfer key ideas from high-dimensional BO to the preferential setting. In particular, we introduce local PBO methods which adapt trust-region and derivative-informed local search to pairwise preference feedback, where the latter exploits first- and second-order derivatives of the Laplace-approximated GP posterior. Our benchmark on GP sample paths, standard optimization benchmark functions, and policy-search tasks shows that local PBO methods are especially effective in high-dimensional and complex landscapes with steep optima. Compared with global preference-based baselines, they can substantially reduce cumulative regret, making them particularly useful for real-world preference-based optimization tasks such as policy search.

</details>


### [922] [Calibration Data Trade-offs Across Capability Dimensions: Why Multi-Source Mixing Matters for High-Sparsity LLM Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03328)
*Hu Xu,Zhaolong Xing,Congcong Liu,Jiaxing Wang,Zhida Jiang,Junshi Huang,Zhen Chen,Jianfeng Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现剪枝校准数据源对不同能力维度存在相反影响（通用能力正相关，数学/代码能力负相关），并提出多源混合校准方法IGSP，通过信息度量自动构建多源校准集，在LLaMA-3.1-8B上实现58.8%的总保留率，远超单源最佳（50.0%）和C4默认（40.0%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前研究认为校准源选择对平均剪枝精度影响不大，但本文质疑该结论是否在分维度评估时仍然成立，旨在揭示校准源对不同能力维度的差异化影响，并解决单一源无法同时保留所有能力的问题。

Method: 将后剪枝能力分解为通用、常识、代码、数学四个维度，对15个校准源进行Spearman相关分析；提出IGSP（信息引导自校准协议），通过最小化4-gram聚合和平衡各维度困惑度，自动构建多源混合校准集，无需能力对齐语料库。

Result: 校准困惑度与通用能力保留正相关（ρ=+0.71），但与数学（ρ=-0.53）和代码（ρ=-0.59）保留负相关；均匀多源混合达58.8%总保留率，比MetaMath（50.0%）高8.8%，比C4（40.0%）高18.8%；IGSP比Self-Cal高2.4%，比SGS高4.8%。

Conclusion: 校准源选择对剪枝后能力保留存在显著且方向相反的维度特异性影响，多源混合校准是有效解决方案，IGSP能自动化实现此过程。

Abstract: Post-training pruning compresses large language models to high sparsity using a small unlabelled calibration set, and recent work has concluded that the choice of calibration source has only modest impact on averaged post-pruning accuracy. We ask whether this conclusion survives once calibration impact is evaluated separately across distinct capability dimensions rather than aggregated. Decomposing post-pruning capability into General, Commonsense, Code, and Math, and analysing $n{=}15$ calibration sources via Spearman correlations between OIT information metrics and per-dimension retention, we uncover an opposite-sign trade-off: calibration perplexity correlates positively with General retention ($ρ{=}{+}0.71$) but negatively with Math and Code retention ($ρ{=}{-}0.53,\,{-}0.59$; $p{<}0.05$), so no single source can preserve all capabilities. We respond with multi-source calibration mixing, and propose IGSP, an information-guided self-calibration protocol that automates multi-source construction without capability-aligned corpora by minimising 4-gram aggregation and balancing perplexity across dimensions. On LLaMA-3.1-8B at SparseGPT 60% sparsity, a uniform multi-source mix reaches 58.8% total retention, outperforming the best single source (MetaMath, 50.0%) by $+8.8$ and the C4 default (40.0%) by $+18.8$; IGSP improves over Self-Cal by $+2.4$ and SGS by $+4.8$.

</details>


### [923] [Position: Deployed Reinforcement Learning should be Continual](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04029)
*Parnian Behdin,Kevin Roice,Golnaz Mesbahi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文论证了部署后无法达到最优但能接收评估性奖励信号的智能体本质上属于持续强化学习问题，识别了部署后导致非平稳性的四个来源，并通过现实世界的成功案例分析了持续RL的优势，呼吁社区从"训练-修复"范式转向持续学习范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大多数RL系统采用"训练-修复"范式，部署后的智能体不再学习，直到性能下降才重新训练。作者认为这种范式效率低下，需要转向持续强化学习。

Method: 作为立场论文，作者通过理论论证识别了部署后四个非平稳性来源，并分析了现实世界中持续RL的成功案例。

Result: 识别了部署后导致非平稳性的四个来源，展示了持续RL在现实世界中的成功应用案例，并提出了社区向持续学习范式转型的优势与衡量标准。

Conclusion: 部署后无法达到最优的智能体本质上是持续RL问题，最好的部署智能体从不停止适应，社区应放弃"训练-修复"范式转向持续学习。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has received increasing attention and adoption in real-world use cases. Most of these systems follow a train-then-fix paradigm, where trained agents do not learn while interacting with the world until performance degrades and retraining becomes necessary. In this position paper, we argue that deploying an agent that is incapable of optimality, but receives an evaluative reward signal, is inherently a continual RL problem. We identify four sources of non-stationarity after deployment that necessitate never-ending learning, and highlight why the best deployed agents never stop adapting. We analyze successful examples of continual RL in the real world, and present the community with the advantages and measures to move away from the current train-then-fix paradigm.

</details>


### [924] [An Empirical Audit of Input Encoders for Multi-Channel Signal Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04752)
*Ossi Lehtinen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统审计了八种多通道标量信号输入编码器，发现标准逐通道线性投影与大多数复杂方案性能几乎等价，原因在于其自发产生了近正交投影，而共享标量基线和独立通道结构则显著失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer处理多通道标量信号时需将C个同时值嵌入到一个d_model维向量中，现有多种编码方案但缺乏系统性比较，作者希望厘清各方案的实际性能差异及其根本原因。

Method: 在合成基准（通道标识有信息）和ETTh1上，以下一步负对数似然为指标，审计了八种编码器：共享标量基线、逐通道线性投影、正交正则化、非线性MLP、块分区拼接、通道独立架构、通道即词元架构、投影位置编码。

Result: 标准逐通道线性投影与所有替代方案性能几乎等价，差异虽统计显著但实际很小；几何探针揭示其自发产生近正交投影。共享标量基线和通道独立PatchTST风格基线显著失败。

Conclusion: 默认推荐使用标准逐通道线性投影，仅在特定任务需要时才考虑更复杂的方案。

Abstract: Transformers consuming multi-channel scalar signals must embed $C$ simultaneous values into one $d_{\text{model}}$-dimensional vector per time step. We audit eight input encoders -- a shared-scalar baseline, per-channel linear projections, an orthogonality regulariser, a nonlinear MLP, block-partitioned concatenation, channel-independent and channel-as-token architectures, and a projected positional encoding -- on a synthetic benchmark where channel identity is informative and on ETTh1, scored by next-step negative log-likelihood. The headline is practical near-equivalence within a wide "top tier": the standard per-channel linear projection matches every alternative up to small, statistically real but practically modest differences. A direct geometric probe attributes this to a spontaneous orthogonalisation of the per-channel projections: they end up near-orthogonal with no explicit regulariser, letting the standard linear recover channel identity from the summed embedding. Two encoders lose decisively: the shared-scalar baseline collapses for information-theoretic reasons we make explicit, and the channel-independent PatchTST-spirit baseline overfits universally on the synthetic benchmark and underperforms on both. Paired tests resolve two small gaps: projecting the sinusoidal positional encoding through a learned linear layer edges the rest at small $C$ by extending this orthogonality to the positional subspace; a nonlinear MLP stem edges them at the largest $C$, with the gap shrinking under more training data. The practical recommendation: use the standard per-channel linear projection by default; reach for something more elaborate only when the task calls for it.

</details>


### [925] [The Right Measure for Physics-Constrained Generation: A Co-Area Correction for Posterior-Consistent PDE Inverse Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04804)
*Jian Xu,Yanning Wu,Delu Zeng,John Paisley,Qibin Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明，使用扩散/流匹配模型通过硬约束（投影或引导）求解PDE逆问题时，会因忽略Borel-Kolmogorov悖论中的co-area Jacobian因子而采样到错误的后验分布。作者提出CoCoS方法，通过引入测度感知的约束采样器，首次实现了与真实后验分布一致的正确采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成模型（扩散/流匹配）在求解PDE逆问题时，普遍采用硬约束（投影或引导）来强制满足物理规律，并将采样结果报告为具有校准不确定性的贝叶斯后验。但这种广泛使用的做法理论上存在根本性缺陷——在零测度流形上条件化会引发Borel-Kolmogorov悖论，导致采样分布与真实后验分布不一致，从而影响科学推理中不确定性量化的准确性。

Method: 首先从理论上证明，硬PDE约束是对测度为零的流形进行条件化，存在固有歧义（Borel-Kolmogorov悖论）。物理上正确的解析（小残差噪声极限）包含co-area（Fixman）Jacobian因子[det(JJ^T)]^{-1/2}，而投影法和引导法都隐式忽略了这一因子。作者通过控制实验与独立同分布真实后验对比，量化了偏差大小。最后提出CoCoS（测度感知约束采样器），通过修正该Jacobian因子来瞄准正确的co-area后验分布。

Result: 省略co-area Jacobian因子并非二阶细节：它会使后验误差膨胀到采样噪声底线的20倍；最小位移投影（如PCFM）的偏差为采样噪声底线的9倍；简单的标量重新加权也无法修复。而CoCoS方法能够匹配金标准后验分布，误差仅限采样噪声范围内。

Conclusion: "满足物理规律"不等同于"采样后验分布"。对于不确定性感知的科学推理，需要基于co-area公式对约束采样进行原则性修正。CoCoS提供了这种修正方案，为科学推断中真正可靠的贝叶斯后验采样铺平了道路。

Abstract: Generative models -- diffusion and flow matching -- are increasingly used to solve partial differential equation (PDE) inverse problems, enforcing the governing physics as a \emph{hard constraint} (via projection or guidance) and reporting the resulting samples as a Bayesian posterior with calibrated uncertainty. We show that this widely adopted recipe samples the wrong distribution. Conditioning a generative prior on a hard PDE constraint is conditioning on a measure-zero manifold -- an operation that is intrinsically ambiguous (the Borel--Kolmogorov paradox) and whose physically correct resolution, the small-residual-noise limit, carries a co-area (Fixman) Jacobian factor $[det(JJ^{\top})]^{-1/2}$ that projection- and guidance-based methods silently omit. We make the bias precise, show that it grows with the heterogeneity of the constraint sensitivity, and validate it on controlled problems against an \emph{i.i.d.} ground-truth arbiter. The omitted factor is not a second-order detail: removing it inflates the posterior error to $20\times$ the sampling-noise floor; minimal-displacement projection (as in PCFM) is biased at $9\times$ the floor; and a naive scalar reweighting does not fix it. We introduce \textbf{CoCoS}, a measure-aware constrained sampler that targets the correct co-area posterior, and show that it matches the gold-standard posterior to within sampling noise. Our results imply that ``satisfying the physics'' is not the same as ``sampling the posterior,'' and give a principled correction for uncertainty-aware scientific inference.

</details>


### [926] [STaR-Quant: State-Time Consistent Post-Training Quantization for Diffusion Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04945)
*Xin Yan,Aqiang Wang,Zhenglin Wan,Xingrui Yu,Ivor Tsang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对扩散大语言模型（DLLM）的低比特量化挑战，提出STaR-Quant框架，通过状态引导激活变换（SGAT）解决掩码/非掩码令牌的激活分布差异，以及时间注意力补偿（TAC）抑制跨步量化误差累积，在保持低比特量化性能的同时实现1.69倍加速和3.14倍内存节省。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散大语言模型（DLLM）虽作为自回归LLM的有力替代，但模型规模大且迭代去噪过程带来严重的内存和计算开销，亟需高效的部署方案。后训练量化（PTQ）是降低开销的有效手段，但现有方法未针对DLLM的特性进行优化。

Method: 提出STaR-Quant框架，包含两个核心组件：1) 状态引导激活变换（SGAT），将掩码令牌与未掩码令牌分配到不同的激活变换空间，并通过统一的静态权重侧变换实现；2) 时间注意力补偿（TAC），利用轻量级块对角仿射映射校正量化后的注意力表示，抑制跨时间步的误差累积。

Result: 在代表性DLLM上的实验表明，STaR-Quant在低比特权重-激活量化上一致优于强PTQ基线，同时相比FP16部署实现最高1.69倍加速和3.14倍内存节省。

Conclusion: STaR-Quant有效解决了DLLM低比特量化中状态依赖的激活差异和时间误差累积两大关键挑战，为扩散大语言模型的高效部署提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Diffusion large language models (DLLMs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive LLMs by generating text through iterative masked denoising with bidirectional context. However, their large model sizes and iterative denoising process introduce substantial memory and computational overhead, motivating post-training quantization for efficient deployment. In this paper, we identify two key challenges for low-bit DLLM quantization: state-dependent activation disparity and temporal error accumulation. Masked and unmasked tokens exhibit different activation distributions within each denoising step, while quantization errors can accumulate across steps during iterative decoding. To address these challenges, we propose STaR-Quant, a state-time consistent PTQ framework for DLLMs. STaR-Quant introduces State-Guided Activation Transformation (SGAT) to assign masked and unmasked tokens to different activation transformation spaces with a unified static weight-side transformation. It further introduces Temporal Attention Compensation (TAC) to correct the quantized attention representation via a lightweight block-diagonal affine mapping. Experiments on representative DLLMs demonstrate that STaR-Quant consistently improves low-bit weight-activation quantization over strong PTQ baselines, while delivering up to 1.69x speedup and 3.14x memory saving over FP16 deployment.

</details>


### [927] [GOTabPFN: From Feature Ordering to Compact Tokenization for Tabular Foundation Models on High-Dimensional Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05441)
*Al Zadid Sultan Bin Habib,Md Younus Ahamed,Prashnna Kumar Gyawali,Gianfranco Doretto,Donald A. Adjeroh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出GOTabPFN，通过图引导排序与局部压缩，使小型表格基础模型能高效处理高维小样本（HDLSS）表格预测任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 让小型表格基础模型在不重新训练大骨干网络的情况下，有效应对高维小样本（HDLSS）表格预测任务中的维度灾难与稀疏性问题。

Method: 提出GO-LR（图引导排序与局部精炼），证明其等价于加权最小线性排列问题，并解释为TSP路径代理；基于GO-LR构建GOTabPFN，引入NSC（神经启发子单元压缩）将局部相邻有序特征池化为元特征，形成紧凑表示。

Result: 在表格基准测试中，GOTabPFN在紧凑token预算下提升了稳定性和准确率。

Conclusion: GO-LR结合NSC压缩策略能有效扩展TabPFN架构到HDLSS场景，兼顾性能与效率。

Abstract: We investigate how to make small tabular foundation models effective for High-Dimensional, Low-Sample Size (HDLSS) tabular prediction without retraining large backbones. We introduce Graph-guided Ordering with Local Refinement (GO-LR), show its equivalence to weighted Minimum Linear Arrangement, and interpret the practical solver as a TSP-path-style surrogate. We propose GOTabPFN,which builds on GO-LR, and a Neuro-Inspired Subunit Compression (NSC) unit to pool locally adjacent ordered features into meta-features, yielding a compact representation that makes TabPFN-style prediction practical in HDLSS regimes. Across tabular benchmarks, GOTabPFN improves stability and accuracy under tight token budgets.

</details>


### [928] [Field Validation of a Multi-Resolution ConvLSTM Framework for Retaining Wall Deformation Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05556)
*Jihoon Kim,Saeyon Kim,Heejung Youn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种多分辨率ConvLSTM堆叠集成框架，通过在噪声增强的数值模拟上训练，并在韩国11个基坑的34个测斜仪数据上验证，实现了对基坑开挖过程中挡土墙变形的精确预测（平均MAE=1.4mm，R²=0.93）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 挡土墙变形预测对基坑工程安全至关重要，但现有方法难以同时捕捉不同时间尺度的变形特征，且缺乏基于现场实测数据的系统验证。本研究旨在开发一个能在实际工程中可靠应用的预测框架。

Method: 采用多分辨率ConvLSTM模型，结合高斯噪声增强的数值模拟数据进行训练，并通过堆叠集成策略融合不同时间分辨率下的预测结果，最后利用韩国11个基坑34个测斜仪的现场数据进行验证。

Result: 框架可预测多达5.0米额外开挖的挡土墙变形，平均绝对误差1.4mm，决定系数0.93，且仅基于数值模拟训练数据即可有效应用于多种现场条件。

Conclusion: 该框架尽管仅在数值模拟与增强数据上训练，但能推广至实际工程条件，实现可靠的挡土墙变形预测，具有良好的工程应用前景。

Abstract: This study presents a comprehensive field validation of a multi-resolution Convolutional Long Short-Term Memory (ConvLSTM) framework for predicting retaining wall deformation during staged excavation. The framework is trained on Gaussian noise-augmented numerical simulations and integrates ConvLSTM models operating at different temporal resolutions through a stacking ensemble strategy. The proposed framework is validated using field monitoring data from 34 inclinometers across 11 excavation sites in South Korea. Site-wise prediction performance is systematically evaluated using multiple evaluation metrics, with analyses of the influence of temporal deformation irregularity and spatiotemporal prediction characteristics on model performance. The results demonstrate that the framework predicts retaining wall deformation associated with up to 5.0 m of additional excavation with an average mean absolute error of 1.4 mm and a coefficient of determination of 0.93 across the excavation sites. These results indicate that the framework, although trained exclusively on numerically simulated and augmented database, can be effectively applied to diverse field excavation conditions and achieve a reliable level of prediction accuracy in practical retaining wall deformation prediction.

</details>


### [929] [Domain-Adapted Small Language Models with Hybrid Post-Processing: Achieving Cost-Efficient, Low-Latency Multi-Label Structured Prediction via LoRA Fine-Tuning on Scarce Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05781)
*Srinivasan Manoharan,Dilipkumar Nallusamy,Sachin Kumar,Haifeng Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合框架，通过微调小语言模型（LLaMA 3.1 8B，仅2.05%参数可训练）并耦合确定性规则后处理层，在仅219个样本上实现与前沿大模型相当的结构化评估精度，同时降低延迟、成本和隐私风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部署前沿大语言模型进行领域特定结构化评估任务面临高延迟、高成本和数据隐私开销的问题，亟需一种更高效的替代方案。

Method: 采用LoRA微调LLaMA 3.1 8B小模型（仅2.05%可训练参数），在219个精心筛选的样本上训练，结合确定性规则后处理层；引入针对关键决策边界的硬负样本增强，形成混合神经-符号分解框架。

Result: 在对话转录的多标签合规评估任务（18个异构输出字段）中，实现100% JSON结构有效性、83.0%人工验证整体准确率、关键分类字段100%准确率；单次推理约2秒（比前沿API快2-5倍），每次评估成本0.013美元（比专有方案低46-76%）。

Conclusion: 领域自适应的小语言模型配合同步后处理能够匹配前沿模型精度，同时大幅降低运营成本、延迟和隐私风险。

Abstract: Deploying frontier large language models (LLMs) for domain-specific structured evaluation tasks incurs prohibitive latency, cost, and data-privacy overhead. We present a hybrid framework that fine-tunes a small language model (LLaMA 3.1 8B, 2.05% trainable parameters via LoRA) on only 219 curated examples and couples it with a deterministic rule-based postprocessing layer. Applied to multi-label compliance evaluation of conversational transcripts (18 heterogeneous output fields), our system achieves 100% JSON structural validity, 83.0% human-validated overall accuracy, and 100% accuracy on the most critical classification field in blind evaluation on 53 unseen production transcripts. On a single NVIDIA A100 GPU, inference completes in $\sim$2 seconds -- 2--5x faster than frontier APIs -- at USD 0.013 per evaluation versus USD 0.025--0.055 for proprietary alternatives, yielding 46--76% cost savings.
  We introduce targeted hard-negative augmentation for critical decision boundaries and formalize the hybrid neural-symbolic decomposition, demonstrating that domain-adapted small language models with postprocessing can match frontier model accuracy while dramatically reducing operational cost, latency, and privacy risk.

</details>


### [930] [Causal Longitudinal Prior-Fitted Networks for Counterfactual Outcome Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05797)
*Amirhossein Zare,Amirhessam Zare,Herlock Rahimi,Reza Salarikia,Mohammad Kashkooli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CausalLongPFN，一种基于先验拟合网络的时间序列因果推断方法，通过在合成结构因果模型上预训练，实现零样本情境下的反事实结果预测，无需梯度更新或倾向性模型拟合，在癌症、HIV、华法林和MIMIC-III基准上取得与领域专用训练模型竞争的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有纵向因果估计方法需要为每个队列或模拟器训练新模型，成本高昂且不实用；缺乏一种能在少量领域数据下进行零样本反事实结果预测的通用方法。

Method: 在涵盖治疗-混杂反馈、潜在异质性、非线性状态演化、延迟效应和累积治疗响应等多种因果结构的合成数据上预训练CausalLongPFN；测试时冻结模型，基于支持轨迹和查询历史零样本预测未来治疗结果，通过递归应用单步预测器实现多步预测。

Result: 在可分支癌症、HIV和华法林反事实基准上与领域训练模型竞争；在MIMIC-III事实预测上表现强劲。

Conclusion: 广泛的合成因果预训练可以作为一种冻结的、摊销的替代方案，用于在领域专用训练成本高昂或不可行时进行零样本纵向治疗-响应预测。

Abstract: Longitudinal treatment decisions from multivariate time-series data require predicting potential outcomes under future treatment sequences in the presence of time-varying confounding, heterogeneous patient dynamics, and limited domain-specific data. Existing longitudinal causal estimators typically address this problem by training a new model for each cohort or simulator. We introduce Causal Longitudinal Prior-Fitted Networks (CausalLongPFN), a prior-fitted network for time-series causal inference in longitudinal treatment-response data and zero-shot in-context counterfactual outcome prediction. The model is pretrained entirely on synthetic episodes sampled from a broad prior over temporal structural causal models, exposing it to treatment-confounder feedback, latent heterogeneity, nonlinear state evolution, delayed effects, and cumulative treatment responses. At test time, CausalLongPFN remains frozen and is used zero-shot: it conditions on support trajectories, a query history, and a planned future treatment sequence, and returns a predictive distribution over future outcomes without gradient updates or propensity-model fitting. Multi-step predictions are obtained by recursively applying the one-step predictor under the specified treatment sequence. We evaluate the model on branchable cancer, HIV, and warfarin benchmarks with ground-truth counterfactual labels, and on factual-only rolling-origin prediction in MIMIC-III ICU trajectories. CausalLongPFN is competitive with domain-trained longitudinal baselines on counterfactual benchmarks and performs strongly on factual MIMIC-III prediction, suggesting that broad synthetic causal pretraining can provide a frozen, amortized alternative for zero-shot longitudinal treatment-response prediction when repeated domain-specific training is costly or impractical.

</details>


### [931] [OPRD: On-Policy Representation Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06021)
*Shenzhi Yang,Guangcheng Zhu,Bowen Song,Haobo Wang,Mingxuan Xia,Xing Zheng,Yingfan Ma,Zhongqi Chen,Weiqiang Wang,Gang Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种新的知识蒸馏方法OPRD，通过在隐藏状态空间对齐学生和教师模型的表征，避免了传统输出空间蒸馏的采样方差和黑盒问题，在数学推理任务上表现更优，且训练更快、内存更少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于策略的蒸馏（OPD）存在两个局限：一是大词表上蒙特卡洛KL估计的采样方差持续存在；二是将教师模型视为黑盒，丢弃了LM head之前的中间隐藏状态信息。作者希望克服这些问题。

Method: 提出On-Policy Representation Distillation (OPRD)，在相同rollout上对齐学生和教师模型在选定层的隐藏状态表征，完全绕过LM head，在隐藏状态空间进行蒸馏。

Result: 在AIME 2024/2025和AIMO上，OPRD缩小了学生-教师差距，而输出空间OPD基线在低于教师水平处停滞；OPRD训练速度提升1.44倍，内存使用减少54%。

Conclusion: OPRD通过消除采样方差、提供更丰富的逐层结构信息，成为比传统输出空间蒸馏更高效、更有效的知识蒸馏方法。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) supervises the student only in output space by matching next-token probabilities. This output-only paradigm has two limits: (1) sampling variance from Monte Carlo KL estimates over large vocabularies (e.g., Qwen's ~150k tokens) persists throughout training, and (2) it treats the teacher as a black-box, discarding all intermediate hidden states after the LM head. We propose On-Policy Representation Distillation (OPRD), which lifts distillation into hidden-state space by aligning student and teacher representations across selected layers on the same rollouts, bypassing the LM head entirely. Theoretically, OPRD eliminates sampling variance and provides richer per-layer structural information. Empirically, OPRD closes the student-teacher gap on AIME 2024/2025 and AIMO, while output-space OPD baselines plateau below the teacher. OPRD also trains 1.44x faster and uses 54% less memory than top-k OPD. Code: https://github.com/ShenzhiYang2000/OPRD.

</details>


### [932] [Multi-Scale Feature Attention Network for Polymer Classification Using Terahertz Spectroscopy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06554)
*Roshni Mahtani,Ilán Carretero,Laura Monroy,Aldo Moreno-Oyervides,Oscar Elías Bonilla-Manrique,Rocío del Amor*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结合太赫兹光谱和深度学习（MSFAN网络）的方法，用于12种聚合物的高精度分类，准确率达85.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有聚合物分选和光谱技术在识别回收塑料时难以实现可靠的判别，亟需一种高效、非破坏性的分类方法。

Method: 提出多尺度特征注意力网络（MSFAN），集成特征门控信号重校准、多尺度并行卷积捕获不同频率模式，并通过跨特征注意力和注意力池化进一步优化特征。

Result: 在12类聚合物（包括纯聚合物、多层薄膜、商业混合物和生物聚合物）分类中达到85.2%的准确率，优于现有最先进模型。

Conclusion: 太赫兹光谱结合深度学习是一种有效、可扩展且可解释的聚合物分类方案，在回收塑料质量保障中具有应用潜力。

Abstract: Reliable polymer identification is essential for ensuring the quality and safety of recycled plastics, yet conventional sorting and spectroscopic techniques often struggle to deliver robust discrimination. Terahertz (THz) spectroscopy offers a promising alternative, providing high-resolution and non-destructive measurements. In this work, we leverage THz signals to classify 12 types of polymers, including pure polymers, multilayer films, commercial blends, and biopolymers. To handle the complexity of these spectral signals, we propose the Multi-Scale Feature Attention Network (MSFAN), a novel deep learning architecture tailored for THz data. The framework integrates feature gating for signal recalibration and multi-scale parallel convolutions to capture diverse frequency patterns. These features are further refined through cross-feature attention and attention pooling, enabling the model to intrinsically highlight the most informative THz regions. MSFAN consistently outperforms state-of-the-art models, reaching a classification accuracy of 85.2%. This study demonstrates the potential of combining THz spectroscopy with deep learning techniques for effective, scalable, and interpretable polymer classification.

</details>


### [933] [RECAP: Regression Evaluation for Continual Adaptation of Prompts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06698)
*Harsh Deshpande,Kushal Chawla,Sangwoo Cho,William Campbell,Sambit Sahu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RECAP是一个评估大语言模型在约束条件动态变化下进行主动适应能力的基准测试。研究发现现有提示优化方法在主动适应范式下表现不佳，即使付出更高延迟成本也无法显著提升性能，揭示了当前方法在部署场景中的局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产环境中的智能体系统经常面临动态变化的约束条件（如工具调用通知改变合规阈值、政策更新增加披露要求），且必须在下一次交互时立即遵守，几乎没有容错空间。现有的基准测试仅考虑静态约束集或带有评估反馈的反应式协议，缺乏对这种主动适应设置的评估。

Method: 提出RECAP基准测试，采用严格的主动适应-再测试协议：提示优化方法仅接收约束规范，必须在未见任何测试数据之前泛化。在四种LLM、三种调度方案和动态变化的约束条件下评估六种方法。

Result: 现有方法在主动适应范式下没有显著的性能提升，即使付出更高延迟成本也是如此。这些为离线或反应式设置设计的方法不足以应对主动适应范式。

Conclusion: 研究强调了设计主动式提示适应方法的需求日益增长，模型必须在部署中保持对动态变化需求的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Production agentic systems routinely face evolving constraints and must comply from the very next interaction. Scenarios like a tool-call notification changing a compliance threshold or a policy update adding disclosure requirements fit this criteria, having close to no room for errors in production. This proactive adaptation setting is common in deployment, but absent from current benchmarks, which assume either static constraint sets or reactive protocols with evaluation feedback. We introduce RECAP, a benchmark that measures continual-learning phenomena (forgetting, regression, forward transfer) at the constraint level under a strictly proactive adapt-then-test protocol: prompt optimization methods receive only the constraint specification and must generalize before seeing any test data. Evaluating six methods across four LLMs and three schedules with evolving constraints, we find that these methods show no significant improvement in performance, even after incurring a higher latency. These methods, designed for offline or reactive settings, are inadequate for the proactive paradigm. Our work emphasizes the growing need for designing proactive prompt adaptation methods, where the models must remain robust to evolving needs in deployment.

</details>


### [934] [Do Coding Agents Deceive Us? Detecting and Preventing Cheating via Capped Evaluation with Randomized Tests](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07379)
*Thanawat Lodkaew,Johannes Ackermann,Soichiro Nishimori,Nontawat Charoenphakdee,Masashi Sugiyama,Takashi Ishida*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CapCode框架，通过设计上限低于满分的数据集来检测模型作弊（利用捷径获得虚假高分），并基于此提出CapReward奖励机制抑制作弊行为。实验表明该方法能有效检测作弊并保持模型性能排名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体评估中，模型常通过利用任务捷径（而非真正解决问题）获得高分，导致评估分数不可靠，无法反映真实任务解决能力。

Method: 提出CapCode框架，构建带有随机化测试的编码数据集，其最佳非作弊性能被人为设定上限低于满分。基于此设计CapReward奖励机制，惩罚超出上限的优化行为。

Result: 多数据集实验表明，CapCode能有效检测作弊行为，同时保持模型的性能排名；CapReward能减少作弊行为，使模型更好地遵循任务规范。

Conclusion: 通过上限设计可使评估分数具有更清晰的解释性（显著高于上限即为作弊证据），结合针对性奖励机制可有效抑制模型作弊。

Abstract: A growing failure mode in agent evaluation and training is that models can achieve high evaluation scores by exploiting shortcuts instead of solving the intended task, producing deceptive performance. This makes evaluation scores unreliable as measures of true task-solving ability. We propose CapCode, a framework for constructing coding datasets with randomized tests whose best achievable non-cheating performance is deliberately capped below one. This capped-performance design gives evaluation scores a clearer interpretation: scores substantially above the cap are implausible and therefore provide evidence of cheating. To prevent cheating, we propose CapReward, a reward design based on the CapCode principle to discourage optimization beyond the cap. Experiments across multiple datasets show that CapCode detects cheating while preserving performance ranking of models, and CapReward reduces cheating behavior, yielding models that better follow the intended task specification.

</details>


<div id='cs.SI'></div>
